### 4. 仓颉：完整流程

```cangjie
enum NodeKind { | Zero | One | Half | Dot | Include | Proxy | Multi }

class Node {
    let kind: NodeKind
    let children: Array<Node>
    let female: Bool
    init(kind!: NodeKind, children!: Array<Node> = [], female!: Bool = false) {
        this.kind = kind
        this.children = children
        this.female = female
    }
}

class Rules {
    let conventionPaths: Array<Array<Int64>>
    let zeroOutermost: Bool
    let forbidFemaleInProxy: Bool
    init(conventionPaths!: Array<Array<Int64>> = [],
         zeroOutermost!: Bool = true,
         forbidFemaleInProxy!: Bool = true) {
        this.conventionPaths = conventionPaths
        this.zeroOutermost = zeroOutermost
        this.forbidFemaleInProxy = forbidFemaleInProxy
    }
}

func pathEq(a: Array<Int64>, b: Array<Int64>): Bool {
    if (a.size != b.size) { return false }
    for (i in 0..a.size) {
        if (a[i] != b[i]) { return false }
    }
    return true
}

func isConvention(path: Array<Int64>, rules: Rules): Bool {
    for (cp in rules.conventionPaths) {
        if (pathEq(cp, path)) { return true }
    }
    return false
}

func visit(node: Node, path: Array<Int64>, rules: Rules,
           conventions: ArrayList<Array<Int64>>,
           zeroInner: ArrayList<Array<Int64>>,
           femaleProxy: ArrayList<Array<Int64>>): Unit {
    if (isConvention(path, rules)) { conventions.append(path) }
    if (node.kind == NodeKind.Zero && path.size > 0) { zeroInner.append(path) }
    if (node.kind == NodeKind.Proxy && node.female) { femaleProxy.append(path) }

    for (i in 0..node.children.size) {
        visit(node.children[i], path + [i], rules, conventions, zeroInner, femaleProxy)
    }
}

main() {
    let tree = Node(NodeKind.Include, children: [
        Node(NodeKind.Zero),
        Node(NodeKind.Proxy, children: [
            Node(NodeKind.Include, children: [
                Node(NodeKind.Zero),
                Node(NodeKind.Proxy, children: [
                    Node(NodeKind.Include, children: [Node(NodeKind.One)])
                ]),
                Node(NodeKind.Zero)
            ])
        ]),
        Node(NodeKind.Zero)
    ])

    let rules = Rules(conventionPaths: [[0], [2]])
    let conventions = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
    let zeroInner = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
    let femaleProxy = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
    visit(tree, [], rules, conventions, zeroInner, femaleProxy)

    if (conventions.size > 1) { println("冲突：多个公约数 ${conventions.size}") }
    if (rules.zeroOutermost && zeroInner.size > 0) { println("冲突：内部 0 ${zeroInner.size}") }
    if (rules.forbidFemaleInProxy && femaleProxy.size > 0) { println("冲突：尖号内女性标记 ${femaleProxy.size}") }
}
```

### 完整流程

```
源码字符串
  → lex（字符→token）
  → parser（token→AST 树）
  → 你填 rules（公约数路径、尖号允许内容、0 位置规则）
  → visit（遍历树，按 rules 收集）
  → 输出冲突列表
```

程序不猜：
- 哪条路径是公约数 → `conventionPaths` 由你填；
- 哪个节点是女性 → `female` 由你标；
- 哪个 0 在内部算不算冲突 → `zeroOutermost` 由你开。

下一步若继续，只剩两样可补：**把 `conventionPaths` 改成“按 tags 标注”而不是手写路径**，或**把冲突输出改成 JSON/图结构**。你说方向，我按 Nim/Zig/Rust/仓颉 分别给。

### 1. Nim

```nim
import std/[json, strformat, strutils]

type
  NodeKind = enum nkZero, nkOne, nkHalf, nkDot, nkInclude, nkProxy, nkMulti
  Node = ref object
    kind: NodeKind
    children: seq[Node]
    female: bool

  Report = object
    conventionPaths: seq[seq[int]]
    zeroInner: seq[seq[int]]
    femaleProxy: seq[seq[int]]
    conflicts: seq[string]

proc kindName(k: NodeKind): string =
  case k
  of nkZero: "zero"
  of nkOne: "one"
  of nkHalf: "half"
  of nkDot: "dot"
  of nkInclude: "include"
  of nkProxy: "proxy"
  of nkMulti: "multi"

proc toJson(n: Node, path: seq[int]): JsonNode =
  result = %*{
    "kind": kindName(n.kind),
    "path": path,
    "female": n.female,
    "children": newJArray()
  }
  for i, ch in n.children:
    result["children"].add toJson(ch, path & i)

proc visit(n: Node, path: seq[int], rules: seq[seq[int]], r: var Report) =
  if path in rules:
    r.conventionPaths.add path
  if n.kind == nkZero and path.len > 0:
    r.zeroInner.add path
  if n.kind == nkProxy and n.female:
    r.femaleProxy.add path
  for i, ch in n.children:
    visit(ch, path & i, rules, r)

proc analyze(root: Node, rules: seq[seq[int]]): Report =
  visit(root, @[], rules, result)
  if result.conventionPaths.len > 1:
    result.conflicts.add "多个公约数"
  if result.zeroInner.len > 0:
    result.conflicts.add "内部0"
  if result.femaleProxy.len > 0:
    result.conflicts.add "尖号内女性标记"

proc toJson(r: Report): JsonNode =
  %*{
    "convention_paths": r.conventionPaths,
    "zero_inner": r.zeroInner,
    "female_in_proxy": r.femaleProxy,
    "conflicts": r.conflicts
  }

let tree = Node(kind: nkInclude, female: false, children: @[
  Node(kind: nkZero),
  Node(kind: nkProxy, children: @[
    Node(kind: nkInclude, children: @[
      Node(kind: nkZero),
      Node(kind: nkProxy, children: @[
        Node(kind: nkInclude, children: @[Node(kind: nkOne)])
      ]),
      Node(kind: nkZero)
    ])
  ]),
  Node(kind: nkZero)
])

let rules = @[@[0], @[2]]
let report = analyze(tree, rules)

let out = %*{
  "tree": toJson(tree, @[]),
  "report": toJson(report)
}
echo out.pretty
```

### 2. Zig

```zig
const std = @import("std");

const NodeKind = enum { zero, one, half, dot, include, proxy, multi };
const Node = struct {
    kind: NodeKind,
    children: []const Node = &.{},
    female: bool = false,
};

fn kindName(k: NodeKind) []const u8 {
    return @tagName(k);
}

fn writeTree(w: anytype, node: Node, path: []const usize) !void {
    try w.print("{{\"kind\":\"{s}\",\"path\":[", .{kindName(node.kind)});
    for (path, 0..) |p, i| {
        if (i > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
        try w.print("{d}", .{p});
    }
    try w.print("],\"female\":{s},\"children\":[", .{ if (node.female) "true" else "false" });
    for (node.children, 0..) |ch, i| {
        if (i > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
        var np = try std.heap.page_allocator.alloc(usize, path.len + 1);
        defer std.heap.page_allocator.free(np);
        @memcpy(np[0..path.len], path);
        np[path.len] = i;
        try writeTree(w, ch, np);
    }
    try w.writeAll("]}");
}

pub fn main() !void {
    const tree = Node{ .kind = .include, .children = &[_]Node{
        .{ .kind = .zero },
        .{ .kind = .proxy, .children = &[_]Node{
            .{ .kind = .include, .children = &[_]Node{
                .{ .kind = .zero },
                .{ .kind = .proxy, .children = &[_]Node{
                    .{ .kind = .include, .children = &[_]Node{.{ .kind = .one }} }
                }},
                .{ .kind = .zero }
            }}
        }},
        .{ .kind = .zero }
    }};

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.writeAll("{\"tree\":");
    try writeTree(stdout, tree, &[_]usize{});
    try stdout.writeAll("}\n");
}
```

### 3. Rust

```rust
use std::fmt::Write;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum NodeKind { Zero, One, Half, Dot, Include, Proxy, Multi }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Node {
    kind: NodeKind,
    children: Vec<Node>,
    female: bool,
}

fn kind_name(k: NodeKind) -> &'static str {
    match k {
        NodeKind::Zero => "zero",
        NodeKind::One => "one",
        NodeKind::Half => "half",
        NodeKind::Dot => "dot",
        NodeKind::Include => "include",
        NodeKind::Proxy => "proxy",
        NodeKind::Multi => "multi",
    }
}

fn write_tree(out: &mut String, node: &Node, path: &[usize]) {
    write!(out, "{{\"kind\":\"{}\",\"path\":[", kind_name(node.kind)).unwrap();
    for (i, p) in path.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 { out.push(','); }
        write!(out, "{}", p).unwrap();
    }
    write!(out, "],\"female\":{},\"children\":[", node.female).unwrap();
    for (i, ch) in node.children.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 { out.push(','); }
        let mut np = path.to_vec();
        np.push(i);
        write_tree(out, ch, &np);
    }
    out.push_str("]}");
}

fn main() {
    let tree = Node {
        kind: NodeKind::Include,
        female: false,
        children: vec![
            Node { kind: NodeKind::Zero, female: false, children: vec![] },
            Node { kind: NodeKind::Proxy, female: false, children: vec![
                Node { kind: NodeKind::Include, female: false, children: vec![
                    Node { kind: NodeKind::Zero, female: false, children: vec![] },
                    Node { kind: NodeKind::Proxy, female: false, children: vec![
                        Node { kind: NodeKind::Include, female: false, children: vec![
                            Node { kind: NodeKind::One, female: false, children: vec![] }
                        ]},
                    ]},
                    Node { kind: NodeKind::Zero, female: false, children: vec![] },
                ]},
            ]},
            Node { kind: NodeKind::Zero, female: false, children: vec![] },
        ],
    };

    let mut out = String::from("{\"tree\":");
    write_tree(&mut out, &tree, &[]);
    out.push('}');
    println!("{}", out);
}
```

### 1. Nim：完整流程

```nim
import std/[json, strformat]

type
  TokKind = enum tkZero, tkOne, tkHalf, tkDot, tkLParen, tkRParen,
                  tkLangle, tkRangle, tkLBrace, tkRBrace, tkEOF
  Token = object
    kind: TokKind
    pos: int
  NodeKind = enum nkZero, nkOne, nkHalf, nkDot, nkInclude, nkProxy, nkMulti
  Node = ref object
    kind: NodeKind
    children: seq[Node]
    tags: seq[string]

  LabelMap = seq[tuple[path: seq[int], tag: string]]
  Rules = object
    zeroOutermost: bool
    forbidFemaleInProxy: bool

proc lex(src: string): seq[Token] =
  var i = 0
  while i < src.len:
    case src[i]
    of '0': result.add Token(kind: tkZero, pos: i); inc i
    of '1': result.add Token(kind: tkOne, pos: i); inc i
    of '.': result.add Token(kind: tkDot, pos: i); inc i
    of '(': result.add Token(kind: tkLParen, pos: i); inc i
    of ')': result.add Token(kind: tkRParen, pos: i); inc i
    of '<': result.add Token(kind: tkLangle, pos: i); inc i
    of '>': result.add Token(kind: tkRangle, pos: i); inc i
    of '{': result.add Token(kind: tkLBrace, pos: i); inc i
    of '}': result.add Token(kind: tkRBrace, pos: i); inc i
    of ' ', '\n', '\t': inc i
    else:
      if src[i] == '\xC2' and i + 1 < src.len and src[i + 1] == '\xBD':
        result.add Token(kind: tkHalf, pos: i); i += 2
      else:
        raise newException(ValueError, "非法字符: " & $src[i])
  result.add Token(kind: tkEOF, pos: i)

type Parser = object
  toks: seq[Token]
  pos: int

proc peek(p: Parser): TokKind = p.toks[p.pos].kind
proc bump(p: var Parser): TokKind =
  result = p.toks[p.pos].kind
  inc p.pos

proc parseExpr(p: var Parser): Node

proc parseGroup(p: var Parser, close: TokKind, kind: NodeKind): Node =
  discard p.bump()
  while p.peek() != close:
    if p.peek() == tkEOF:
      raise newException(ValueError, "未闭合分组")
    result.children.add p.parseExpr()
  discard p.bump()
  result.kind = kind

proc parseAtom(p: var Parser): Node =
  case p.bump()
  of tkZero: Node(kind: nkZero)
  of tkOne:  Node(kind: nkOne)
  of tkHalf: Node(kind: nkHalf)
  of tkLParen: p.parseGroup(tkRParen, nkInclude)
  of tkLangle: p.parseGroup(tkRangle, nkProxy)
  of tkLBrace: p.parseGroup(tkRBrace, nkMulti)
  else: raise newException(ValueError, "意外 token")

proc parseExpr(p: var Parser): Node =
  result = p.parseAtom()
  while p.peek() == tkDot:
    discard p.bump()
    let rhs = p.parseAtom()
    result = Node(kind: nkDot, children: @[result, rhs])

proc applyTags(n: Node, path: seq[int], labels: LabelMap) =
  for (lp, tag) in labels:
    if lp == path:
      n.tags.add tag
  for i, ch in n.children:
    applyTags(ch, path & i, labels)

proc walk(n: Node, path: seq[int], cb: proc(n: Node, path: seq[int])) =
  cb(n, path)
  for i, ch in n.children:
    walk(ch, path & i, cb)

proc check(root: Node, rules: Rules): JsonNode =
  var conventions: seq[seq[int]]
  var femaleProxy: seq[seq[int]]
  var zeroInner: seq[seq[int]]
  var conflicts: seq[string]

  walk(root, @[], proc(n: Node, path: seq[int]) =
    if "convention" in n.tags:
      conventions.add path
    if n.kind == nkProxy and "female" in n.tags:
      femaleProxy.add path
    if n.kind == nkZero and path.len > 0:
      zeroInner.add path
  )

  if conventions.len > 1: conflicts.add "多个公约数"
  if rules.zeroOutermost and zeroInner.len > 0: conflicts.add "内部0"
  if rules.forbidFemaleInProxy and femaleProxy.len > 0: conflicts.add "尖号内女性标记"

  %*{
    "convention_paths": conventions,
    "female_in_proxy": femaleProxy,
    "zero_inner": zeroInner,
    "conflicts": conflicts
  }

# 主流程
let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0)"
let toks = lex(src)
var p = Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0)
let tree = p.parseExpr()

# 按路径打标签，不猜
let labels: LabelMap = @[
  (path: @[0], tag: "convention"),
  (path: @[2], tag: "convention")
]
applyTags(tree, @[], labels)

let rules = Rules(zeroOutermost: true, forbidFemaleInProxy: true)
echo check(tree, rules).pretty
```

### 2. Zig：完整流程

```zig
const std = @import("std");

const TokKind = enum { zero, one, half, dot, lparen, rparen, langle, rangle, lbrace, rbrace, eof };
const Token = struct { kind: TokKind, pos: usize };

const NodeKind = enum { zero, one, half, dot, include, proxy, multi };
const Node = struct {
    kind: NodeKind,
    children: []const Node = &.{},
    tags: u32 = 0,
};

const TAG_CONVENTION: u32 = 1 << 0;
const TAG_FEMALE: u32 = 1 << 1;

const Label = struct { path: []const usize, tag: u32 };
const Rules = struct {
    zero_outermost: bool = true,
    forbid_female_in_proxy: bool = true,
};

fn lex(src: []const u8, alloc: std.mem.Allocator) ![]Token {
    var out = std.ArrayList(Token).init(alloc);
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < src.len) {
        const c = src[i];
        switch (c) {
            '0' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .zero, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '1' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .one, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '.' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .dot, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '(' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .lparen, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            ')' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .rparen, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '<' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .langle, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '>' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .rangle, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '{' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .lbrace, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '}' => { try out.append(.{ .kind = .rbrace, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            ' ', '\n', '\t' => i += 1,
            else => {
                if (c == 0xC2 and i + 1 < src.len and src[i + 1] == 0xBD) {
                    try out.append(.{ .kind = .half, .pos = i }); i += 2;
                } else return error.IllegalChar;
            },
        }
    }
    try out.append(.{ .kind = .eof, .pos = i });
    return out.toOwnedSlice();
}

const Parser = struct {
    toks: []const Token,
    pos: usize = 0,
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,

    fn peek(self: *Parser) TokKind { return self.toks[self.pos].kind; }
    fn bump(self: *Parser) TokKind { const k = self.peek(); self.pos += 1; return k; }

    fn parseExpr(self: *Parser) !Node {
        var node = try self.parseAtom();
        while (self.peek() == .dot) {
            _ = self.bump();
            const rhs = try self.parseAtom();
            const ch = try self.alloc.alloc(Node, 2);
            ch[0] = node; ch[1] = rhs;
            node = .{ .kind = .dot, .children = ch };
        }
        return node;
    }

    fn parseGroup(self: *Parser, close: TokKind, kind: NodeKind) !Node {
        _ = self.bump();
        var children = std.ArrayList(Node).init(self.alloc);
        while (self.peek() != close) {
            if (self.peek() == .eof) return error.Unclosed;
            try children.append(try self.parseExpr());
        }
        _ = self.bump();
        return .{ .kind = kind, .children = try children.toOwnedSlice() };
    }

    fn parseAtom(self: *Parser) !Node {
        return switch (self.bump()) {
            .zero => .{ .kind = .zero },
            .one  => .{ .kind = .one },
            .half => .{ .kind = .half },
            .lparen => self.parseGroup(.rparen, .include),
            .langle => self.parseGroup(.rangle, .proxy),
            .lbrace => self.parseGroup(.rbrace, .multi),
            else => error.UnexpectedToken,
        };
    }
};

fn applyTags(node: *Node, path: []const usize, labels: []const Label) void {
    for (labels) |l| {
        if (std.mem.eql(usize, l.path, path)) node.tags |= l.tag;
    }
    // 子节点需要可变，这里用递归构造新节点
}

fn applyTagsRec(node: Node, path: []const usize, labels: []const Label, alloc: std.mem.Allocator) !Node {
    var n = node;
    for (labels) |l| {
        if (std.mem.eql(usize, l.path, path)) n.tags |= l.tag;
    }
    if (node.children.len > 0) {
        var new_children = try alloc.alloc(Node, node.children.len);
        for (node.children, 0..) |ch, i| {
            var np = try alloc.alloc(usize, path.len + 1);
            @memcpy(np[0..path.len], path);
            np[path.len] = i;
            new_children[i] = try applyTagsRec(ch, np, labels, alloc);
        }
        n.children = new_children;
    }
    return n;
}

fn countAll(node: Node, path: []const usize, report: *struct {
    conventions: usize = 0,
    zero_inner: usize = 0,
    female_proxy: usize = 0,
}) void {
    if (node.tags & TAG_CONVENTION != 0) report.conventions += 1;
    if (node.kind == .zero and path.len > 0) report.zero_inner += 1;
    if (node.kind == .proxy and node.tags & TAG_FEMALE != 0) report.female_proxy += 1;
    for (node.children, 0..) |ch, i| {
        var np: [64]usize = undefined;
        @memcpy(np[0..path.len], path);
        np[path.len] = i;
        countAll(ch, np[0..path.len+1], report);
    }
}

pub fn main() !void {
    var gpa = std.heap.GeneralPurposeAllocator(.{}){};
    defer _ = gpa.deinit();
    const alloc = gpa.allocator();

    const src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0)";
    const toks = try lex(src, alloc);
    var p = Parser{ .toks = toks, .alloc = alloc };
    var tree = try p.parseExpr();

    const labels = [_]Label{
        .{ .path = &[_]usize{0}, .tag = TAG_CONVENTION },
        .{ .path = &[_]usize{2}, .tag = TAG_CONVENTION },
    };
    tree = try applyTagsRec(tree, &[_]usize{}, &labels, alloc);

    var report = .{ .conventions = 0, .zero_inner = 0, .female_proxy = 0 };
    countAll(tree, &[_]usize{}, &report);

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.print("{{\"conventions\":{},\"zero_inner\":{},\"female_proxy\":{}}}\n",
        .{ report.conventions, report.zero_inner, report.female_proxy });
}
```

### 3. Rust：完整流程

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum TokKind { Zero, One, Half, Dot, LParen, RParen, LAngle, RAngle, LBrace, RBrace, Eof }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct Token { kind: TokKind, pos: usize }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum NodeKind { Zero, One, Half, Dot, Include, Proxy, Multi }

const TAG_CONVENTION: u32 = 1 << 0;
const TAG_FEMALE: u32 = 1 << 1;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Node {
    kind: NodeKind,
    children: Vec<Node>,
    tags: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Label { path: Vec<usize>, tag: u32 }

fn lex(src: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Token>, String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < src.len {
        let c = src[i];
        let k = match c {
            b'0' => Some(TokKind::Zero),
            b'1' => Some(TokKind::One),
            b'.' => Some(TokKind::Dot),
            b'(' => Some(TokKind::LParen),
            b')' => Some(TokKind::RParen),
            b'<' => Some(TokKind::LAngle),
            b'>' => Some(TokKind::RAngle),
            b'{' => Some(TokKind::LBrace),
            b'}' => Some(TokKind::RBrace),
            b' ' | b'\n' | b'\t' => { i += 1; continue; }
            0xC2 if i + 1 < src.len && src[i + 1] == 0xBD => {
                out.push(Token { kind: TokKind::Half, pos: i });
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("非法字节 0x{:02X}", c)),
        };
        out.push(Token { kind: k.unwrap(), pos: i });
        i += 1;
    }
    out.push(Token { kind: TokKind::Eof, pos: i });
    Ok(out)
}

struct Parser { toks: Vec<Token>, pos: usize }

impl Parser {
    fn peek(&self) -> TokKind { self.toks[self.pos].kind }
    fn bump(&mut self) -> TokKind { let k = self.peek(); self.pos += 1; k }

    fn parse_expr(&mut self) -> Result<Node, String> {
        let mut node = self.parse_atom()?;
        while self.peek() == TokKind::Dot {
            self.bump();
            let rhs = self.parse_atom()?;
            node = Node { kind: NodeKind::Dot, children: vec![node, rhs], tags: 0 };
        }
        Ok(node)
    }

    fn parse_group(&mut self, close: TokKind, kind: NodeKind) -> Result<Node, String> {
        self.bump();
        let mut children = Vec::new();
        while self.peek() != close {
            if self.peek() == TokKind::Eof { return Err("未闭合分组".into()); }
            children.push(self.parse_expr()?);
        }
        self.bump();
        Ok(Node { kind, children, tags: 0 })
    }

    fn parse_atom(&mut self) -> Result<Node, String> {
        match self.bump() {
            TokKind::Zero => Ok(Node { kind: NodeKind::Zero, children: vec![], tags: 0 }),
            TokKind::One  => Ok(Node { kind: NodeKind::One, children: vec![], tags: 0 }),
            TokKind::Half => Ok(Node { kind: NodeKind::Half, children: vec![], tags: 0 }),
            TokKind::LParen => self.parse_group(TokKind::RParen, NodeKind::Include),
            TokKind::LAngle => self.parse_group(TokKind::RAngle, NodeKind::Proxy),
            TokKind::LBrace => self.parse_group(TokKind::RBrace, NodeKind::Multi),
            _ => Err("意外 token".into()),
        }
    }
}

fn apply_tags(node: &mut Node, path: &mut Vec<usize>, labels: &[Label]) {
    if labels.iter().any(|l| l.path == *path) {
        node.tags |= labels.iter().find(|l| l.path == *path).unwrap().tag;
    }
    for (i, ch) in node.children.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        path.push(i);
        apply_tags(ch, path, labels);
        path.pop();
    }
}

fn count_all(node: &Node, path: &mut Vec<usize>, conv: &mut usize, zi: &mut usize, fp: &mut usize) {
    if node.tags & TAG_CONVENTION != 0 { *conv += 1; }
    if node.kind == NodeKind::Zero && !path.is_empty() { *zi += 1; }
    if node.kind == NodeKind::Proxy && node.tags & TAG_FEMALE != 0 { *fp += 1; }
    for (i, ch) in node.children.iter().enumerate() {
        path.push(i);
        count_all(ch, path, conv, zi, fp);
        path.pop();
    }
}

fn main() {
    let src = b"(0<(0<(1)>0)>0)";
    let toks = lex(src).unwrap();
    let mut p = Parser { toks, pos: 0 };
    let mut tree = p.parse_expr().unwrap();

    let labels = vec![
        Label { path: vec![0], tag: TAG_CONVENTION },
        Label { path: vec![2], tag: TAG_CONVENTION },
    ];
    apply_tags(&mut tree, &mut Vec::new(), &labels);

    let (mut conv, mut zi, mut fp) = (0, 0, 0);
    count_all(&tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut conv, &mut zi, &mut fp);

    println!("{{\"conventions\":{},\"zero_inner\":{},\"female_proxy\":{}}}", conv, zi, fp);
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：完整流程

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

enum TokKind {
    | Zero | One | Half | Dot
    | LParen | RParen | LAngle | RAngle | LBrace | RBrace | Eof
}

class Token {
    let kind: TokKind
    let pos: Int64
    init(kind!: TokKind, pos!: Int64) {
        this.kind = kind
        this.pos = pos
    }
}

enum NodeKind { | Zero | One | Half | Dot | Include | Proxy | Multi }

const TAG_CONVENTION: Int64 = 1
const TAG_FEMALE: Int64 = 2

class Node {
    let kind: NodeKind
    let children: Array<Node>
    var tags: Int64
    init(kind!: NodeKind, children!: Array<Node> = [], tags!: Int64 = 0) {
        this.kind = kind
        this.children = children
        this.tags = tags
    }
}

class Label {
    let path: Array<Int64>
    let tag: Int64
    init(path!: Array<Int64>, tag!: Int64) {
        this.path = path
        this.tag = tag
    }
}

func lex(src: String): Array<Token> {
    let out = ArrayList<Token>()
    let chars = src.toRuneArray()
    var i = 0
    while (i < chars.size) {
        let c = chars[i]
        if (c == r'0') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Zero, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'1') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.One, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'.') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Dot, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'(') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.LParen, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r')') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.RParen, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'<') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.LAngle, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'>') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.RAngle, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'{') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.LBrace, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'}') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.RBrace, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'½') { out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Half, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r' ' || c == r'\n' || c == r'\t') { i += 1 }
        else { throw Exception("非法字符") }
    }
    out.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Eof, pos: i))
    return out.toArray()
}

class Parser {
    let toks: Array<Token>
    var pos: Int64

    init(toks!: Array<Token>) {
        this.toks = toks
        this.pos = 0
    }

    func peek(): TokKind { return toks[pos].kind }

    func bump(): TokKind {
        let k = peek()
        pos += 1
        return k
    }

    func parseExpr(): Node {
        var node = parseAtom()
        while (peek() == TokKind.Dot) {
            bump()
            let rhs = parseAtom()
            node = Node(kind: NodeKind.Dot, children: [node, rhs])
        }
        return node
    }

    func parseGroup(close: TokKind, kind: NodeKind): Node {
        bump()
        let children = ArrayList<Node>()
        while (peek() != close) {
            if (peek() == TokKind.Eof) { throw Exception("未闭合分组") }
            children.append(parseExpr())
        }
        bump()
        return Node(kind: kind, children: children.toArray())
    }

    func parseAtom(): Node {
        match (bump()) {
            case TokKind.Zero => Node(kind: NodeKind.Zero)
            case TokKind.One  => Node(kind: NodeKind.One)
            case TokKind.Half => Node(kind: NodeKind.Half)
            case TokKind.LParen => parseGroup(TokKind.RParen, NodeKind.Include)
            case TokKind.LAngle => parseGroup(TokKind.RAngle, NodeKind.Proxy)
            case TokKind.LBrace => parseGroup(TokKind.RBrace, NodeKind.Multi)
            case _ => throw Exception("意外 token")
        }
    }
}

func pathEq(a: Array<Int64>, b: Array<Int64>): Bool {
    if (a.size != b.size) { return false }
    for (i in 0..a.size) { if (a[i] != b[i]) { return false } }
    return true
}

func applyTags(node: Node, path: Array<Int64>, labels: Array<Label>): Unit {
    for (l in labels) {
        if (pathEq(l.path, path)) { node.tags |= l.tag }
    }
    for (i in 0..node.children.size) {
        applyTags(node.children[i], path + [i], labels)
    }
}

func countAll(node: Node, path: Array<Int64>, report: Report): Unit {
    if ((node.tags & TAG_CONVENTION) != 0) { report.conventions += 1 }
    if (node.kind == NodeKind.Zero && path.size > 0) { report.zeroInner += 1 }
    if (node.kind == NodeKind.Proxy && (node.tags & TAG_FEMALE) != 0) { report.femaleProxy += 1 }
    for (i in 0..node.children.size) {
        countAll(node.children[i], path + [i], report)
    }
}

class Report {
    var conventions: Int64 = 0
    var zeroInner: Int64 = 0
    var femaleProxy: Int64 = 0
}

main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0)"
    let toks = lex(src)
    let p = Parser(toks: toks)
    let tree = p.parseExpr()

    let labels = [
        Label(path: [0], tag: TAG_CONVENTION),
        Label(path: [2], tag: TAG_CONVENTION)
    ]
    applyTags(tree, [], labels)

    let report = Report()
    countAll(tree, [], report)

    println("{\"conventions\":${report.conventions},\"zero_inner\":${report.zeroInner},\"female_proxy\":${report.femaleProxy}}")
}
```

### 流程总结

```
源码字符串
  → lex（字符→token）
  → parser（token→AST 树，含 tags 空位）
  → applyTags（按你给的路径+标签，给节点打标）
  → countAll（遍历树，按 rules 数公约数/内部0/尖号女性）
  → JSON 输出
```

程序不猜：哪条路径是公约数 → `labels` 由你填；哪个节点是女性 → `TAG_FEMALE` 由你标；哪个 0 在内部算冲突 → `Rules` 由你开。

下一步可选：把 `labels` 从路径改成 **DSL 标注串**，或把输出改成 **可回读的完整 JSON 树**。你说方向。

```nim
import std/strutils

type
  Label = tuple[path: seq[int], tag: string]

proc parsePath(s: string): seq[int] =
  if s.len == 0: return @[]
  for part in s.split('.'):
    result.add parseInt(part)

proc parseLabels(src: string): seq[Label] =
  if src.strip.len == 0: return @[]
  for item in src.split(';'):
    let pair = item.split(':', maxsplit = 1)
    if pair.len != 2:
      raise newException(ValueError, "标签格式应为 path:tag -> " & item)
    result.add (path: parsePath(pair[0].strip), tag: pair[1].strip)
```

### 2. Zig：标签 DSL 解析

```zig
const Label = struct {
    path: []const usize,
    tag: []const u8,
};

fn parsePath(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, s: []const u8) ![]usize {
    var out = std.ArrayList(usize).init(alloc);
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, s, '.');
    while (it.next()) |part| {
        if (part.len == 0) continue;
        try out.append(try std.fmt.parseInt(usize, part, 10));
    }
    return out.toOwnedSlice();
}

fn parseLabels(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) ![]Label {
    var out = std.ArrayList(Label).init(alloc);
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, src, ';');
    while (it.next()) |item| {
        const trimmed = std.mem.trim(u8, item, " \t\r\n");
        if (trimmed.len == 0) continue;
        const colon = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, trimmed, ':') orelse return error.BadLabel;
        const path_str = std.mem.trim(u8, trimmed[0..colon], " \t");
        const tag = std.mem.trim(u8, trimmed[colon + 1 ..], " \t");
        try out.append(.{
            .path = try parsePath(alloc, path_str),
            .tag = try alloc.dupe(u8, tag),
        });
    }
    return out.toOwnedSlice();
}
```

使用：

```zig
const labels = try parseLabels(alloc, "0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female");
```

### 3. Rust：标签 DSL 解析

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Label {
    path: Vec<usize>,
    tag: String,
}

fn parse_path(s: &str) -> Result<Vec<usize>, String> {
    if s.is_empty() { return Ok(Vec::new()); }
    s.split('.')
        .map(|p| p.parse::<usize>().map_err(|_| format!("非法路径段: {}", p)))
        .collect()
}

fn parse_labels(src: &str) -> Result<Vec<Label>, String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for item in src.split(';') {
        let item = item.trim();
        if item.is_empty() { continue; }
        let (path_str, tag) = item.split_once(':')
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("标签格式应为 path:tag -> {}", item))?;
        out.push(Label {
            path: parse_path(path_str.trim())?,
            tag: tag.trim().to_string(),
        });
    }
    Ok(out)
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：标签 DSL 解析

```cangjie
class Label {
    let path: Array<Int64>
    let tag: String
    init(path!: Array<Int64>, tag!: String) {
        this.path = path
        this.tag = tag
    }
}

func parsePath(s: String): Array<Int64> {
    if (s.size == 0) { return [] }
    let out = ArrayList<Int64>()
    for (part in s.split(".")) {
        if (part.size > 0) { out.append(Int64.parse(part)) }
    }
    return out.toArray()
}

func parseLabels(src: String): Array<Label> {
    let out = ArrayList<Label>()
    for (item in src.split(";")) {
        let trimmed = item.trimAscii()
        if (trimmed.size == 0) { continue }
        let idx = trimmed.indexOf(":")
        if (idx < 0) { throw Exception("标签格式应为 path:tag -> ${item}") }
        let pathStr = trimmed[0..idx].trimAscii()
        let tag = trimmed[idx+1..].trimAscii()
        out.append(Label(path: parsePath(pathStr), tag: tag))
    }
    return out.toArray()
}
```

使用：

```cangjie
let labels = parseLabels("0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female")
applyTags(tree, [], labels)
```

### 1. Nim：动态标签统计

```nim
import std/[tables, json]

proc collectTags(root: Node): Table[string, seq[seq[int]]] =
  result = initTable[string, seq[seq[int]]]()
  proc visit(n: Node, path: seq[int]) =
    for tag in n.tags:
      result.mgetOrPut(tag, @[]).add path
    for i, ch in n.children:
      visit(ch, path & i)
  visit(root, @[])

proc toJson(t: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]]): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  for tag, paths in t:
    result[tag] = %*paths

let tree = ...  # 上一轮解析出的树

applyTags(tree, @[], labels)

let tagged = collectTags(tree)
echo toJson(tagged).pretty
```

### 2. Zig：动态标签统计

```zig
const TagPaths = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize));

fn collectTags(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    node: Node,
    path: []const usize,
    out: *TagPaths,
) !void {
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, node.tag_str, ',');
    while (it.next()) |tag| {
        const t = std.mem.trim(u8, tag, " \t");
        if (t.len == 0) continue;
        const gop = try out.getOrPut(t);
        if (!gop.found_existing) {
            gop.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList([]const usize).init(alloc);
        }
        try gop.value_ptr.append(try alloc.dupe(usize, path));
    }
    for (node.children, 0..) |ch, i| {
        var np = try alloc.alloc(usize, path.len + 1);
        @memcpy(np[0..path.len], path);
        np[path.len] = i;
        try collectTags(alloc, ch, np, out);
    }
}
```

注意：Zig 版把节点标签存成 `tag_str: []const u8`（逗号分隔），而非位掩码，因为标签名是动态字符串。输出时遍历 `TagPaths` 打印每个标签的路径。

### 3. Rust：动态标签统计

```rust
use std::collections::HashMap;

fn collect_tags(node: &Node, path: &mut Vec<usize>, out: &mut HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>) {
    for tag in &node.tags {
        out.entry(tag.clone()).or_default().push(path.clone());
    }
    for (i, ch) in node.children.iter().enumerate() {
        path.push(i);
        collect_tags(ch, path, out);
        path.pop();
    }
}

fn main() {
    let tree = ...; // 上一轮解析出的树
    let labels = parse_labels("0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female").unwrap();
    apply_tags(&mut tree, &mut Vec::new(), &labels);

    let mut tagged: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut tagged);

    let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&tagged).unwrap();
    println!("{}", json);
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：动态标签统计

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

func collectTags(node: Node, path: Array<Int64>,
                 out: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>): Unit {
    for (tag in node.tags) {
        if (!out.contains(tag)) {
            out[tag] = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
        }
        out[tag].append(path)
    }
    for (i in 0..node.children.size) {
        collectTags(node.children[i], path + [i], out)
    }
}

main() {
    let tree = ... // 上一轮解析出的树
    let labels = parseLabels("0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female")
    applyTags(tree, [], labels)

    let tagged = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(tree, [], tagged)

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{")
    var first = true
    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
        first = false
        sb.append("\"${tag}\":[")
        for (i in 0..paths.size) {
            if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
            sb.append("[")
            for (j in 0..paths[i].size) {
                if (j > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("${paths[i][j]}")
            }
            sb.append("]")
        }
        sb.append("]")
    }
    sb.append("}")
    println(sb.toString())
}
```

注意：仓颉版需要把 `Node.tags` 从 `Int64` 位掩码改成 `Array<String>`，否则无法按标签名动态统计。改法：

```cangjie
class Node {
    let kind: NodeKind
    let children: Array<Node>
    var tags: Array<String>
    init(kind!: NodeKind, children!: Array<Node> = [], tags!: Array<String> = []) {
        this.kind = kind
        this.children = children
        this.tags = tags
    }
}
```

`applyTags` 相应改为 `node.tags = node.tags + [l.tag]`。

### 1. Nim：统一入口

```nim
type
  Program = object
    tree: Node
    labels: seq[Label]

proc parseProgram(src: string): Program =
  let at = src.find('@')
  if at < 0:
    result.tree = parseExprFrom(src.strip)
    result.labels = @[]
  else:
    let exprPart = src[0 ..< at].strip
    let tagPart = src[at + 1 .. ^1].strip
    result.tree = parseExprFrom(exprPart)
    result.labels = parseLabels(tagPart)

proc parseExprFrom(src: string): Node =
  let toks = lex(src)
  var p = Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0)
  result = p.parseExpr()
  if p.peek() != tkEOF:
    raise newException(ValueError, "表达式后有多余 token")

# 主流程
let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female"
let prog = parseProgram(src)
applyTags(prog.tree, @[], prog.labels)
let tagged = collectTags(prog.tree)
echo toJson(tagged).pretty
```

### 2. Zig：统一入口

```zig
const Program = struct {
    tree: Node,
    labels: []Label,
};

fn parseProgram(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !Program {
    const at = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, src, '@') orelse {
        const toks = try lex(alloc, src);
        var p = Parser{ .toks = toks, .alloc = alloc };
        return .{ .tree = try p.parseExpr(), .labels = &.{} };
    };

    const expr_part = std.mem.trim(u8, src[0..at], " \t\r\n");
    const tag_part = std.mem.trim(u8, src[at + 1 ..], " \t\r\n");

    const toks = try lex(alloc, expr_part);
    var p = Parser{ .toks = toks, .alloc = alloc };
    const tree = try p.parseExpr();

    return .{
        .tree = tree,
        .labels = try parseLabels(alloc, tag_part),
    };
}

// 主流程
const src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female";
const prog = try parseProgram(alloc, src);
const tree = try applyTagsRec(prog.tree, &[_]usize{}, prog.labels, alloc);
// 然后 collectTags 输出
```

注意：Zig 版 `applyTagsRec` 需要按 `Label.tag` 是字符串来处理；如果节点标签是位掩码，就把字符串映射成位；如果是字符串列表，就追加。程序不替你选，这里只给切分逻辑。

### 3. Rust：统一入口

```rust
struct Program {
    tree: Node,
    labels: Vec<Label>,
}

fn parse_program(src: &str) -> Result<Program, String> {
    match src.split_once('@') {
        None => {
            let toks = lex(src.as_bytes())?;
            let mut p = Parser { toks, pos: 0 };
            let tree = p.parse_expr()?;
            if p.peek() != TokKind::Eof {
                return Err("表达式后有多余 token".into());
            }
            Ok(Program { tree, labels: Vec::new() })
        }
        Some((expr_part, tag_part)) => {
            let toks = lex(expr_part.trim().as_bytes())?;
            let mut p = Parser { toks, pos: 0 };
            let tree = p.parse_expr()?;
            if p.peek() != TokKind::Eof {
                return Err("表达式后有多余 token".into());
            }
            let labels = parse_labels(tag_part.trim())?;
            Ok(Program { tree, labels })
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female";
    let prog = parse_program(src).unwrap();
    let mut tree = prog.tree;
    apply_tags(&mut tree, &mut Vec::new(), &prog.labels);

    let mut tagged: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut tagged);
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&tagged).unwrap());
}
```

```cangjie
class Program {
    let tree: Node
    let labels: Array<Label>
    init(tree!: Node, labels!: Array<Label>) {
        this.tree = tree
        this.labels = labels
    }
}

func parseProgram(src: String): Program {
    let at = src.indexOf("@")
    if (at < 0) {
        let toks = lex(src.trimAscii())
        let p = Parser(toks: toks)
        return Program(tree: p.parseExpr(), labels: [])
    }
    let exprPart = src[0..at].trimAscii()
    let tagPart = src[at+1..].trimAscii()
    let toks = lex(exprPart)
    let p = Parser(toks: toks)
    return Program(tree: p.parseExpr(), labels: parseLabels(tagPart))
}

main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female"
    let prog = parseProgram(src)
    applyTags(prog.tree, [], prog.labels)

    let tagged = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(prog.tree, [], tagged)
    // 输出 tagged
}
```

### 1. Nim：JsonNode 双向

```nim
import std/[json, tables]

proc toJson(n: Node, path: seq[int]): JsonNode =
  var tags = newJArray()
  for t in n.tags: tags.add %t
  result = %*{
    "kind": $n.kind,        # NodeKind 的字符串名
    "path": path,
    "tags": tags,
    "children": newJArray()
  }
  for i, ch in n.children:
    result["children"].add toJson(ch, path & i)

proc fromJson(j: JsonNode): Node =
  result.kind = parseEnum[NodeKind](j["kind"].getStr)
  for t in j["tags"]:
    result.tags.add t.getStr
  for ch in j["children"]:
    result.children.add fromJson(ch)

proc roundTrip(tree: Node): Node =
  let s = toJson(tree, @[]).pretty
  fromJson(parseJson(s))

# 主流程
let prog = parseProgram("(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female")
applyTags(prog.tree, @[], prog.labels)

let copy = roundTrip(prog.tree)
doAssert copy.toJson(@[]) == prog.tree.toJson(@[]), "round-trip 不一致"

let a = collectTags(prog.tree)
let b = collectTags(copy)
doAssert a == b, "回读后标签统计不一致"
echo "round-trip OK: ", toJson(a).pretty
```

### 2. Zig：std.json 双向

```zig
// 需给 NodeKind 提供字符串映射
fn kindToStr(k: NodeKind) []const u8 { return @tagName(k); }
fn kindFromStr(s: []const u8) !NodeKind {
    inline for (@typeInfo(NodeKind).@"enum".fields) |f| {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, f.name, s)) return @field(NodeKind, f.name);
    }
    return error.BadKind;
}

fn nodeToJson(w: anytype, node: Node, path: []const usize) !void {
    try w.beginObject();
    try w.objectField("kind");  try w.write(kindToStr(node.kind));
    try w.objectField("path");  try w.write(path);
    try w.objectField("tags");  try w.write(node.tags);   // []const []const u8
    try w.objectField("children");
    try w.beginArray();
    for (node.children, 0..) |ch, i| {
        var np = try std.heap.page_allocator.alloc(usize, path.len + 1);
        defer std.heap.page_allocator.free(np);
        @memcpy(np[0..path.len], path);
        np[path.len] = i;
        try nodeToJson(w, ch, np);
    }
    try w.endArray();
    try w.endObject();
}

fn nodeFromJson(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, v: std.json.Value) !Node {
    var n = Node{ .kind = try kindFromStr(v.object.get("kind").?.string) };
    var tags = std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(alloc);
    for (v.object.get("tags").?.array.items) |t| {
        try tags.append(try alloc.dupe(u8, t.string));
    }
    n.tags = try tags.toOwnedSlice();
    var children = std.ArrayList(Node).init(alloc);
    for (v.object.get("children").?.array.items) |ch| {
        try children.append(try nodeFromJson(alloc, ch));
    }
    n.children = try children.toOwnedSlice();
    return n;
}

// round-trip
var buf = std.ArrayList(u8).init(alloc);
try std.json.stringify(tree, .{}, buf.writer());
const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(std.json.Value, alloc, buf.items, .{});
defer parsed.deinit();
const copy = try nodeFromJson(alloc, parsed.value);
// 再用 nodeToJson 序列化 copy，逐字节比较
```

注意：Zig 的 `Node` 需要 `tags: []const []const u8` 才能直接 `w.write(node.tags)`；用位掩码时改成先映射成字符串数组再写。

### 3. Rust：serde 双向（最省事）

```rust
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum NodeKind { Zero, One, Half, Dot, Include, Proxy, Multi }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct Node {
    kind: NodeKind,
    children: Vec<Node>,
    tags: Vec<String>,
}

fn round_trip(tree: &Node) -> Result<Node, String> {
    let s = serde_json::to_string(tree).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    serde_json::from_str(&s).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female";
    let mut prog = parse_program(src).unwrap();
    apply_tags(&mut prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &prog.labels);

    let copy = round_trip(&prog.tree).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(copy, prog.tree, "round-trip 不一致");

    let mut a: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut a);
    let mut b: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&copy, &mut Vec::new(), &mut b);
    assert_eq!(a, b, "回读后标签统计不一致");
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&a).unwrap());
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：手写序列化 + JsonValue 反序列化

```cangjie
import std.encoding.json.*

func nodeToJsonStr(node: Node, path: Array<Int64>): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"kind\":\"${kindName(node.kind)}\",\"path\":[")
    for (i in 0..path.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        sb.append("${path[i]}")
    }
    sb.append("],\"tags\":[")
    for (i in 0..node.tags.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        sb.append("\"${node.tags[i]}\"")
    }
    sb.append("],\"children\":[")
    for (i in 0..node.children.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        sb.append(nodeToJsonStr(node.children[i], path + [i]))
    }
    sb.append("]}")
    return sb.toString()
}

func nodeFromJson(v: JsonValue): Node {
    let kindStr = v["kind"].asString()
    let n = Node(kind: kindFromName(kindStr))
    for (t in v["tags"].asArray()) {
        n.tags.append(t.asString())
    }
    for (ch in v["children"].asArray()) {
        n.children.append(nodeFromJson(ch))
    }
    return n
}

func roundTrip(tree: Node): Node {
    let s = nodeToJsonStr(tree, [])
    let v = JsonValue.parse(s)
    return nodeFromJson(v)
}

main() {
    let prog = parseProgram("(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female")
    applyTags(prog.tree, [], prog.labels)

    let copy = roundTrip(prog.tree)
    if (nodeToJsonStr(copy, []) != nodeToJsonStr(prog.tree, [])) {
        throw Exception("round-trip 不一致")
    }

    let a = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(prog.tree, [], a)
    let b = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(copy, [], b)
    // 比较 a、b 后输出
    println(nodeToJsonStr(copy, []))
}
```

仓颉 `std.encoding.json` 的 API 名称（`JsonValue.parse` / `asString` / `asArray`）以实际版本为准；若版本不同，按同义函数替换，手写序列化部分不受影响。

### 2. Zig：语义表检查

```zig
const SemanticEntry = struct { name: []const u8, meaning: []const u8 };

fn warnUnknownTags(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    tagged: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)),
    semantic: []const SemanticEntry,
) ![]const []const u8 {
    var warnings = std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(alloc);
    var it = tagged.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |entry| {
        const tag = entry.key_ptr.*;
        var found = false;
        for (semantic) |s| {
            if (std.mem.eql(u8, s.name, tag)) { found = true; break; }
        }
        if (!found) {
            const msg = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc,
                "未定义标签: {s}，出现 {d} 次", .{ tag, entry.value_ptr.items.len });
            try warnings.append(msg);
        }
    }
    return warnings.toOwnedSlice();
}

// 主流程
const semantic = [_]SemanticEntry{
    .{ .name = "convention", .meaning = "公约数" },
    .{ .name = "female",     .meaning = "女性标记" },
    .{ .name = "outer",      .meaning = "外层标记" },
};

var tagged = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)).init(alloc);
try collectTags(alloc, tree, &[_]usize{}, &tagged);

const warnings = try warnUnknownTags(alloc, &tagged, &semantic);
for (warnings) |w| std.debug.print("警告: {s}\n", .{w});
```

### 3. Rust：语义表检查

```rust
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct SemanticEntry {
    name: &'static str,
    meaning: &'static str,
}

fn warn_unknown_tags(
    tagged: &HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
    semantic: &[SemanticEntry],
) -> Vec<String> {
    let defined: HashSet<&str> = semantic.iter().map(|s| s.name).collect();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for (tag, paths) in tagged {
        if !defined.contains(tag.as_str()) {
            out.push(format!(
                "未定义标签: {}，出现路径: {:?}",
                tag, paths
            ));
        }
    }
    out
}

fn main() {
    let semantic = vec![
        SemanticEntry { name: "convention", meaning: "公约数" },
        SemanticEntry { name: "female",     meaning: "女性标记" },
        SemanticEntry { name: "outer",      meaning: "外层标记" },
    ];

    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger";
    let mut prog = parse_program(src).unwrap();
    apply_tags(&mut prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &prog.labels);

    let mut tagged: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut tagged);

    for w in warn_unknown_tags(&tagged, &semantic) {
        println!("警告: {}", w);
    }
}
```

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

class SemanticEntry {
    let name: String
    let meaning: String
    init(name!: String, meaning!: String) {
        this.name = name
        this.meaning = meaning
    }
}

func warnUnknownTags(
    tagged: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>,
    semantic: Array<SemanticEntry>
): ArrayList<String> {
    let defined = HashSet<String>()
    for (s in semantic) { defined.add(s.name) }

    let out = ArrayList<String>()
    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        if (!defined.contains(tag)) {
            out.append("未定义标签: ${tag}，出现 ${paths.size} 次")
        }
    }
    return out
}

main() {
    let semantic = [
        SemanticEntry(name: "convention", meaning: "公约数"),
        SemanticEntry(name: "female",     meaning: "女性标记"),
        SemanticEntry(name: "outer",      meaning: "外层标记")
    ]

    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger"
    let prog = parseProgram(src)
    applyTags(prog.tree, [], prog.labels)

    let tagged = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(prog.tree, [], tagged)

    for (w in warnUnknownTags(tagged, semantic)) {
        println("警告: ${w}")
    }
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
之前：collectTags 只输出 {tag -> paths}
现在：额外对照你的语义表，标签不在表里 → 警告
```

程序不猜语义：
- 语义表里有什么标签、每个标签什么意思 → **由你填**；
- 出现表外标签 → 只警告，不报错、不阻断、不替你删；
- 警告内容包括：标签名 + 出现路径/次数，方便你回去补表或改写法。

四种语言行为一致：**有定义 → 静默；无定义 → 警告；不改变 AST、不改变统计结果**。

下一步可选：**把警告分成“错误/警告”两级**（比如 `convention` 重复出现算错误，表外标签算警告），或**把语义表和标签 DSL 一起写进源串**（如 `@ 0:convention;2:convention # semantic: convention=公约数`）。你说方向。

统一源串格式：

```
(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger
# semantic: convention=公约数,error; female=女性标记,warn; outer=外层标记,warn
```

- `@` 前：表达式  
- `@` 后、`#` 前：标签路径  
- `# semantic:` 后：`标签名=含义,级别`，级别只允许 `error` 或 `warn`

程序规则：
- 标签不在语义表 → **warn**
- 标签在语义表且级别是 `error`，且出现次数 > 1 → **error**（重复错误）
- 标签在语义表且级别是 `warn` → 只记录，不报错

### 1. Nim：三段解析 + 分级

```nim
import std/[strutils, tables, sets]

type
  Level = enum lvError, lvWarn
  SemanticEntry = object
    meaning: string
    level: Level
  SemanticTable = Table[string, SemanticEntry]

  ParseResult = object
    tree: Node
    labels: seq[Label]
    semantic: SemanticTable
    errors: seq[string]
    warnings: seq[string]

proc parseLevel(s: string): Level =
  case s.strip.toLowerAscii
  of "error": lvError
  of "warn": lvWarn
  else: raise newException(ValueError, "未知级别: " & s)

proc parseSemanticTable(src: string): SemanticTable =
  result = initTable[string, SemanticEntry]()
  if src.strip.len == 0: return
  for item in src.split(';'):
    let trimmed = item.strip
    if trimmed.len == 0: continue
    let eq = trimmed.find('=')
    if eq < 0: raise newException(ValueError, "语义项应为 名=含义,级别 -> " & trimmed)
    let name = trimmed[0 ..< eq].strip
    let rest = trimmed[eq + 1 .. ^1]
    let parts = rest.split(',')
    if parts.len != 2: raise newException(ValueError, "语义项缺级别 -> " & trimmed)
    result[name] = SemanticEntry(
      meaning: parts[0].strip,
      level: parseLevel(parts[1])
    )

proc parseProgramV2(src: string): ParseResult =
  let hash = src.find('#')
  let body = if hash < 0: src.strip else: src[0 ..< hash].strip
  let semPart = if hash < 0: "" else: src[hash + 1 .. ^1].strip

  let at = body.find('@')
  let exprPart = if at < 0: body else: body[0 ..< at].strip
  let tagPart = if at < 0: "" else: body[at + 1 .. ^1].strip

  result.tree = parseExprFrom(exprPart)
  result.labels = parseLabels(tagPart)

  let semBody = semPart.strip
  if semBody.startsWith("semantic:"):
    result.semantic = parseSemanticTable(semBody["semantic:".len .. ^1])
  else:
    result.semantic = initTable[string, SemanticEntry]()

proc checkSemantic(
  tagged: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]],
  semantic: SemanticTable
): tuple[errors, warnings: seq[string]] =
  var defined = initHashSet[string]()
  for k in semantic.keys: defined.incl k

  for tag, paths in tagged:
    if tag notin defined:
      result.warnings.add "未定义标签: " & tag & " 路径: " & $paths
    else:
      let e = semantic[tag]
      if e.level == lvError and paths.len > 1:
        result.errors.add "错误: " & tag & "(" & e.meaning & ") 出现 " &
                          $paths.len & " 次，路径: " & $paths

# 主流程
let prog = parseProgramV2(
  "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n" &
  "# semantic: convention=公约数,error; female=女性标记,warn; outer=外层标记,warn"
)
applyTags(prog.tree, @[], prog.labels)
let tagged = collectTags(prog.tree)
let (errs, warns) = checkSemantic(tagged, prog.semantic)

for e in errs: echo e
for w in warns: echo "警告: ", w
```

```
警告: 未定义标签: stranger 路径: @[@[1, 1]]
```

### 2. Zig：三段解析 + 分级

```zig
const Level = enum { error_level, warn_level };
const SemanticEntry = struct { meaning: []const u8, level: Level };

fn parseLevel(s: []const u8) !Level {
    const t = std.mem.trim(u8, s, " \t\r\n");
    if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(t, "error")) return .error_level;
    if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(t, "warn")) return .warn_level;
    return error.BadLevel;
}

fn parseSemanticTable(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    src: []const u8,
) !std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry) {
    var out = std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry).init(alloc);
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, src, ';');
    while (it.next()) |item| {
        const t = std.mem.trim(u8, item, " \t\r\n");
        if (t.len == 0) continue;
        const eq = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, t, '=') orelse return error.BadEntry;
        const name = std.mem.trim(u8, t[0..eq], " \t");
        const rest = t[eq + 1 ..];
        const comma = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, rest, ',') orelse return error.BadEntry;
        const meaning = std.mem.trim(u8, rest[0..comma], " \t");
        const level = try parseLevel(rest[comma + 1 ..]);
        try out.put(
            try alloc.dupe(u8, name),
            .{ .meaning = try alloc.dupe(u8, meaning), .level = level },
        );
    }
    return out;
}

const ProgramV2 = struct {
    tree: Node,
    labels: []Label,
    semantic: std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry),
};

fn parseProgramV2(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !ProgramV2 {
    const hash = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, src, '#') orelse src.len;
    const body = std.mem.trim(u8, src[0..hash], " \t\r\n");
    const sem_part = if (hash < src.len)
        std.mem.trim(u8, src[hash + 1 ..], " \t\r\n")
    else
        "";

    const at = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, body, '@') orelse body.len;
    const expr_part = std.mem.trim(u8, body[0..at], " \t\r\n");
    const tag_part = if (at < body.len)
        std.mem.trim(u8, body[at + 1 ..], " \t\r\n")
    else
        "";

    const toks = try lex(alloc, expr_part);
    var p = Parser{ .toks = toks, .alloc = alloc };
    const tree = try p.parseExpr();

    var semantic = std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry).init(alloc);
    if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, sem_part, "semantic:")) {
        semantic = try parseSemanticTable(alloc, sem_part["semantic:".len..]);
    }

    return .{
        .tree = tree,
        .labels = try parseLabels(alloc, tag_part),
        .semantic = semantic,
    };
}

fn checkSemantic(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    tagged: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)),
    semantic: *std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry),
    errors: *std.ArrayList([]const u8),
    warnings: *std.ArrayList([]const u8),
) !void {
    var it = tagged.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |entry| {
        const tag = entry.key_ptr.*;
        const paths = entry.value_ptr.items;
        if (semantic.get(tag)) |e| {
            if (e.level == .error_level and paths.len > 1) {
                const msg = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc,
                    "错误: {s}({s}) 出现 {d} 次",
                    .{ tag, e.meaning, paths.len });
                try errors.append(msg);
            }
        } else {
            const msg = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc,
                "未定义标签: {s} 出现 {d} 次", .{ tag, paths.len });
            try warnings.append(msg);
        }
    }
}
```

### 3. Rust：三段解析 + 分级

```rust
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Level { Error, Warn }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct SemanticEntry {
    meaning: String,
    level: Level,
}

struct ParseResult {
    tree: Node,
    labels: Vec<Label>,
    semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
}

fn parse_level(s: &str) -> Result<Level, String> {
    match s.trim().to_lowercase().as_str() {
        "error" => Ok(Level::Error),
        "warn"  => Ok(Level::Warn),
        other   => Err(format!("未知级别: {}", other)),
    }
}

fn parse_semantic_table(src: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>, String> {
    let mut out = HashMap::new();
    for item in src.split(';') {
        let t = item.trim();
        if t.is_empty() { continue; }
        let (name, rest) = t.split_once('=')
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("语义项应为 名=含义,级别 -> {}", t))?;
        let (meaning, level_str) = rest.split_once(',')
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("语义项缺级别 -> {}", t))?;
        out.insert(
            name.trim().to_string(),
            SemanticEntry {
                meaning: meaning.trim().to_string(),
                level: parse_level(level_str)?,
            },
        );
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn parse_program_v2(src: &str) -> Result<ParseResult, String> {
    let (body, sem_part) = match src.split_once('#') {
        Some((b, s)) => (b.trim(), s.trim()),
        None => (src.trim(), ""),
    };
    let (expr_part, tag_part) = match body.split_once('@') {
        Some((e, t)) => (e.trim(), t.trim()),
        None => (body, ""),
    };

    let toks = lex(expr_part.as_bytes())?;
    let mut p = Parser { toks, pos: 0 };
    let tree = p.parse_expr()?;
    if p.peek() != TokKind::Eof {
        return Err("表达式后有多余 token".into());
    }
    let labels = parse_labels(tag_part)?;

    let semantic = if let Some(rest) = sem_part.strip_prefix("semantic:") {
        parse_semantic_table(rest.trim())?
    } else {
        HashMap::new()
    };

    Ok(ParseResult { tree, labels, semantic })
}

fn check_semantic(
    tagged: &HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
    semantic: &HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    let mut warnings = Vec::new();
    for (tag, paths) in tagged {
        match semantic.get(tag) {
            Some(e) => {
                if e.level == Level::Error && paths.len() > 1 {
                    errors.push(format!(
                        "错误: {}({}) 出现 {} 次，路径 {:?}",
                        tag, e.meaning, paths.len(), paths
                    ));
                }
            }
            None => {
                warnings.push(format!("未定义标签: {} 出现 {} 次", tag, paths.len()));
            }
        }
    }
    (errors, warnings)
}

fn main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n\
               # semantic: convention=公约数,error; female=女性标记,warn; outer=外层标记,warn";
    let mut prog = parse_program_v2(src).unwrap();
    apply_tags(&mut prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &prog.labels);

    let mut tagged: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut tagged);

    let (errors, warnings) = check_semantic(&tagged, &prog.semantic);
    for e in errors { println!("{}", e); }
    for w in warnings { println!("警告: {}", w); }
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：三段解析 + 分级

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

enum Level { | Error | Warn }

class SemanticEntry {
    let meaning: String
    let level: Level
    init(meaning!: String, level!: Level) {
        this.meaning = meaning
        this.level = level
    }
}

class ParseResult {
    let tree: Node
    let labels: Array<Label>
    let semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>
    init(tree!: Node, labels!: Array<Label>, semantic!: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>) {
        this.tree = tree
        this.labels = labels
        this.semantic = semantic
    }
}

func parseLevel(s: String): Level {
    let t = s.trimAscii().toLowerAscii()
    if (t == "error") { return Level.Error }
    if (t == "warn") { return Level.Warn }
    throw Exception("未知级别: ${t}")
}

func parseSemanticTable(src: String): HashMap<String, SemanticEntry> {
    let out = HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>()
    for (item in src.split(";")) {
        let t = item.trimAscii()
        if (t.size == 0) { continue }
        let eq = t.indexOf("=")
        if (eq < 0) { throw Exception("语义项应为 名=含义,级别 -> ${t}") }
        let name = t[0..eq].trimAscii()
        let rest = t[eq+1..]
        let comma = rest.indexOf(",")
        if (comma < 0) { throw Exception("语义项缺级别 -> ${t}") }
        let meaning = rest[0..comma].trimAscii()
        let level = parseLevel(rest[comma+1..])
        out[name] = SemanticEntry(meaning: meaning, level: level)
    }
    return out
}

func parseProgramV2(src: String): ParseResult {
    let hashIdx = src.indexOf("#")
    let body = (if (hashIdx < 0) { src } else { src[0..hashIdx] }).trimAscii()
    let semPart = (if (hashIdx < 0) { "" } else { src[hashIdx+1..] }).trimAscii()

    let atIdx = body.indexOf("@")
    let exprPart = (if (atIdx < 0) { body } else { body[0..atIdx] }).trimAscii()
    let tagPart = (if (atIdx < 0) { "" } else { body[atIdx+1..] }).trimAscii()

    let toks = lex(exprPart)
    let p = Parser(toks: toks)
    let tree = p.parseExpr()

    var semantic = HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>()
    if (semPart.startsWith("semantic:")) {
        semantic = parseSemanticTable(semPart["semantic:".size..].trimAscii())
    }

    return ParseResult(tree: tree, labels: parseLabels(tagPart), semantic: semantic)
}

func checkSemantic(tagged: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>,
                    semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
                    errors: ArrayList<String>,
                    warnings: ArrayList<String>): Unit {
    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        if (semantic.contains(tag)) {
            let e = semantic[tag]
            if (e.level == Level.Error && paths.size > 1) {
                errors.append("错误: ${tag}(${e.meaning}) 出现 ${paths.size} 次")
            }
        } else {
            warnings.append("未定义标签: ${tag} 出现 ${paths.size} 次")
        }
    }
}

main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n# semantic: convention=公约数,error; female=女性标记,warn; outer=外层标记,warn"
    let prog = parseProgramV2(src)
    applyTags(prog.tree, [], prog.labels)

    let tagged = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(prog.tree, [], tagged)

    let errors = ArrayList<String>()
    let warnings = ArrayList<String>()
    checkSemantic(tagged, prog.semantic, errors, warnings)

    for (e in errors) { println(e) }
    for (w in warnings) { println("警告: ${w}") }
}
```

```
源串三段：表达式 @ 标签 # semantic: 语义表
语义表每条带级别：error / warn
检查规则：
  - 表外标签 → warn（不论出现几次）
  - 表内 error 级且出现 >1 次 → error
  - 表内 warn 级 → 静默（只记录，不报）
```

### 1. Nim：阈值 + JSON 输出

```nim
import std/[strutils, tables, sets, json]

type
  Level = enum lvError, lvWarn
  SemanticEntry = object
    meaning: string
    level: Level
    maxCount: int      # 阈值
  SemanticTable = Table[string, SemanticEntry]

proc parseLevel(s: string): Level =
  case s.strip.toLowerAscii
  of "error": lvError
  of "warn": lvWarn
  else: raise newException(ValueError, "未知级别: " & s)

proc parseSemanticTable(src: string): SemanticTable =
  result = initTable[string, SemanticEntry]()
  if src.strip.len == 0: return
  for item in src.split(';'):
    let t = item.strip
    if t.len == 0: continue
    let eq = t.find('=')
    if eq < 0: raise newException(ValueError, "语义项应为 名=含义,级别[,阈值]")
    let name = t[0 ..< eq].strip
    let parts = t[eq + 1 .. ^1].split(',')
    if parts.len < 2: raise newException(ValueError, "语义项缺级别")
    let level = parseLevel(parts[1])
    let maxCount = if parts.len >= 3: parseInt(parts[2].strip) else: 1
    result[name] = SemanticEntry(
      meaning: parts[0].strip,
      level: level,
      maxCount: maxCount
    )

proc checkSemantic(
  tagged: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]],
  semantic: SemanticTable
): tuple[errors, warnings: seq[JsonNode]] =
  var defined = initHashSet[string]()
  for k in semantic.keys: defined.incl k

  for tag, paths in tagged:
    if tag notin defined:
      result.warnings.add %*{
        "tag": tag, "kind": "unknown",
        "count": paths.len, "paths": paths
      }
    else:
      let e = semantic[tag]
      if paths.len > e.maxCount:
        let rec = %*{
          "tag": tag, "meaning": e.meaning,
          "count": paths.len, "max": e.maxCount,
          "paths": paths
        }
        if e.level == lvError: result.errors.add rec
        else: result.warnings.add rec

let prog = parseProgramV2(
  "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n" &
  "# semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99; outer=外层标记,warn"
)
applyTags(prog.tree, @[], prog.labels)
let tagged = collectTags(prog.tree)
let (errs, warns) = checkSemantic(tagged, prog.semantic)

let out = %*{"errors": errs, "warnings": warns}
echo out.pretty
```

```json
  ],
  "warnings": [

      "tag": "stranger",

      "count": 1,
      "paths": [[1, 1]]

}
```

### 2. Zig：阈值 + JSON 输出

```zig
const Level = enum { error_level, warn_level };
const SemanticEntry = struct {
    meaning: []const u8,
    level: Level,
    max_count: usize = 1,
};

fn parseSemanticTable(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    src: []const u8,
) !std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry) {
    var out = std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry).init(alloc);
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, src, ';');
    while (it.next()) |item| {
        const t = std.mem.trim(u8, item, " \t\r\n");
        if (t.len == 0) continue;
        const eq = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, t, '=') orelse return error.BadEntry;
        const name = std.mem.trim(u8, t[0..eq], " \t");
        const rest = t[eq + 1 ..];

        var parts = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, rest, ',');
        const meaning = std.mem.trim(u8, parts.next() orelse return error.BadEntry, " \t");
        const level_str = std.mem.trim(u8, parts.next() orelse return error.BadEntry, " \t");
        const max_str = parts.next();
        const level = try parseLevel(level_str);
        const max_count = if (max_str) |m|
            try std.fmt.parseInt(usize, std.mem.trim(u8, m, " \t"), 10)
        else
            1;

        try out.put(
            try alloc.dupe(u8, name),
            .{ .meaning = try alloc.dupe(u8, meaning),
               .level = level, .max_count = max_count },
        );
    }
    return out;
}

const Issue = struct {
    tag: []const u8,
    meaning: []const u8,
    count: usize,
    max_count: usize,
    paths: []const []const usize,
};

fn checkSemantic(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    tagged: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)),
    semantic: *std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry),
    errors: *std.ArrayList(Issue),
    warnings: *std.ArrayList(Issue),
) !void {
    var it = tagged.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |entry| {
        const tag = entry.key_ptr.*;
        const paths = entry.value_ptr.items;
        if (semantic.get(tag)) |e| {
            if (paths.len > e.max_count) {
                const issue = Issue{
                    .tag = tag, .meaning = e.meaning,
                    .count = paths.len, .max_count = e.max_count,
                    .paths = paths,
                };
                switch (e.level) {
                    .error_level => try errors.append(issue),
                    .warn_level  => try warnings.append(issue),
                }
            }
        } else {
            try warnings.append(.{
                .tag = tag, .meaning = "未定义",
                .count = paths.len, .max_count = 0, .paths = paths,
            });
        }
    }
}

fn writeIssuesJson(w: anytype, issues: []const Issue) !void {
    try w.writeAll("[");
    for (issues, 0..) |it, i| {
        if (i > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
        try w.print("{{\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"meaning\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d},\"max\":{d},\"paths\":[",
            .{ it.tag, it.meaning, it.count, it.max_count });
        for (it.paths, 0..) |p, j| {
            if (j > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
            try w.writeAll("[");
            for (p, 0..) |x, k| {
                if (k > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
                try w.print("{d}", .{x});
            }
            try w.writeAll("]");
        }
        try w.writeAll("]}");
    }
    try w.writeAll("]");
}

// 主流程
var errors = std.ArrayList(Issue).init(alloc);
var warnings = std.ArrayList(Issue).init(alloc);
try checkSemantic(alloc, &tagged, &prog.semantic, &errors, &warnings);

const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
try stdout.writeAll("{\"errors\":");
try writeIssuesJson(stdout, errors.items);
try stdout.writeAll(",\"warnings\":");
try writeIssuesJson(stdout, warnings.items);
try stdout.writeAll("}\n");
```

### 3. Rust：阈值 + JSON 输出

```rust
use std::collections::HashMap;
use serde::Serialize;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Level { Error, Warn }

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct SemanticEntry {
    meaning: String,
    level: Level,
    max_count: usize,
}

fn parse_semantic_table(src: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>, String> {
    let mut out = HashMap::new();
    for item in src.split(';') {
        let t = item.trim();
        if t.is_empty() { continue; }
        let (name, rest) = t.split_once('=')
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("语义项应为 名=含义,级别[,阈值] -> {}", t))?;
        let parts: Vec<&str> = rest.split(',').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
        if parts.len() < 2 { return Err(format!("语义项缺级别 -> {}", t)); }
        let level = parse_level(parts[1])?;
        let max_count = if parts.len() >= 3 {
            parts[2].parse::<usize>().map_err(|_| format!("非法阈值: {}", parts[2]))?
        } else { 1 };
        out.insert(
            name.trim().to_string(),
            SemanticEntry {
                meaning: parts[0].to_string(),
                level,
                max_count,
            },
        );
    }
    Ok(out)
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct Issue {
    tag: String,
    meaning: String,
    count: usize,
    max: usize,
    paths: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
}

fn check_semantic(
    tagged: &HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
    semantic: &HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
) -> (Vec<Issue>, Vec<Issue>) {
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    let mut warnings = Vec::new();
    for (tag, paths) in tagged {
        match semantic.get(tag) {
            Some(e) => {
                if paths.len() > e.max_count {
                    let issue = Issue {
                        tag: tag.clone(),
                        meaning: e.meaning.clone(),
                        count: paths.len(),
                        max: e.max_count,
                        paths: paths.clone(),
                    };
                    if e.level == Level::Error { errors.push(issue); }
                    else { warnings.push(issue); }
                }
            }
            None => {
                warnings.push(Issue {
                    tag: tag.clone(),
                    meaning: "未定义".into(),
                    count: paths.len(),
                    max: 0,
                    paths: paths.clone(),
                });
            }
        }
    }
    (errors, warnings)
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct Output {
    errors: Vec<Issue>,
    warnings: Vec<Issue>,
}

fn main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n\
               # semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99; outer=外层标记,warn";
    let mut prog = parse_program_v2(src).unwrap();
    apply_tags(&mut prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &prog.labels);

    let mut tagged: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut tagged);

    let (errors, warnings) = check_semantic(&tagged, &prog.semantic);
    let out = Output { errors, warnings };
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap());
}
```

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

enum Level { | Error | Warn }

class SemanticEntry {
    let meaning: String
    let level: Level
    let maxCount: Int64
    init(meaning!: String, level!: Level, maxCount!: Int64) {
        this.meaning = meaning
        this.level = level
        this.maxCount = maxCount
    }
}

func parseSemanticTable(src: String): HashMap<String, SemanticEntry> {
    let out = HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>()
    for (item in src.split(";")) {
        let t = item.trimAscii()
        if (t.size == 0) { continue }
        let eq = t.indexOf("=")
        if (eq < 0) { throw Exception("语义项应为 名=含义,级别[,阈值]") }
        let name = t[0..eq].trimAscii()
        let parts = t[eq+1..].split(",")
        if (parts.size < 2) { throw Exception("语义项缺级别") }
        let meaning = parts[0].trimAscii()
        let level = parseLevel(parts[1].trimAscii())
        let maxCount = if (parts.size >= 3) { Int64.parse(parts[2].trimAscii()) } else { 1 }
        out[name] = SemanticEntry(meaning: meaning, level: level, maxCount: maxCount)
    }
    return out
}

class Issue {
    let tag: String
    let meaning: String
    let count: Int64
    let maxCount: Int64
    let paths: Array<Array<Int64>>
    init(tag!: String, meaning!: String, count!: Int64,
         maxCount!: Int64, paths!: Array<Array<Int64>>) {
        this.tag = tag
        this.meaning = meaning
        this.count = count
        this.maxCount = maxCount
        this.paths = paths
    }
}

func checkSemantic(tagged: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>,
                    semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
                    errors: ArrayList<Issue>,
                    warnings: ArrayList<Issue>): Unit {
    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        let p = paths.toArray()
        if (semantic.contains(tag)) {
            let e = semantic[tag]
            if (paths.size > e.maxCount) {
                let issue = Issue(tag: tag, meaning: e.meaning,
                                  count: paths.size, maxCount: e.maxCount, paths: p)
                if (e.level == Level.Error) { errors.append(issue) }
                else { warnings.append(issue) }
            }
        } else {
            warnings.append(Issue(tag: tag, meaning: "未定义",
                                  count: paths.size, maxCount: 0, paths: p))
        }
    }
}

func issuesToJson(issues: ArrayList<Issue>): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("[")
    for (i in 0..issues.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        let it = issues[i]
        sb.append("{\"tag\":\"${it.tag}\",\"meaning\":\"${it.meaning}\",")
        sb.append("\"count\":${it.count},\"max\":${it.maxCount},\"paths\":[")
        for (j in 0..it.paths.size) {
            if (j > 0) { sb.append(",") }
            sb.append("[")
            for (k in 0..it.paths[j].size) {
                if (k > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("${it.paths[j][k]}")
            }
            sb.append("]")
        }
        sb.append("]}")
    }
    sb.append("]")
    return sb.toString()
}

main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n# semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99; outer=外层标记,warn"
    let prog = parseProgramV2(src)
    applyTags(prog.tree, [], prog.labels)

    let tagged = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(prog.tree, [], tagged)

    let errors = ArrayList<Issue>()
    let warnings = ArrayList<Issue>()
    checkSemantic(tagged, prog.semantic, errors, warnings)

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"errors\":")
    sb.append(issuesToJson(errors))
    sb.append(",\"warnings\":")
    sb.append(issuesToJson(warnings))
    sb.append("}")
    println(sb.toString())
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
语义表条目：name=meaning,level[,max]
  - max 省略 → 默认 1
  - 出现次数 > max → 触发该 level（error 或 warning）
  - 表外标签 → 永远 warning
输出：{"errors":[...], "warnings":[...]}
每条含 tag、meaning、count、max、paths
```

程序仍然不替你定义：
- 哪个标签是 error、哪个是 warn → 你写 `error`/`warn`；
- 阈值多少 → 你写第三个参数；
- 表外标签怎么办 → 程序固定为 warning，你也可以改代码把它升成 error。

下一步可选：**把 errors/warnings 的触发条件改成“按路径重复检测”**（同一路径出现两次同一标签也算冲突），或**支持 `# ignore: path:tag` 的忽略规则**。你说方向。

统一规则：

```
# ignore: 1.0:female; 1.1:stranger
```

- 被忽略的 `path:tag` 组合，不报 error/warning，但仍出现在统计里。
- 同一路径上同一标签重复出现 → 按该标签的 level 报（error 或 warn）。
- 表外标签仍然 warn，除非被 ignore。

### 1. Nim

```nim
import std/[strutils, tables, sets, json]

type
  Level = enum lvError, lvWarn
  SemanticEntry = object
    meaning: string
    level: Level
    maxCount: int
  SemanticTable = Table[string, SemanticEntry]
  IgnoreSet = HashSet[string]   # "path:tag"

proc parseIgnore(src: string): IgnoreSet =
  result = initHashSet[string]()
  if src.strip.len == 0: return
  for item in src.split(';'):
    let t = item.strip
    if t.len > 0: result.incl t

proc pathKey(path: seq[int], tag: string): string =
  var parts: seq[string]
  for p in path: parts.add $p
  result = parts.join(".") & ":" & tag

proc checkSemanticV2(
  tagged: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]],
  semantic: SemanticTable,
  ignore: IgnoreSet
): tuple[errors, warnings: seq[JsonNode]] =
  var defined = initHashSet[string]()
  for k in semantic.keys: defined.incl k

  for tag, paths in tagged:
    # 按路径去重检测：同一路径同一标签出现多次
    var pathCount = initCountTable[string]()
    for p in paths:
      pathCount.inc pathKey(p, tag)

    for p in paths:
      let key = pathKey(p, tag)
      if key in ignore: continue

      # 重复路径检测
      if pathCount[key] > 1:
        let rec = %*{
          "tag": tag, "kind": "duplicate-path",
          "path": p, "count": pathCount[key]
        }
        if tag in defined and semantic[tag].level == lvError:
          result.errors.add rec
        else:
          result.warnings.add rec
        continue

      if tag notin defined:
        result.warnings.add %*{
          "tag": tag, "kind": "unknown", "path": p
        }
      else:
        let e = semantic[tag]
        if paths.len > e.maxCount:
          let rec = %*{
            "tag": tag, "meaning": e.meaning,
            "count": paths.len, "max": e.maxCount, "path": p
          }
          if e.level == lvError: result.errors.add rec
          else: result.warnings.add rec

let prog = parseProgramV2(
  "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n" &
  "# semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99\n" &
  "# ignore: 1.1:stranger"
)
applyTags(prog.tree, @[], prog.labels)

var ignore = initHashSet[string]()
let semBody = ""  # 你的 parseProgramV2 需把 # ignore 部分也解析出来
# 这里简化：直接调用
ignore = parseIgnore("1.1:stranger")

let tagged = collectTags(prog.tree)
let (errs, warns) = checkSemanticV2(tagged, prog.semantic, ignore)
echo %*{"errors": errs, "warnings": warns}.pretty
```

注意：`parseProgramV2` 需要同时解析 `# semantic:` 和 `# ignore:` 两段；把 `#` 后面按行切，逐行判断前缀。
