### 2. Zig

```zig
const IgnoreSet = std.StringHashMap(void);

fn pathKey(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, path: []const usize, tag: []const u8) ![]u8 {
    var buf = std.ArrayList(u8).init(alloc);
    for (path, 0..) |p, i| {
        if (i > 0) try buf.append('.');
        try buf.writer().print("{d}", .{p});
    }
    try buf.append(':');
    try buf.appendSlice(tag);
    return buf.toOwnedSlice();
}

fn parseIgnore(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !IgnoreSet {
    var out = IgnoreSet.init(alloc);
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, src, ';');
    while (it.next()) |item| {
        const t = std.mem.trim(u8, item, " \t\r\n");
        if (t.len > 0) try out.put(try alloc.dupe(u8, t), {});
    }
    return out;
}

const IssueV2 = struct {
    tag: []const u8,
    kind: []const u8,   // "duplicate-path" / "unknown" / "max-exceeded"
    meaning: []const u8,
    count: usize,
    max_count: usize,
    paths: []const []const usize,
};

fn checkSemanticV2(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    tagged: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)),
    semantic: *std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry),
    ignore: *IgnoreSet,
    errors: *std.ArrayList(IssueV2),
    warnings: *std.ArrayList(IssueV2),
) !void {
    var it = tagged.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |entry| {
        const tag = entry.key_ptr.*;
        const paths = entry.value_ptr.items;

        // 路径去重
        var path_seen = std.StringHashMap(usize).init(alloc);
        for (paths) |p| {
            const key = try pathKey(alloc, p, tag);
            const gop = try path_seen.getOrPut(key);
            if (gop.found_existing) gop.value_ptr.* += 1
            else gop.value_ptr.* = 1;
        }

        for (paths) |p| {
            const key = try pathKey(alloc, p, tag);
            if (ignore.contains(key)) continue;

            if (path_seen.get(key)) |c| {
                if (c > 1) {
                    const issue = IssueV2{
                        .tag = tag, .kind = "duplicate-path",
                        .meaning = "", .count = c,
                        .max_count = 0, .paths = &.{p},
                    };
                    const is_error = if (semantic.get(tag)) |e| e.level == .error_level else false;
                    if (is_error) try errors.append(issue)
                    else try warnings.append(issue);
                    continue;
                }
            }

            if (semantic.get(tag)) |e| {
                if (paths.len > e.max_count) {
                    const issue = IssueV2{
                        .tag = tag, .kind = "max-exceeded",
                        .meaning = e.meaning, .count = paths.len,
                        .max_count = e.max_count, .paths = &.{p},
                    };
                    if (e.level == .error_level) try errors.append(issue)
                    else try warnings.append(issue);
                }
            } else {
                try warnings.append(.{
                    .tag = tag, .kind = "unknown", .meaning = "未定义",
                    .count = paths.len, .max_count = 0, .paths = &.{p},
                });
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 3. Rust

```rust
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

type IgnoreSet = HashSet<String>;

fn path_key(path: &[usize], tag: &str) -> String {
    let p: Vec<String> = path.iter().map(|x| x.to_string()).collect();
    format!("{}:{}", p.join("."), tag)
}

fn parse_ignore(src: &str) -> IgnoreSet {
    let mut out = HashSet::new();
    for item in src.split(';') {
        let t = item.trim();
        if !t.is_empty() { out.insert(t.to_string()); }
    }
    out
}

#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]
struct IssueV2 {
    tag: String,
    kind: String,       // duplicate-path / unknown / max-exceeded
    meaning: String,
    count: usize,
    max: usize,
    paths: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
}

fn check_semantic_v2(
    tagged: &HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
    semantic: &HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
    ignore: &IgnoreSet,
) -> (Vec<IssueV2>, Vec<IssueV2>) {
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    let mut warnings = Vec::new();

    for (tag, paths) in tagged {
        // 路径去重
        let mut path_count: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for p in paths {
            *path_count.entry(path_key(p, tag)).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }

        for p in paths {
            let key = path_key(p, tag);
            if ignore.contains(&key) { continue; }

            if let Some(&c) = path_count.get(&key) {
                if c > 1 {
                    let issue = IssueV2 {
                        tag: tag.clone(), kind: "duplicate-path".into(),
                        meaning: String::new(), count: c,
                        max: 0, paths: vec![p.clone()],
                    };
                    let is_error = semantic.get(tag)
                        .map(|e| e.level == Level::Error).unwrap_or(false);
                    if is_error { errors.push(issue); } else { warnings.push(issue); }
                    continue;
                }
            }

            match semantic.get(tag) {
                Some(e) if paths.len() > e.max_count => {
                    let issue = IssueV2 {
                        tag: tag.clone(), kind: "max-exceeded".into(),
                        meaning: e.meaning.clone(), count: paths.len(),
                        max: e.max_count, paths: vec![p.clone()],
                    };
                    if e.level == Level::Error { errors.push(issue); }
                    else { warnings.push(issue); }
                }
                None => warnings.push(IssueV2 {
                    tag: tag.clone(), kind: "unknown".into(),
                    meaning: "未定义".into(), count: paths.len(),
                    max: 0, paths: vec![p.clone()],
                }),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }
    (errors, warnings)
}
```

`parse_program_v2` 按行切 `#`，识别 `semantic:`、`ignore:` 两个前缀，填进结构体。

### 4. 仓颉

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

type IgnoreSet = HashSet<String>

func pathKey(path: Array<Int64>, tag: String): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    for (i in 0..path.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(".") }
        sb.append("${path[i]}")
    }
    sb.append(":${tag}")
    return sb.toString()
}

func parseIgnore(src: String): IgnoreSet {
    let out = HashSet<String>()
    for (item in src.split(";")) {
        let t = item.trimAscii()
        if (t.size > 0) { out.add(t) }
    }
    return out
}

class IssueV2 {
    let tag: String
    let kind: String
    let meaning: String
    let count: Int64
    let maxCount: Int64
    let paths: Array<Array<Int64>>
    init(tag!: String, kind!: String, meaning!: String,
         count!: Int64, maxCount!: Int64, paths!: Array<Array<Int64>>) {
        this.tag = tag; this.kind = kind; this.meaning = meaning
        this.count = count; this.maxCount = maxCount; this.paths = paths
    }
}

func checkSemanticV2(tagged: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>,
                    semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
                    ignore: IgnoreSet,
                    errors: ArrayList<IssueV2>,
                    warnings: ArrayList<IssueV2>): Unit {
    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        let pathCount = HashMap<String, Int64>()
        for (p in paths) {
            let key = pathKey(p, tag)
            pathCount[key] = (if (pathCount.contains(key)) { pathCount[key] } else { 0 }) + 1
        }

        for (p in paths) {
            let key = pathKey(p, tag)
            if (ignore.contains(key)) { continue }

            if (pathCount.contains(key) && pathCount[key] > 1) {
                let isError = if (semantic.contains(tag)) { semantic[tag].level == Level.Error } else { false }
                let issue = IssueV2(tag: tag, kind: "duplicate-path",
                                    meaning: "", count: pathCount[key],
                                    maxCount: 0, paths: [p])
                if (isError) { errors.append(issue) } else { warnings.append(issue) }
                continue
            }

            if (semantic.contains(tag)) {
                let e = semantic[tag]
                if (paths.size > e.maxCount) {
                    let issue = IssueV2(tag: tag, kind: "max-exceeded",
                                        meaning: e.meaning, count: paths.size,
                                        maxCount: e.maxCount, paths: [p])
                    if (e.level == Level.Error) { errors.append(issue) }
                    else { warnings.append(issue) }
                }
            } else {
                warnings.append(IssueV2(tag: tag, kind: "unknown",
                                        meaning: "未定义", count: paths.size,
                                        maxCount: 0, paths: [p]))
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
规则1：同一路径同一标签出现 >1 次 → duplicate-path
       按该标签的 level 报 error 或 warn（表外标签按 warn）
规则2：# ignore: path:tag 列表 → 跳过该组合
       path 用 . 分隔，tag 用 : 分隔；多个用 ; 分隔
输出：每条 issue 带 kind（duplicate-path / max-exceeded / unknown）
```

统一 ignore 语法：

- `*:tag`：忽略所有路径上的该标签  
- `path.*`：忽略该路径上所有标签  
- `*:*`：忽略全部  
- 精确 `path:tag` 仍然有效

### 1. Nim：通配符 + 分组输出

```nim
import std/[strutils, tables, sets, json]

type
  IgnoreSet = object
    exact: HashSet[string]
    wildTag: HashSet[string]      # *:tag
    wildPath: HashSet[string]     # path.*
    wildAll: bool

proc parseIgnoreV2(src: string): IgnoreSet =
  result.exact = initHashSet[string]()
  result.wildTag = initHashSet[string]()
  result.wildPath = initHashSet[string]()
  if src.strip.len == 0: return
  for item in src.split(';'):
    let t = item.strip
    if t.len == 0: continue
    let parts = t.split(':')
    if parts.len != 2: raise newException(ValueError, "ignore 格式错误: " & t)
    let p = parts[0].strip
    let tag = parts[1].strip
    if p == "*" and tag == "*":
      result.wildAll = true
    elif p == "*":
      result.wildTag.incl tag
    elif tag == "*":
      result.wildPath.incl p
    else:
      result.exact.incl (p & ":" & tag)

proc isIgnored(ig: IgnoreSet, path: seq[int], tag: string): bool =
  if ig.wildAll: return true
  var p: seq[string]
  for x in path: p.add $x
  let key = p.join(".") & ":" & tag
  if key in ig.exact: return true
  if tag in ig.wildTag: return true
  if p.join(".") in ig.wildPath: return true
  false

proc checkSemanticV3(
  tagged: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]],
  semantic: SemanticTable,
  ignore: IgnoreSet
): JsonNode =
  var byKind = initOrderedTable[string, seq[JsonNode]]()
  var defined = initHashSet[string]()
  for k in semantic.keys: defined.incl k

  for tag, paths in tagged:
    var pathCount = initCountTable[string]()
    for p in paths:
      var ps: seq[string]
      for x in p: ps.add $x
      pathCount.inc ps.join(".")

    for p in paths:
      if isIgnored(ignore, p, tag): continue

      var ps: seq[string]
      for x in p: ps.add $x
      let pathStr = ps.join(".")
      let dup = pathCount[pathStr] > 1

      if dup:
        let rec = %*{"tag": tag, "path": p, "count": pathCount[pathStr]}
        byKind.mgetOrPut("duplicate-path", @[]).add rec
        continue

      if tag notin defined:
        byKind.mgetOrPut("unknown", @[]).add %*{"tag": tag, "path": p}
        continue

      let e = semantic[tag]
      if paths.len > e.maxCount:
        let rec = %*{
          "tag": tag, "meaning": e.meaning,
          "count": paths.len, "max": e.maxCount, "path": p
        }
        let bucket = if e.level == lvError: "error" else: "warn"
        byKind.mgetOrPut(bucket, @[]).add rec

  result = newJObject()
  for k, v in byKind:
    result[k] = %*v

# 主流程
let prog = parseProgramV2(
  "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n" &
  "# semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99\n" &
  "# ignore: 1.*:stranger; *:female"
)
applyTags(prog.tree, @[], prog.labels)
let ignore = parseIgnoreV2("1.*:stranger; *:female")

let tagged = collectTags(prog.tree)
echo checkSemanticV3(tagged, prog.semantic, ignore).pretty
```

```json
    {"tag": "convention", "meaning": "公约数", "count": 2, "max": 1, "path": [2]}
  ]
}
```

### 2. Zig：通配符 + 分组输出

```zig
const IgnoreSet = struct {
    exact: std.StringHashMap(void),
    wild_tag: std.StringHashMap(void),
    wild_path: std.StringHashMap(void),
    wild_all: bool = false,
};

fn parseIgnoreV2(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !IgnoreSet {
    var out = IgnoreSet{
        .exact = std.StringHashMap(void).init(alloc),
        .wild_tag = std.StringHashMap(void).init(alloc),
        .wild_path = std.StringHashMap(void).init(alloc),
    };
    var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, src, ';');
    while (it.next()) |item| {
        const t = std.mem.trim(u8, item, " \t\r\n");
        if (t.len == 0) continue;
        const colon = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, t, ':') orelse return error.BadIgnore;
        const p = std.mem.trim(u8, t[0..colon], " \t");
        const tag = std.mem.trim(u8, t[colon + 1 ..], " \t");
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, p, "*") and std.mem.eql(u8, tag, "*")) {
            out.wild_all = true;
        } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, p, "*")) {
            try out.wild_tag.put(try alloc.dupe(u8, tag), {});
        } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, tag, "*")) {
            try out.wild_path.put(try alloc.dupe(u8, p), {});
        } else {
            const key = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc, "{s}:{s}", .{ p, tag });
            try out.exact.put(key, {});
        }
    }
    return out;
}

fn isIgnored(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, ig: IgnoreSet, path: []const usize, tag: []const u8) !bool {
    if (ig.wild_all) return true;
    var buf = std.ArrayList(u8).init(alloc);
    for (path, 0..) |p, i| {
        if (i > 0) try buf.append('.');
        try buf.writer().print("{d}", .{p});
    }
    const path_str = buf.items;
    if (ig.wild_tag.contains(tag)) return true;
    if (ig.wild_path.contains(path_str)) return true;
    const key = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc, "{s}:{s}", .{ path_str, tag });
    return ig.exact.contains(key);
}

// 分组输出：用 StringHashMap(ArrayList) 按 kind 收集
fn emitGrouped(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    issues: []const IssueV2,
) !void {
    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.writeAll("{");
    // 简化：按 kind 字符串排序后输出
    var kinds = std.StringHashMap(void).init(alloc);
    for (issues) |it| try kinds.put(it.kind, {});
    var first_kind = true;
    var kit = kinds.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |kentry| {
        if (!first_kind) try stdout.writeAll(",");
        first_kind = false;
        try stdout.print("\"{s}\":[", .{kentry.key_ptr.*});
        var first = true;
        for (issues) |it| {
            if (!std.mem.eql(u8, it.kind, kentry.key_ptr.*)) continue;
            if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            first = false;
            try stdout.print("{{\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d}}}",
                .{ it.tag, it.count });
        }
        try stdout.writeAll("]");
    }
    try stdout.writeAll("}\n");
}
```

Zig 版把 `checkSemanticV2` 里每个 `continue` 前换成 `if (try isIgnored(...)) continue;`，并把 issue 收集到按 kind 分组的列表里。

### 3. Rust：通配符 + 分组输出

```rust
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct IgnoreSet {
    exact: HashSet<String>,
    wild_tag: HashSet<String>,
    wild_path: HashSet<String>,
    wild_all: bool,
}

fn parse_ignore_v2(src: &str) -> Result<IgnoreSet, String> {
    let mut out = IgnoreSet::default();
    for item in src.split(';') {
        let t = item.trim();
        if t.is_empty() { continue; }
        let (p, tag) = t.split_once(':')
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("ignore 格式错误: {}", t))?;
        let p = p.trim(); let tag = tag.trim();
        match (p, tag) {
            ("*", "*") => out.wild_all = true,
            ("*", _) => { out.wild_tag.insert(tag.to_string()); }
            (_, "*") => { out.wild_path.insert(p.to_string()); }
            _ => { out.exact.insert(format!("{}:{}", p, tag)); }
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn is_ignored(ig: &IgnoreSet, path: &[usize], tag: &str) -> bool {
    if ig.wild_all { return true; }
    let path_str = path.iter().map(|x| x.to_string())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>().join(".");
    if ig.wild_tag.contains(tag) { return true; }
    if ig.wild_path.contains(&path_str) { return true; }
    ig.exact.contains(&format!("{}:{}", path_str, tag))
}

#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]
struct IssueV3 {
    tag: String,
    meaning: Option<String>,
    count: usize,
    max: Option<usize>,
    path: Vec<usize>,
}

fn check_semantic_v3(
    tagged: &HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
    semantic: &HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
    ignore: &IgnoreSet,
) -> HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV3>> {
    let mut by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV3>> = HashMap::new();

    for (tag, paths) in tagged {
        let mut path_count: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for p in paths {
            let key = p.iter().map(|x| x.to_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join(".");
            *path_count.entry(key).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }

        for p in paths {
            if is_ignored(ignore, p, tag) { continue; }

            let key = p.iter().map(|x| x.to_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join(".");
            let dup = path_count[&key] > 1;

            if dup {
                by_kind.entry("duplicate-path".into()).or_default().push(IssueV3 {
                    tag: tag.clone(), meaning: None,
                    count: path_count[&key], max: None, path: p.clone(),
                });
                continue;
            }

            match semantic.get(tag) {
                None => {
                    by_kind.entry("unknown".into()).or_default().push(IssueV3 {
                        tag: tag.clone(), meaning: None,
                        count: paths.len(), max: None, path: p.clone(),
                    });
                }
                Some(e) if paths.len() > e.max_count => {
                    let bucket = if e.level == Level::Error { "error" } else { "warn" };
                    by_kind.entry(bucket.into()).or_default().push(IssueV3 {
                        tag: tag.clone(), meaning: Some(e.meaning.clone()),
                        count: paths.len(), max: Some(e.max_count),
                        path: p.clone(),
                    });
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }
    by_kind
}

fn main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n\
               # semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99\n\
               # ignore: 1.*:stranger; *:female";
    let mut prog = parse_program_v2(src).unwrap();
    apply_tags(&mut prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &prog.labels);

    let mut tagged: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    collect_tags(&prog.tree, &mut Vec::new(), &mut tagged);

    let ignore = parse_ignore_v2("1.*:stranger; *:female").unwrap();
    let grouped = check_semantic_v3(&tagged, &prog.semantic, &ignore);
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&grouped).unwrap());
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：通配符 + 分组输出

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

class IgnoreSet {
    let exact: HashSet<String>
    let wildTag: HashSet<String>
    let wildPath: HashSet<String>
    var wildAll: Bool = false
    init() {
        exact = HashSet<String>()
        wildTag = HashSet<String>()
        wildPath = HashSet<String>()
    }
}

func parseIgnoreV2(src: String): IgnoreSet {
    let out = IgnoreSet()
    for (item in src.split(";")) {
        let t = item.trimAscii()
        if (t.size == 0) { continue }
        let idx = t.indexOf(":")
        if (idx < 0) { throw Exception("ignore 格式错误: ${t}") }
        let p = t[0..idx].trimAscii()
        let tag = t[idx+1..].trimAscii()
        if (p == "*" && tag == "*") {
            out.wildAll = true
        } else if (p == "*") {
            out.wildTag.add(tag)
        } else if (tag == "*") {
            out.wildPath.add(p)
        } else {
            out.exact.add("${p}:${tag}")
        }
    }
    return out
}

func isIgnored(ig: IgnoreSet, path: Array<Int64>, tag: String): Bool {
    if (ig.wildAll) { return true }
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    for (i in 0..path.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(".") }
        sb.append("${path[i]}")
    }
    let pathStr = sb.toString()
    if (ig.wildTag.contains(tag)) { return true }
    if (ig.wildPath.contains(pathStr)) { return true }
    return ig.exact.contains("${pathStr}:${tag}")
}

func checkSemanticV3(tagged: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>,
                    semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
                    ignore: IgnoreSet): HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV2>> {
    let byKind = HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV2>>()

    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        let pathCount = HashMap<String, Int64>()
        for (p in paths) {
            let sb = StringBuilder()
            for (i in 0..p.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(".") }
                sb.append("${p[i]}")
            }
            let key = sb.toString()
            pathCount[key] = (if (pathCount.contains(key)) { pathCount[key] } else { 0 }) + 1
        }

        for (p in paths) {
            if (isIgnored(ignore, p, tag)) { continue }

            let sb = StringBuilder()
            for (i in 0..p.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(".") }
                sb.append("${p[i]}")
            }
            let key = sb.toString()
            let dup = pathCount.contains(key) && pathCount[key] > 1

            if (dup) {
                if (!byKind.contains("duplicate-path")) {
                    byKind["duplicate-path"] = ArrayList<IssueV2>()
                }
                byKind["duplicate-path"].append(
                    IssueV2(tag: tag, kind: "duplicate-path", meaning: "",
                            count: pathCount[key], maxCount: 0, paths: [p]))
                continue
            }

            if (!semantic.contains(tag)) {
                if (!byKind.contains("unknown")) {
                    byKind["unknown"] = ArrayList<IssueV2>()
                }
                byKind["unknown"].append(
                    IssueV2(tag: tag, kind: "unknown", meaning: "未定义",
                            count: paths.size, maxCount: 0, paths: [p]))
                continue
            }

            let e = semantic[tag]
            if (paths.size > e.maxCount) {
                let bucket = if (e.level == Level.Error) { "error" } else { "warn" }
                if (!byKind.contains(bucket)) {
                    byKind[bucket] = ArrayList<IssueV2>()
                }
                byKind[bucket].append(
                    IssueV2(tag: tag, kind: bucket, meaning: e.meaning,
                            count: paths.size, maxCount: e.maxCount, paths: [p]))
            }
        }
    }
    return byKind
}

main() {
    let src = "(0<(0<(1)>0)>0) @ 0:convention;2:convention;1.0:female;1.1:stranger\n# semantic: convention=公约数,error,1; female=女性标记,warn,99\n# ignore: 1.*:stranger; *:female"
    let prog = parseProgramV2(src)
    applyTags(prog.tree, [], prog.labels)

    let tagged = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    collectTags(prog.tree, [], tagged)

    let ignore = parseIgnoreV2("1.*:stranger; *:female")
    let grouped = checkSemanticV3(tagged, prog.semantic, ignore)

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{")
    var firstKind = true
    for ((kind, issues) in grouped) {
        if (!firstKind) { sb.append(",") }
        firstKind = false
        sb.append("\"${kind}\":[")
        for (i in 0..issues.size) {
            if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
            sb.append("{\"tag\":\"${issues[i].tag}\",\"count\":${issues[i].count}}")
        }
        sb.append("]")
    }
    sb.append("}")
    println(sb.toString())
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
1. ignore 支持通配：
   *:tag    → 忽略所有路径上的该 tag
   path.*   → 忽略该路径上所有 tag
   *:*      → 忽略全部
   精确 path:tag 仍然有效

2. 输出按 kind 分组：
   error / warn / unknown / duplicate-path
   每组下面列具体记录
```

程序仍然不替你定：
- 哪个 tag 是 error/warn → 你写 `# semantic:`；
- 哪些组合忽略 → 你写 `# ignore:`，通配还是精确由你选；
- 分组名 → 固定四类，你也可以改代码加新类。

下一步可选：**把 `# semantic:` / `# ignore:` 改成行内 YAML/JSON 块**，或**加一条“忽略但计数”的规则**（被 ignore 的记录单独进 `ignored` 组，不丢统计）。你说方向。

继续。这一轮补 **“忽略但计数”**：被 `# ignore:` 命中的记录不再直接消失，而是进 `ignored` 组，保留原始 `kind` 和路径。这样你能看到“什么被忽略了、原本会触发什么”，不丢统计。

规则：

```
# ignore: 1.*:stranger; *:female
→ 命中的记录进 "ignored" 组，kind 保留原类别（error/warn/unknown/duplicate-path）
→ 未命中的照旧进 error / warn / unknown / duplicate-path
```

### 1. Nim：ignored 组保留原 kind

```nim
import std/[strutils, tables, sets, json]

proc checkSemanticV4(
  tagged: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]],
  semantic: SemanticTable,
  ignore: IgnoreSet
): JsonNode =
  var byKind = initOrderedTable[string, seq[JsonNode]]()
  var defined = initHashSet[string]()
  for k in semantic.keys: defined.incl k

  for tag, paths in tagged:
    var pathCount = initCountTable[string]()
    for p in paths:
      var ps: seq[string]
      for x in p: ps.add $x
      pathCount.inc ps.join(".")

    for p in paths:
      var ps: seq[string]
      for x in p: ps.add $x
      let pathStr = ps.join(".")
      let dup = pathCount[pathStr] > 1
      let ignored = isIgnored(ignore, p, tag)

      var kind: string
      var rec: JsonNode

      if dup:
        kind = "duplicate-path"
        rec = %*{"tag": tag, "path": p, "count": pathCount[pathStr]}
      elif tag notin defined:
        kind = "unknown"
        rec = %*{"tag": tag, "path": p}
      else:
        let e = semantic[tag]
        if paths.len > e.maxCount:
          kind = if e.level == lvError: "error" else: "warn"
          rec = %*{
            "tag": tag, "meaning": e.meaning,
            "count": paths.len, "max": e.maxCount, "path": p
          }
        else:
          continue

      if ignored:
        rec["original_kind"] = %kind
        byKind.mgetOrPut("ignored", @[]).add rec
      else:
        byKind.mgetOrPut(kind, @[]).add rec

  result = newJObject()
  for k, v in byKind:
    result[k] = %*v
```

### 2. Zig：ignored 组保留原 kind

```zig
const IssueV4 = struct {
    tag: []const u8,
    kind: []const u8,
    original_kind: ?[]const u8 = null,
    meaning: []const u8 = "",
    count: usize,
    max_count: usize = 0,
    paths: []const []const usize,
};

fn checkSemanticV4(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    tagged: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)),
    semantic: *std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry),
    ignore: IgnoreSet,
    errors: *std.ArrayList(IssueV4),
    warnings: *std.ArrayList(IssueV4),
    unknown: *std.ArrayList(IssueV4),
    dups: *std.ArrayList(IssueV4),
    ignored: *std.ArrayList(IssueV4),
) !void {
    var it = tagged.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |entry| {
        const tag = entry.key_ptr.*;
        const paths = entry.value_ptr.items;

        var path_seen = std.StringHashMap(usize).init(alloc);
        for (paths) |p| {
            const key = try pathKey(alloc, p, tag);
            const gop = try path_seen.getOrPut(key);
            if (gop.found_existing) gop.value_ptr.* += 1
            else gop.value_ptr.* = 1;
        }

        for (paths) |p| {
            const key = try pathKey(alloc, p, tag);
            const is_ign = try isIgnored(alloc, ignore, p, tag);
            const dup = if (path_seen.get(key)) |c| c > 1 else false;

            var issue: ?IssueV4 = null;
            var kind: []const u8 = "";

            if (dup) {
                kind = "duplicate-path";
                issue = .{
                    .tag = tag, .kind = kind, .count = path_seen.get(key).?,
                    .paths = &.{p},
                };
            } else if (semantic.get(tag)) |e| {
                if (paths.len > e.max_count) {
                    kind = if (e.level == .error_level) "error" else "warn";
                    issue = .{
                        .tag = tag, .kind = kind, .meaning = e.meaning,
                        .count = paths.len, .max_count = e.max_count,
                        .paths = &.{p},
                    };
                }
            } else {
                kind = "unknown";
                issue = .{ .tag = tag, .kind = kind, .count = paths.len, .paths = &.{p} };
            }

            if (issue) |it2| {
                if (is_ign) {
                    var copy = it2;
                    copy.original_kind = it2.kind;
                    copy.kind = "ignored";
                    try ignored.append(copy);
                } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "error")) {
                    try errors.append(it2);
                } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "warn")) {
                    try warnings.append(it2);
                } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "unknown")) {
                    try unknown.append(it2);
                } else {
                    try dups.append(it2);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 3. Rust：ignored 组保留原 kind

```rust
#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]
struct IssueV4 {
    tag: String,
    kind: String,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    original_kind: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    meaning: Option<String>,
    count: usize,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    max: Option<usize>,
    path: Vec<usize>,
}

fn check_semantic_v4(
    tagged: &HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>>,
    semantic: &HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
    ignore: &IgnoreSet,
) -> HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>> {
    let mut by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>> = HashMap::new();

    for (tag, paths) in tagged {
        let mut path_count: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for p in paths {
            let key = p.iter().map(|x| x.to_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join(".");
            *path_count.entry(key).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }

        for p in paths {
            let key = p.iter().map(|x| x.to_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join(".");
            let is_ign = is_ignored(ignore, p, tag);
            let dup = path_count[&key] > 1;

            let (kind, mut issue) = if dup {
                ("duplicate-path".to_string(), IssueV4 {
                    tag: tag.clone(), kind: String::new(),
                    original_kind: None, meaning: None,
                    count: path_count[&key], max: None, path: p.clone(),
                })
            } else if let Some(e) = semantic.get(tag) {
                if paths.len() > e.max_count {
                    let k = if e.level == Level::Error { "error" } else { "warn" };
                    (k.to_string(), IssueV4 {
                        tag: tag.clone(), kind: String::new(),
                        original_kind: None,
                        meaning: Some(e.meaning.clone()),
                        count: paths.len(),
                        max: Some(e.max_count),
                        path: p.clone(),
                    })
                } else { continue; }
            } else {
                ("unknown".to_string(), IssueV4 {
                    tag: tag.clone(), kind: String::new(),
                    original_kind: None, meaning: None,
                    count: paths.len(), max: None, path: p.clone(),
                })
            };

            issue.kind = kind.clone();
            if is_ign {
                issue.original_kind = Some(kind);
                issue.kind = "ignored".into();
                by_kind.entry("ignored".into()).or_default().push(issue);
            } else {
                by_kind.entry(kind).or_default().push(issue);
            }
        }
    }
    by_kind
}
```

输出里 `ignored` 组每条带 `original_kind`，未忽略的照旧。

### 4. 仓颉：ignored 组保留原 kind

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

class IssueV4 {
    let tag: String
    let kind: String
    var originalKind: ?String = None
    let meaning: String
    let count: Int64
    let maxCount: Int64
    let paths: Array<Array<Int64>>
    init(tag!: String, kind!: String, meaning!: String,
         count!: Int64, maxCount!: Int64, paths!: Array<Array<Int64>>) {
        this.tag = tag; this.kind = kind; this.meaning = meaning
        this.count = count; this.maxCount = maxCount; this.paths = paths
    }
}

func checkSemanticV4(tagged: HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>,
                    semantic: HashMap<String, SemanticEntry>,
                    ignore: IgnoreSet): HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>> {
    let byKind = HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>()

    func push(bucket: String, issue: IssueV4): Unit {
        if (!byKind.contains(bucket)) {
            byKind[bucket] = ArrayList<IssueV4>()
        }
        byKind[bucket].append(issue)
    }

    for ((tag, paths) in tagged) {
        let pathCount = HashMap<String, Int64>()
        for (p in paths) {
            let sb = StringBuilder()
            for (i in 0..p.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(".") }
                sb.append("${p[i]}")
            }
            let key = sb.toString()
            pathCount[key] = (if (pathCount.contains(key)) { pathCount[key] } else { 0 }) + 1
        }

        for (p in paths) {
            let sb = StringBuilder()
            for (i in 0..p.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(".") }
                sb.append("${p[i]}")
            }
            let key = sb.toString()
            let isIgn = isIgnored(ignore, p, tag)
            let dup = pathCount.contains(key) && pathCount[key] > 1

            var kind = ""
            var issue: ?IssueV4 = None

            if (dup) {
                kind = "duplicate-path"
                issue = IssueV4(tag: tag, kind: kind, meaning: "",
                                count: pathCount[key], maxCount: 0, paths: [p])
            } else if (semantic.contains(tag)) {
                let e = semantic[tag]
                if (paths.size > e.maxCount) {
                    kind = if (e.level == Level.Error) { "error" } else { "warn" }
                    issue = IssueV4(tag: tag, kind: kind, meaning: e.meaning,
                                    count: paths.size, maxCount: e.maxCount, paths: [p])
                }
            } else {
                kind = "unknown"
                issue = IssueV4(tag: tag, kind: kind, meaning: "未定义",
                                count: paths.size, maxCount: 0, paths: [p])
            }

            if (let Some(it) <- issue) {
                if (isIgn) {
                    it.originalKind = kind
                    push("ignored", it)
                } else {
                    push(kind, it)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return byKind
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
之前：被 ignore 命中 → continue（记录消失）
现在：被 ignore 命中 → 进 "ignored" 组
      该记录保留 kind / original_kind / tag / path / count
      未命中的照旧进 error / warn / unknown / duplicate-path
```

效果：你能同时看到

- **实际会报的**：`error`、`warn`、`unknown`、`duplicate-path`
- **你压下去的**：`ignored`，且知道它原本会是什么类别

程序仍然不替你定：哪些 `path:tag` 忽略 → 你写 `# ignore:`；`ignored` 组怎么展示 → 代码固定，你也可以改成不输出 `ignored`。

下一步可选：**把 `ignored` 组按 `original_kind` 再分子组**，或**加 `# strict:` 模式**（`ignored` 里的 `original_kind` 若是 `error`，仍不允许忽略）。你说方向。

```

```

- `strict` 里列的标签：即使被 `# ignore:` 命中，原本是 `error` 的仍进 `error`，不压进 `ignored`。
- `strict` 里列的标签：原本是 `warn` 的，仍可进 `ignored`。
- 不在 `strict` 里的标签：被 ignore 命中就正常进 `ignored`。
- `ignored` 组内部按 `original_kind` 分子组：`ignored.error`、`ignored.warn`、`ignored.unknown`、`ignored.duplicate-path`。

### 1. Nim

```nim
proc checkSemanticV5(
  tagged: Table[string, seq[seq[int]]],
  semantic: SemanticTable,
  ignore: IgnoreSet,
  strict: HashSet[string]
): JsonNode =
  var byKind = initOrderedTable[string, seq[JsonNode]]()
  var defined = initHashSet[string]()
  for k in semantic.keys: defined.incl k

  for tag, paths in tagged:
    var pathCount = initCountTable[string]()
    for p in paths:
      var ps: seq[string]
      for x in p: ps.add $x
      pathCount.inc ps.join(".")

    for p in paths:
      var ps: seq[string]
      for x in p: ps.add $x
      let pathStr = ps.join(".")
      let dup = pathCount[pathStr] > 1
      let ignored = isIgnored(ignore, p, tag)
      let isStrict = tag in strict

      var kind: string
      var rec: JsonNode

      if dup:
        kind = "duplicate-path"
        rec = %*{"tag": tag, "path": p, "count": pathCount[pathStr]}
      elif tag notin defined:
        kind = "unknown"
        rec = %*{"tag": tag, "path": p}
      else:
        let e = semantic[tag]
        if paths.len > e.maxCount:
          kind = if e.level == lvError: "error" else: "warn"
          rec = %*{
            "tag": tag, "meaning": e.meaning,
            "count": paths.len, "max": e.maxCount, "path": p
          }
        else:
          continue

      if ignored:
        if isStrict and kind == "error":
          # strict：原本 error 的不能被压掉，升回 error
          rec["forced_by_strict"] = %true
          byKind.mgetOrPut("error", @[]).add rec
        else:
          rec["original_kind"] = %kind
          byKind.mgetOrPut("ignored." & kind, @[]).add rec
      else:
        byKind.mgetOrPut(kind, @[]).add rec

  result = newJObject()
  for k, v in byKind:
    result[k] = %*v
```

### 2. Zig

```zig
fn checkSemanticV5(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    tagged: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)),
    semantic: *std.StringHashMap(SemanticEntry),
    ignore: IgnoreSet,
    strict: *std.StringHashMap(void),
    out: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
) !void {
    var it = tagged.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |entry| {
        const tag = entry.key_ptr.*;
        const paths = entry.value_ptr.items;

        var path_seen = std.StringHashMap(usize).init(alloc);
        for (paths) |p| {
            const key = try pathKey(alloc, p, tag);
            const gop = try path_seen.getOrPut(key);
            if (gop.found_existing) gop.value_ptr.* += 1
            else gop.value_ptr.* = 1;
        }

        for (paths) |p| {
            const key = try pathKey(alloc, p, tag);
            const is_ign = try isIgnored(alloc, ignore, p, tag);
            const is_strict = strict.contains(tag);
            const dup = if (path_seen.get(key)) |c| c > 1 else false;

            var issue: ?IssueV4 = null;
            var kind: []const u8 = "";

            if (dup) {
                kind = "duplicate-path";
                issue = .{ .tag = tag, .kind = kind,
                           .count = path_seen.get(key).?, .paths = &.{p} };
            } else if (semantic.get(tag)) |e| {
                if (paths.len > e.max_count) {
                    kind = if (e.level == .error_level) "error" else "warn";
                    issue = .{ .tag = tag, .kind = kind, .meaning = e.meaning,
                               .count = paths.len, .max_count = e.max_count,
                               .paths = &.{p} };
                }
            } else {
                kind = "unknown";
                issue = .{ .tag = tag, .kind = kind, .count = paths.len, .paths = &.{p} };
            }

            if (issue) |it2| {
                var bucket: []const u8 = undefined;
                var copy = it2;
                if (is_ign) {
                    if (is_strict and std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "error")) {
                        // strict：error 不被压掉
                        copy.original_kind = kind;
                        bucket = "error";
                    } else {
                        copy.original_kind = kind;
                        bucket = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc, "ignored.{s}", .{kind});
                    }
                } else {
                    bucket = kind;
                }
                const gop = try out.getOrPut(bucket);
                if (!gop.found_existing) {
                    gop.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList(IssueV4).init(alloc);
                }
                copy.kind = bucket;
                try gop.value_ptr.append(copy);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
            let key = p.iter().map(|x| x.to_string())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join(".");
            let is_ign = is_ignored(ignore, p, tag);
            let dup = path_count[&key] > 1;

            let (kind, mut issue) = if dup {
                ("duplicate-path".to_string(), IssueV4 {
                    tag: tag.clone(), kind: String::new(),

                })

                    (k.to_string(), IssueV4 {

                        original_kind: None,
                        meaning: Some(e.meaning.clone()),
                        count: paths.len(), max: Some(e.max_count),
                        path: p.clone(),

                } else { continue; }

                })

                    "error".to_string()
                } else {
                    issue.original_kind = Some(kind.clone());
                    format!("ignored.{}", kind)
                }

                kind
```

```cangjie
            let sb = StringBuilder()
            for (i in 0..p.size) {

            let key = sb.toString()
            let isIgn = isIgnored(ignore, p, tag)
            let dup = pathCount.contains(key) && pathCount[key] > 1
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
1. ignored 按原 kind 分子组：
   ignored.error / ignored.warn / ignored.unknown / ignored.duplicate-path

2. # strict: tag 列表
   - strict 里的 tag，即使被 ignore 命中，原本 error 的仍进 error
     该记录保留 original_kind 和 forced_by_strict 标记
   - strict 里的 tag，原本 warn 的仍可进 ignored.warn
   - 非 strict 标签：被 ignore 命中正常进 ignored.*
```

效果：

```
你能同时看到：
- 真正要报的：error / warn / unknown / duplicate-path
- 被 ignore 压下的：ignored.<原kind>
- strict 兜底的：error 里带 forced_by_strict，防止你误压关键 error
```

程序仍然不替你定：
- `# strict:` 列哪些标签 → 你写；
- `# ignore:` 怎么配 → 你写；
- 分组名 → 固定前缀，你也可以改代码。

下一步可选：**把 `# ignore:` / `# strict:` 合并进一个 `# policy:` 块**，或**输出 `ignored` 组时不带具体记录、只给计数摘要**。你说方向。

继续。这一轮把 `# ignore:` 和 `# strict:` 合并成一个 **`# policy:` 块**，支持子句，并给 `ignored` 组加一个**只给计数的摘要**，不列每条记录。程序只做块解析、子句分发、摘要汇总，不替你定策略内容。

统一格式：

```
# policy:
#   ignore: 1.*:stranger; *:female
#   strict: convention
#   summary: true
```

- `ignore:` 子句 → 同上一轮的通配 ignore。
- `strict:` 子句 → 同上一轮的 strict 标签列表。
- `summary: true` → `ignored` 组只输出 `{original_kind: count}`，不列每条记录。
- 没有 `# policy:` 时，行为与上一轮相同（空 ignore、空 strict、不摘要）。

### 1. Nim：policy 块 + ignored 摘要

```nim
import std/[strutils, tables, sets, json]

type
  Policy = object
    ignore: IgnoreSet
    strict: HashSet[string]
    summary: bool

proc parsePolicy(src: string): Policy =
  result.ignore = parseIgnoreV2("")
  result.strict = initHashSet[string]()
  result.summary = false
  if src.strip.len == 0: return
  for line in src.splitLines():
    let t = line.strip
    if t.len == 0 or t.startsWith("#"): continue
    let colon = t.find(':')
    if colon < 0: continue
    let key = t[0 ..< colon].strip.toLowerAscii
    let val = t[colon + 1 .. ^1].strip
    case key
    of "ignore": result.ignore = parseIgnoreV2(val)
    of "strict":
      for tag in val.split(';'):
        let x = tag.strip
        if x.len > 0: result.strict.incl x
    of "summary": result.summary = val.toLowerAscii == "true"
    else: discard

proc summarizeIgnored(byKind: var OrderedTable[string, seq[JsonNode]], policy: Policy) =
  if not policy.summary: return
  if "ignored" notin byKind: return
  var counts = initCountTable[string]()
  for rec in byKind["ignored"]:
    let ok = rec["original_kind"].getStr("unknown")
    counts.inc ok
  var summary = newJObject()
  for k, v in counts:
    summary[k] = %v
  byKind["ignored"] = @[ %*{"summary": summary} ]

# 主流程里：
# let policy = parsePolicy("""
# ignore: 1.*:stranger; *:female
# strict: convention
# summary: true
# """)
# 把 checkSemanticV5 的 ignore/strict 换成 policy.ignore / policy.strict
# 最后 summarizeIgnored(byKind, policy)
```

### 2. Zig：policy 块 + ignored 摘要

```zig
const Policy = struct {
    ignore: IgnoreSet,
    strict: std.StringHashMap(void),
    summary: bool = false,
};

fn parsePolicy(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !Policy {
    var out = Policy{
        .ignore = try parseIgnoreV2(alloc, ""),
        .strict = std.StringHashMap(void).init(alloc),
    };
    var lines = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, src, '\n');
    while (lines.next()) |line| {
        const t = std.mem.trim(u8, line, " \t\r");
        if (t.len == 0 or t[0] == '#') continue;
        const colon = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, t, ':') orelse continue;
        const key = std.mem.trim(u8, t[0..colon], " \t");
        const val = std.mem.trim(u8, t[colon + 1 ..], " \t");
        if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(key, "ignore")) {
            out.ignore = try parseIgnoreV2(alloc, val);
        } else if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(key, "strict")) {
            var it = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, val, ';');
            while (it.next()) |tag| {
                const x = std.mem.trim(u8, tag, " \t");
                if (x.len > 0) try out.strict.put(try alloc.dupe(u8, x), {});
            }
        } else if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(key, "summary")) {
            out.summary = std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(val, "true");
        }
    }
    return out;
}

fn summarizeIgnored(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    policy: Policy,
) !void {
    if (!policy.summary) return;
    const gop = by_kind.getOrPut("ignored") orelse return;
    if (!gop.found_existing) return;
    var counts = std.StringHashMap(usize).init(alloc);
    for (gop.value_ptr.items) |it| {
        const ok = it.original_kind orelse "unknown";
        const cg = try counts.getOrPut(ok);
        if (cg.found_existing) cg.value_ptr.* += 1
        else cg.value_ptr.* = 1;
    }
    // 用一条 summary 记录替换原列表
    gop.value_ptr.clearRetainingCapacity();
    // 简化：这里只保留计数，具体 JSON 序列化在输出层处理
}
```

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Policy {
    ignore: IgnoreSet,
    strict: HashSet<String>,
    summary: bool,
}

fn parse_policy(src: &str) -> Policy {
    let mut out = Policy::default();
    for line in src.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if t.is_empty() || t.starts_with('#') { continue; }
        let Some((key, val)) = t.split_once(':') else { continue; };
        let key = key.trim().to_lowercase();
        let val = val.trim();
        match key.as_str() {
            "ignore" => { out.ignore = parse_ignore_v2(val).unwrap_or_default(); }
            "strict" => {
                for tag in val.split(';') {
                    let x = tag.trim();
                    if !x.is_empty() { out.strict.insert(x.to_string()); }
                }
            }
            "summary" => { out.summary = val.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true"); }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    out
}

fn summarize_ignored(
    by_kind: &mut HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    policy: &Policy,
) {
    if !policy.summary { return; }
    let Some(records) = by_kind.get("ignored") else { return; };
    let mut counts: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    for r in records {
        let ok = r.original_kind.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
        *counts.entry(ok).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
    // 替换成一条 summary 记录
    let summary_issue = IssueV4 {
        tag: "__summary__".into(),
        kind: "ignored".into(),
        original_kind: None,
        meaning: None,
        count: counts.values().sum(),
        max: None,
        path: vec![],
    };
    by_kind.insert("ignored".into(), vec![summary_issue]);
    // 若需要保留 counts，可另开字段
}
```

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

class Policy {
    var ignore: IgnoreSet
    let strict: HashSet<String>
    var summary: Bool = false
    init() {
        ignore = IgnoreSet()
        strict = HashSet<String>()
    }
}

func parsePolicy(src: String): Policy {
    let out = Policy()
    for (line in src.split("\n")) {
        let t = line.trimAscii()
        if (t.size == 0 || t.startsWith("#")) { continue }
        let idx = t.indexOf(":")
        if (idx < 0) { continue }
        let key = t[0..idx].trimAscii().toLowerAscii()
        let val = t[idx+1..].trimAscii()
        if (key == "ignore") {
            out.ignore = parseIgnoreV2(val)
        } else if (key == "strict") {
            for (tag in val.split(";")) {
                let x = tag.trimAscii()
                if (x.size > 0) { out.strict.add(x) }
            }
        } else if (key == "summary") {
            out.summary = val.toLowerAscii() == "true"
        }
    }
    return out
}

func summarizeIgnored(byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
                     policy: Policy): Unit {
    if (!policy.summary) { return }
    if (!byKind.contains("ignored")) { return }
    let records = byKind["ignored"]
    let counts = HashMap<String, Int64>()
    for (r in records) {
        let ok = if (let Some(x) <- r.originalKind) { x } else { "unknown" }
        counts[ok] = (if (counts.contains(ok)) { counts[ok] } else { 0 }) + 1
    }
    // 用一条 summary 记录替换
    let summary = IssueV4(tag: "__summary__", kind: "ignored", meaning: "",
                          count: records.size, maxCount: 0, paths: [])
    byKind["ignored"] = ArrayList<IssueV4>([summary])
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：`detailLimit` + 样本截断

```cangjie
class Policy {
    var ignore: IgnoreSet
    let strict: HashSet<String>
    var summary: Bool = false
    var detailLimit: Int64 = 0
    init() {
        ignore = IgnoreSet()
        strict = HashSet<String>()
    }
}

// parsePolicy 增加：
} else if (key == "detail") {
    out.detailLimit = Int64.parse(val)
}

func summarizeIgnored(
    byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
    policy: Policy
): ?String {
    if (!policy.summary) { return None }
    if (!byKind.contains("ignored")) { return None }

    let records = byKind["ignored"]
    let counts = HashMap<String, Int64>()
    let samples = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()

    for (r in records) {
        let ok = if (let Some(x) <- r.originalKind) { x } else { "unknown" }
        counts[ok] = (if (counts.contains(ok)) { counts[ok] } else { 0 }) + 1
        if (policy.detailLimit > 0) {
            if (!samples.contains(ok)) {
                samples[ok] = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
            }
            if (samples[ok].size < policy.detailLimit) {
                samples[ok].append(r.paths[0])
            }
        }
    }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"__summary__\":true,\"counts\":{")
    var first = true
    for ((k, v) in counts) {
        if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
        first = false
        sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
    }
    sb.append("}")
    if (policy.detailLimit > 0) {
        sb.append(",\"samples\":{")
        first = true
        for ((k, paths) in samples) {
            if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
            first = false
            sb.append("\"${k}\":[")
            for (i in 0..paths.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("[")
                for (j in 0..paths[i].size) {
                    if (j > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                    sb.append("${paths[i][j]}")
                }
                sb.append("]")
            }
            sb.append("]")
        }
        sb.append("}")
    }
    sb.append("}")
    return sb.toString()
}
```

排序规则：路径是 `[a, b, c]`，先比 `a`，相同再比 `b`，再比 `c`；短路径排在长路径前面（前缀关系时）。

### 1. Nim：路径排序 + 截断

```nim
import std/algorithm

proc cmpPath(a, b: seq[int]): int =
  let n = min(a.len, b.len)
  for i in 0 ..< n:
    if a[i] != b[i]: return cmp(a[i], b[i])
  cmp(a.len, b.len)

proc summarizeIgnored(
  byKind: var OrderedTable[string, seq[JsonNode]],
  policy: Policy
) =
  if not policy.summary: return
  if "ignored" notin byKind: return

  var counts = initCountTable[string]()
  var samples = initTable[string, seq[seq[int]]]()

  for rec in byKind["ignored"]:
    let ok = rec["original_kind"].getStr("unknown")
    counts.inc ok
    if policy.detailLimit > 0:
      var p: seq[int]
      for x in rec["path"]: p.add x.getInt
      samples.mgetOrPut(ok, @[]).add p

  # 排序后截断
  var sortedSamples = initTable[string, seq[JsonNode]]()
  for k, paths in samples:
    var sp = paths
    sp.sort(cmpPath)
    if sp.len > policy.detailLimit:
      sp.setLen(policy.detailLimit)
    var arr: seq[JsonNode]
    for p in sp: arr.add %*p
    sortedSamples[k] = arr

  var summary = %*{
    "__summary__": true,
    "counts": counts
  }
  if policy.detailLimit > 0:
    var s = newJObject()
    for k, v in sortedSamples:
      s[k] = %*v
    summary["samples"] = s

  byKind["ignored"] = @[summary]
```

### 2. Zig：路径排序 + 截断

```zig
fn cmpPath(_: void, a: []const usize, b: []const usize) bool {
    const n = @min(a.len, b.len);
    for (0..n) |i| {
        if (a[i] != b[i]) return a[i] < b[i];
    }
    return a.len < b.len;
}

fn summarizeIgnored(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    policy: Policy,
) !void {
    if (!policy.summary) return;
    const gop = by_kind.getPtr("ignored") orelse return;

    var counts = std.StringHashMap(usize).init(alloc);
    var samples = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)).init(alloc);

    for (gop.items) |it| {
        const ok = it.original_kind orelse "unknown";
        const cg = try counts.getOrPut(ok);
        if (cg.found_existing) cg.value_ptr.* += 1
        else cg.value_ptr.* = 1;

        if (policy.detail_limit > 0) {
            const sg = try samples.getOrPut(ok);
            if (!sg.found_existing) {
                sg.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList([]const usize).init(alloc);
            }
            try sg.value_ptr.append(it.paths[0]);
        }
    }

    // 对每个 kind 的路径排序后截断
    var sit = samples.iterator();
    while (sit.next()) |entry| {
        const paths = entry.value_ptr;
        std.mem.sort([]const usize, paths.items, {}, cmpPath);
        if (paths.items.len > policy.detail_limit) {
            paths.shrinkRetainingCapacity(policy.detail_limit);
        }
    }

    gop.clearRetainingCapacity();
    // 输出层把 counts / samples 写成 JSON 摘要
}
```

### 3. Rust：路径排序 + 截断

```rust
fn summarize_ignored(
    by_kind: &mut HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    policy: &Policy,
) -> Option<serde_json::Value> {
    if !policy.summary { return None; }
    let records = by_kind.get("ignored")?;

    let mut counts: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut samples: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();

    for r in records {
        let ok = r.original_kind.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
        *counts.entry(ok.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        if policy.detail_limit > 0 {
            samples.entry(ok).or_default().push(r.path.clone());
        }
    }

    // 每个 kind 内部排序后截断
    if policy.detail_limit > 0 {
        for paths in samples.values_mut() {
            paths.sort();
            paths.truncate(policy.detail_limit);
        }
    }

    let mut summary = serde_json::json!({
        "__summary__": true,
        "counts": counts,
    });
    if policy.detail_limit > 0 {
        summary["samples"] = serde_json::json!(samples);
    }
    Some(summary)
}
```

Rust 的 `Vec<usize>` 自带字典序排序（先比第一个元素，相同比第二个，短路径在前），不需要额外比较函数。

### 4. 仓颉：路径排序 + 截断

```cangjie
func cmpPath(a: Array<Int64>, b: Array<Int64>): Int64 {
    let n = if (a.size < b.size) { a.size } else { b.size }
    for (i in 0..n) {
        if (a[i] != b[i]) {
            if (a[i] < b[i]) { return -1 } else { return 1 }
        }
    }
    if (a.size < b.size) { return -1 }
    if (a.size > b.size) { return 1 }
    return 0
}

func summarizeIgnored(
    byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
    policy: Policy
): ?String {
    if (!policy.summary) { return None }
    if (!byKind.contains("ignored")) { return None }

    let records = byKind["ignored"]
    let counts = HashMap<String, Int64>()
    let samples = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()

    for (r in records) {
        let ok = if (let Some(x) <- r.originalKind) { x } else { "unknown" }
        counts[ok] = (if (counts.contains(ok)) { counts[ok] } else { 0 }) + 1
        if (policy.detailLimit > 0) {
            if (!samples.contains(ok)) {
                samples[ok] = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
            }
            samples[ok].append(r.paths[0])
        }
    }

    // 每个 kind 内部排序后截断
    if (policy.detailLimit > 0) {
        for ((k, paths) in samples) {
            paths.sort(cmpPath)
            if (paths.size > policy.detailLimit) {
                // 仓颉 ArrayList 的截断写法视版本而定，
                // 可以新建一个只保留前 N 条的列表替换
                let trimmed = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
                for (i in 0..policy.detailLimit) {
                    trimmed.append(paths[i])
                }
                samples[k] = trimmed
            }
        }
    }

    // 拼 JSON
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"__summary__\":true,\"counts\":{")
    var first = true
    for ((k, v) in counts) {
        if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
        first = false
        sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
    }
    sb.append("}")
    if (policy.detailLimit > 0) {
        sb.append(",\"samples\":{")
        first = true
        for ((k, paths) in samples) {
            if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
            first = false
            sb.append("\"${k}\":[")
            for (i in 0..paths.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("[")
                for (j in 0..paths[i].size) {
                    if (j > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                    sb.append("${paths[i][j]}")
                }
                sb.append("]")
            }
            sb.append("]")
        }
        sb.append("}")
    }
    sb.append("}")
    return sb.toString()
}
```

```
  [0, 1] < [0, 2] < [1, 0] < [1, 0, 0] < [2]
  先比第一项，相同比第二项；短路径在前缀关系下排前
```

```nim
  if "ignored" notin byKind: return

  var counts = initCountTable[string]()
  var pathSamples = initTable[string, seq[seq[int]]]()
  var fullSamples = initTable[string, seq[JsonNode]]()

  for rec in byKind["ignored"]:
    let ok = rec["original_kind"].getStr("unknown")
    counts.inc ok
    case policy.detailMode
    of dmPaths:
      var p: seq[int]
      for x in rec["path"]: p.add x.getInt
      pathSamples.mgetOrPut(ok, @[]).add p
    of dmFull:
      fullSamples.mgetOrPut(ok, @[]).add rec
    of dmNone: discard

  var summary = %*{"__summary__": true, "counts": counts}

  case policy.detailMode
  of dmPaths:
    var s = newJObject()
    for k, paths in pathSamples:
      var sp = paths
      sp.sort(cmpPath)
      if sp.len > policy.detailLimit: sp.setLen(policy.detailLimit)
      var arr: seq[JsonNode]
      for p in sp: arr.add %*p
      s[k] = %*arr
    summary["samples"] = s
  of dmFull:
    var s = newJObject()
    for k, recs in fullSamples:
      s[k] = %*recs
    summary["samples"] = s
  of dmNone: discard

  byKind["ignored"] = @[summary]
```

```zig
const Policy = struct {
    ignore: IgnoreSet,
    strict: std.StringHashMap(void),
    summary: bool = false,
    detail_mode: DetailMode = .none,
    detail_limit: usize = 0,

        out.detail_mode = .full;
    } else {
        out.detail_mode = .paths;
        out.detail_limit = try std.fmt.parseInt(usize, val, 10);
    }

fn summarizeIgnored(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    policy: Policy,
) !void {
    if (!policy.summary) return;
    const gop = by_kind.getPtr("ignored") orelse return;

    var counts = std.StringHashMap(usize).init(alloc);
    var path_samples = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList([]const usize)).init(alloc);
    var full_samples = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)).init(alloc);

    for (gop.items) |it| {
        const ok = it.original_kind orelse "unknown";
        const cg = try counts.getOrPut(ok);
        if (cg.found_existing) cg.value_ptr.* += 1
        else cg.value_ptr.* = 1;

        switch (policy.detail_mode) {
            .paths => {
                const sg = try path_samples.getOrPut(ok);
                if (!sg.found_existing)
                    sg.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList([]const usize).init(alloc);
                try sg.value_ptr.append(it.paths[0]);
            },
            .full => {
                const fg = try full_samples.getOrPut(ok);
                if (!fg.found_existing)
                    fg.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList(IssueV4).init(alloc);
                try fg.value_ptr.append(it);
            },
            .none => {},
        }
    }

    if (policy.detail_mode == .paths) {
        var sit = path_samples.iterator();
        while (sit.next()) |entry| {
            std.mem.sort([]const usize, entry.value_ptr.items, {}, cmpPath);
            if (entry.value_ptr.items.len > policy.detail_limit)
                entry.value_ptr.shrinkRetainingCapacity(policy.detail_limit);
        }
    }

    gop.clearRetainingCapacity();
    // 输出层按 mode 写 counts / samples
```

### 3. Rust：full 模式

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
enum DetailMode { #[default] None, Paths, Full }

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Policy {
    ignore: IgnoreSet,
    strict: HashSet<String>,
    summary: bool,
    detail_mode: DetailMode,
    detail_limit: usize,
}

// parse_policy 增加：
"detail" => {
    if val.eq_ignore_ascii_case("full") {
        out.detail_mode = DetailMode::Full;
    } else {
        out.detail_mode = DetailMode::Paths;
        out.detail_limit = val.parse().unwrap_or(0);
    }
}

fn summarize_ignored(
    by_kind: &mut HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    policy: &Policy,
) -> Option<serde_json::Value> {
    if !policy.summary { return None; }
    let records = by_kind.get("ignored")?;

    let mut counts: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut path_samples: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    let mut full_samples: HashMap<String, Vec<&IssueV4>> = HashMap::new();

    for r in records {
        let ok = r.original_kind.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
        *counts.entry(ok.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        match policy.detail_mode {
            DetailMode::Paths => {
                path_samples.entry(ok).or_default().push(r.path.clone());
            }
            DetailMode::Full => {
                full_samples.entry(ok).or_default().push(r);
            }
            DetailMode::None => {}
        }
    }

    let mut summary = serde_json::json!({
        "__summary__": true,
        "counts": counts,
    });

    match policy.detail_mode {
        DetailMode::Paths => {
            for paths in path_samples.values_mut() {
                paths.sort();
                paths.truncate(policy.detail_limit);
            }
            summary["samples"] = serde_json::json!(path_samples);
        }
        DetailMode::Full => {
            summary["samples"] = serde_json::json!(full_samples);
        }
        DetailMode::None => {}
    }
    Some(summary)
}
```

```cangjie
enum DetailMode { | None | Paths | Full }

class Policy {
    var ignore: IgnoreSet
    let strict: HashSet<String>
    var summary: Bool = false
    var detailMode: DetailMode = DetailMode.None
    var detailLimit: Int64 = 0
    init() {
        ignore = IgnoreSet()
        strict = HashSet<String>()
    }
}

// parsePolicy 增加：
} else if (key == "detail") {
    if (val.toLowerAscii() == "full") {
        out.detailMode = DetailMode.Full
    } else {
        out.detailMode = DetailMode.Paths
        out.detailLimit = Int64.parse(val)
    }
}

func summarizeIgnored(
    byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
    policy: Policy
): ?String {
    if (!policy.summary) { return None }
    if (!byKind.contains("ignored")) { return None }

    let records = byKind["ignored"]
    let counts = HashMap<String, Int64>()
    let pathSamples = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    let fullSamples = HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>()

    for (r in records) {
        let ok = if (let Some(x) <- r.originalKind) { x } else { "unknown" }
        counts[ok] = (if (counts.contains(ok)) { counts[ok] } else { 0 }) + 1
        match (policy.detailMode) {
            case DetailMode.Paths =>
                if (!pathSamples.contains(ok)) {
                    pathSamples[ok] = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
                }
                pathSamples[ok].append(r.paths[0])
            case DetailMode.Full =>
                if (!fullSamples.contains(ok)) {
                    fullSamples[ok] = ArrayList<IssueV4>()
                }
                fullSamples[ok].append(r)
            case DetailMode.None => ()
        }
    }

    if (policy.detailMode == DetailMode.Paths) {
        for ((k, paths) in pathSamples) {
            paths.sort(cmpPath)
            if (paths.size > policy.detailLimit) {
                let trimmed = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
                for (i in 0..policy.detailLimit) {
                    trimmed.append(paths[i])
                }
                pathSamples[k] = trimmed
            }
        }
    }

    // 拼 JSON：counts + samples（paths 或 full）
    // 略
    return None
}
```

```nim
) =
  if not policy.summary: return

      pathSamples.mgetOrPut(ok, @[]).add p
    of dmFull:
      fullSamples.mgetOrPut(ok, @[]).add rec
    of dmNone: discard

  var ignored = newJObject()

  of dmPaths:

      var arr: seq[JsonNode]
```

```zig
    var full_samples = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)).init(alloc);

    for (gop.items) |it| {
        const ok = it.original_kind orelse "unknown";
        const cg = try counts.getOrPut(ok);
        if (cg.found_existing) cg.value_ptr.* += 1
        else cg.value_ptr.* = 1;

                if (!sg.found_existing)
                    sg.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList([]const usize).init(alloc);
                try sg.value_ptr.append(it.paths[0]);
            },
            .full => {
                const fg = try full_samples.getOrPut(ok);
                if (!fg.found_existing)
                    fg.value_ptr.* = std.ArrayList(IssueV4).init(alloc);
                try fg.value_ptr.append(it);
            },
            .none => {},
        }
    }
```

```rust
#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize)]
struct IgnoredSummary {
    counts: HashMap<String, usize>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    samples: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

fn summarize_ignored(
    by_kind: &mut HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    policy: &Policy,
) -> Option<IgnoredSummary> {
    if !policy.summary { return None; }
    let records = by_kind.get("ignored")?;

    let mut counts: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut path_samples: HashMap<String, Vec<Vec<usize>>> = HashMap::new();
    let mut full_samples: HashMap<String, Vec<&IssueV4>> = HashMap::new();

    for r in records {
        let ok = r.original_kind.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
        *counts.entry(ok.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        match policy.detail_mode {
            DetailMode::Paths => path_samples.entry(ok).or_default().push(r.path.clone()),
            DetailMode::Full => full_samples.entry(ok).or_default().push(r),
            DetailMode::None => {}
        }
    }

    let samples = match policy.detail_mode {
        DetailMode::Paths => {
            for paths in path_samples.values_mut() {
                paths.sort();
                paths.truncate(policy.detail_limit);
            }
            Some(serde_json::json!(path_samples))
        }
        DetailMode::Full => {
            for recs in full_samples.values_mut() {
                recs.sort_by(|a, b| a.path.cmp(&b.path));
            }
            Some(serde_json::json!(full_samples))
        }
        DetailMode::None => None,
    };

    by_kind.remove("ignored");   // 数组移除，改由 IgnoredSummary 承载
    Some(IgnoredSummary { counts, samples })
}
```

```cangjie
class IgnoredSummary {
    let counts: HashMap<String, Int64>
    var samples: ?String = None   // 直接存 JSON 片段，或改结构
    init(counts!: HashMap<String, Int64>) {
        this.counts = counts
    }
}

func summarizeIgnored(
    byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
    policy: Policy
): ?IgnoredSummary {
    if (!policy.summary) { return None }
    if (!byKind.contains("ignored")) { return None }

    let records = byKind["ignored"]
    let counts = HashMap<String, Int64>()
    let pathSamples = HashMap<String, ArrayList<Array<Int64>>>()
    let fullSamples = HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>()

    for (r in records) {
        let ok = if (let Some(x) <- r.originalKind) { x } else { "unknown" }
        counts[ok] = (if (counts.contains(ok)) { counts[ok] } else { 0 }) + 1
        match (policy.detailMode) {
            case DetailMode.Paths =>
                if (!pathSamples.contains(ok)) {
                    pathSamples[ok] = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
                }
                pathSamples[ok].append(r.paths[0])
            case DetailMode.Full =>
                if (!fullSamples.contains(ok)) {
                    fullSamples[ok] = ArrayList<IssueV4>()
                }
                fullSamples[ok].append(r)
            case DetailMode.None => ()
        }
    }

    if (policy.detailMode == DetailMode.Paths) {
        for ((k, paths) in pathSamples) {
            paths.sort(cmpPath)
            if (paths.size > policy.detailLimit) {
                let trimmed = ArrayList<Array<Int64>>()
                for (i in 0..policy.detailLimit) { trimmed.append(paths[i]) }
                pathSamples[k] = trimmed
            }
        }
    } else if (policy.detailMode == DetailMode.Full) {
        for ((k, recs) in fullSamples) {
            recs.sort(cmpIssueByPath)
        }
    }

    byKind.remove("ignored")   // 数组不再承载 ignored

    let summary = IgnoredSummary(counts: counts)
    if (policy.detailMode == DetailMode.Paths) {
        summary.samples = renderPathSamples(pathSamples)
    } else if (policy.detailMode == DetailMode.Full) {
        summary.samples = renderFullSamples(fullSamples)
    }
    return summary
}
```

`renderPathSamples` / `renderFullSamples` 只负责拼 JSON 字符串；最终输出把 `ignored` 写成对象 `{counts, samples}`。

```nim
  byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode],
  policy: Policy
): JsonNode =
```

### 2. Zig：total + groups

```zig
fn writeOutput(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
) !void {
    var total: usize = 0;
    var kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| {
        total += entry.value_ptr.items.len;
    }
    if (ignored) |ig| {
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        while (cit.next()) |c| total += c.value_ptr.*;
    }

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.print("{{\"total\":{d},\"groups\":{{", .{total});

    var first = true;
    kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| {
        if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
        first = false;
        try stdout.print("\"{s}\":[", .{entry.key_ptr.*});
        for (entry.value_ptr.items, 0..) |it, i| {
            if (i > 0) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            try stdout.print("{{\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d}}}", .{ it.tag, it.count });
        }
        try stdout.writeAll("]");
    }

    if (ignored) |ig| {
        if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
        try stdout.writeAll("\"ignored\":{\"counts\":{");
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        var cfirst = true;
        while (cit.next()) |c| {
            if (!cfirst) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            cfirst = false;
            try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{d}", .{ c.key_ptr.*, c.value_ptr.* });
        }
        try stdout.writeAll("}}");
    }

    try stdout.writeAll("}}\n");
}
```

```rust
struct GroupedOutput {
    total: usize,
    groups: serde_json::Value,

fn build_output(
    by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    ignored: Option<IgnoredSummary>,
) -> GroupedOutput {
    let mut groups = serde_json::Map::new();
    let mut total = 0usize;

    for (k, v) in by_kind {
        total += v.len();
        groups.insert(k, serde_json::json!(v));
    }
    if let Some(ig) = ignored {
        total += ig.counts.values().sum::<usize>();
        groups.insert("ignored".into(), serde_json::json!(ig));
    }

    GroupedOutput {
        total,
        groups: serde_json::Value::Object(groups),
    }
}
```

```cangjie
func buildOutput(byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
                 ignored: ?IgnoredSummary): String {
    var total: Int64 = 0
    for ((_, issues) in byKind) {
        total += issues.size
    }
    if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
        for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { total += c }
    }

        sb.append("\"${kind}\":[")
        for (i in 0..issues.size) {
            if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
            sb.append("{\"tag\":\"${issues[i].tag}\",\"count\":${issues[i].count}}")
        }
        sb.append("]")
    }

    if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
        if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
        sb.append("\"ignored\":{\"counts\":{")
        var cfirst = true
        for ((k, v) in ig.counts) {
            if (!cfirst) { sb.append(",") }
            cfirst = false
            sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
        }
        sb.append("}")
        if (let Some(s) <- ig.samples) {
            sb.append(",\"samples\":${s}")
        }
        sb.append("}")
    }

    sb.append("}}")
    return sb.toString()
}
```

### 1. Nim：有序 groups + meta

```nim
const GroupOrder = ["error", "warn", "unknown", "duplicate-path", "ignored"]

proc collectMeta(byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode]): JsonNode =
  var maxDepth = 0
  var pathCount = 0
  var tagSet = initHashSet[string]()

  for _, v in byKind:
    if v.kind == JArray:
      for rec in v:
        if rec.hasKey("path"):
          pathCount.inc
          maxDepth = max(maxDepth, rec["path"].len)
        if rec.hasKey("tag"): tagSet.incl rec["tag"].getStr
    elif v.kind == JObject and v.hasKey("samples"):
      for _, arr in v["samples"]:
        if arr.kind == JArray:
          for rec in arr:
            pathCount.inc
            if rec.kind == JArray:
              maxDepth = max(maxDepth, rec.len)
            elif rec.hasKey("path"):
              maxDepth = max(maxDepth, rec["path"].len)

  %*{
    "tags": tagSet.len,
    "paths": pathCount,
    "max_depth": maxDepth,
    "groups": byKind.len
  }

proc buildOutput(
  byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode],
  policy: Policy
): JsonNode =
  var groups = newJObject()
  var total = 0

  # 按固定顺序输出
  for name in GroupOrder:
    if name notin byKind: continue
    let v = byKind[name]
    groups[name] = v
    if name == "ignored" and v.kind == JObject:
      for _, c in v["counts"]: total += c.getInt
    elif v.kind == JArray:
      total += v.len

  %*{
    "total": total,
    "meta": collectMeta(byKind),
    "groups": groups
  }
```

输出示例：

```json
{
  "total": 3,
  "meta": {"tags": 3, "paths": 4, "max_depth": 2, "groups": 2},
  "groups": {
    "error": [ ... ],
    "ignored": { ... }
  }
}
```

### 2. Zig：有序 groups + meta

```zig
const GROUP_ORDER = [_][]const u8{
    "error", "warn", "unknown", "duplicate-path", "ignored",
};

fn collectMeta(
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
) struct { tags: usize, paths: usize, max_depth: usize, groups: usize } {
    var tags = std.StringHashMap(void).init(std.heap.page_allocator);
    var paths: usize = 0;
    var max_depth: usize = 0;

    var kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| {
        for (entry.value_ptr.items) |it| {
            _ = tags.put(it.tag) catch {};
            paths += 1;
            if (it.paths.len > 0)
                max_depth = @max(max_depth, it.paths[0].len);
        }
    }
    if (ignored) |ig| {
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        while (cit.next()) |c| paths += c.value_ptr.*;
    }
    return .{
        .tags = tags.count(),
        .paths = paths,
        .max_depth = max_depth,
        .groups = by_kind.count() + (if (ignored != null) @as(usize, 1) else 0),
    };
}

fn writeOutput(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
) !void {
    const meta = collectMeta(by_kind, ignored);
    var total: usize = 0;
    var kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| total += entry.value_ptr.items.len;
    if (ignored) |ig| {
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        while (cit.next()) |c| total += c.value_ptr.*;
    }

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.print(
        "{{\"total\":{d},\"meta\":{{\"tags\":{d},\"paths\":{d},\"max_depth\":{d},\"groups\":{d}}},\"groups\":{{",
        .{ total, meta.tags, meta.paths, meta.max_depth, meta.groups },
    );

    var first = true;
    for (GROUP_ORDER) |name| {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "ignored")) {
            if (ignored) |ig| {
                if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                first = false;
                try stdout.writeAll("\"ignored\":{\"counts\":{");
                var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                var cfirst = true;
                while (cit.next()) |c| {
                    if (!cfirst) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                    cfirst = false;
                    try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{d}", .{ c.key_ptr.*, c.value_ptr.* });
                }
                try stdout.writeAll("}}");
            }
        } else {
            const gop = by_kind.getPtr(name) orelse continue;
            if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            first = false;
            try stdout.print("\"{s}\":[", .{name});
            for (gop.items, 0..) |it, i| {
                if (i > 0) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                try stdout.print("{{\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d}}}", .{ it.tag, it.count });
            }
            try stdout.writeAll("]");
        }
    }
    try stdout.writeAll("}}\n");
}
```

### 3. Rust：有序 groups + meta

```rust
const GROUP_ORDER: &[&str] = &[
    "error", "warn", "unknown", "duplicate-path", "ignored",
];

#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
struct Meta {
    tags: usize,
    paths: usize,
    max_depth: usize,
    groups: usize,
}

#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
struct GroupedOutput {
    total: usize,
    meta: Meta,
    groups: serde_json::Value,
}

fn build_output(
    by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    ignored: Option<IgnoredSummary>,
) -> GroupedOutput {
    let mut tags: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut paths = 0usize;
    let mut max_depth = 0usize;
    let mut total = 0usize;

    for (_, issues) in &by_kind {
        for it in issues {
            tags.insert(it.tag.clone());
            paths += 1;
            max_depth = max_depth.max(it.path.len());
        }
    }
    if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
        total += ig.counts.values().sum::<usize>();
        paths += ig.counts.values().sum::<usize>();
    }

    let mut groups = serde_json::Map::new();
    for name in GROUP_ORDER {
        if *name == "ignored" {
            if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
                groups.insert("ignored".into(), serde_json::json!(ig));
            }
        } else if let Some(v) = by_kind.get(*name) {
            total += v.len();
            groups.insert(name.to_string(), serde_json::json!(v));
        }
    }

    // 不在固定顺序里的组，追加到末尾
    for (k, v) in &by_kind {
        if !GROUP_ORDER.contains(&k.as_str()) {
            total += v.len();
            groups.insert(k.clone(), serde_json::json!(v));
        }
    }

    GroupedOutput {
        total,
        meta: Meta {
            tags: tags.len(),
            paths,
            max_depth,
            groups: groups.len(),
        },
        groups: serde_json::Value::Object(groups),
    }
}
```
