### 4. 仓颉：有序 groups + meta

```cangjie
let GROUP_ORDER = ["error", "warn", "unknown", "duplicate-path", "ignored"]

class Meta {
    let tags: Int64
    let paths: Int64
    let maxDepth: Int64
    let groups: Int64
    init(tags!: Int64, paths!: Int64, maxDepth!: Int64, groups!: Int64) {
        this.tags = tags
        this.paths = paths
        this.maxDepth = maxDepth
        this.groups = groups
    }
}

func buildOutput(byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
                 ignored: ?IgnoredSummary): String {
    var total: Int64 = 0
    var paths: Int64 = 0
    var maxDepth: Int64 = 0
    let tags = HashSet<String>()

    for ((_, issues) in byKind) {
        for (it in issues) {
            tags.add(it.tag)
            paths += 1
            if (it.paths.size > 0 && it.paths[0].size > maxDepth) {
                maxDepth = it.paths[0].size
            }
        }
    }
    if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
        for ((_, c) in ig.counts) {
            total += c
            paths += c
        }
    }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"total\":${total},\"meta\":{\"tags\":${tags.size},")
    sb.append("\"paths\":${paths},\"max_depth\":${maxDepth},")
    let groupCount = byKind.size + (if (ignored.isSome()) { 1 } else { 0 })
    sb.append("\"groups\":${groupCount}},\"groups\":{")

    var first = true
    for (name in GROUP_ORDER) {
        if (name == "ignored") {
            if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
                if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
                first = false
                sb.append("\"ignored\":{\"counts\":{")
                var cfirst = true
                for ((k, v) in ig.counts) {
                    if (!cfirst) { sb.append(",") }
                    cfirst = false
                    sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
                }
                sb.append("}}")
            }
        } else if (byKind.contains(name)) {
            if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
            first = false
            sb.append("\"${name}\":[")
            let issues = byKind[name]
            for (i in 0..issues.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("{\"tag\":\"${issues[i].tag}\",\"count\":${issues[i].count}}")
            }
            sb.append("]")
        }
    }
    sb.append("}}")
    return sb.toString()
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
1. groups 按固定顺序输出：
   error → warn → unknown → duplicate-path → ignored
   （不在顺序里的组追加到末尾）

2. meta 顶层：
   tags      = 出现过的不同标签数
   paths     = 记录总数（含 ignored 的 counts 之和）
   max_depth = 最深路径长度
   groups    = 实际输出的组数
```

效果：同样的输入，输出顺序稳定、可 diff；`meta` 让你一眼看到规模，不必逐条数。

程序仍然不替你定：
- `meta` 里统计什么 → 固定四项，你也可以加字段；
- 排序方向 → 固定为上述顺序；
- `ignored` 是否计入 `total` / `paths` → 程序固定计入。

下一步可选：**`meta` 加 `elapsed_ms` 解析耗时**，或**`groups` 里每个组加 `count` 字段**（组内记录数），方便不展开就看数量。你说方向。

### 1. Nim：count + elapsed_ms

```nim
import std/[times, monotimes]

proc buildOutput(
  byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode],
  policy: Policy,
  startTime: MonoTime
): JsonNode =
  let elapsed = (getMonoTime() - startTime).inMilliseconds

  var groups = newJObject()
  var total = 0

  for name in GroupOrder:
    if name notin byKind: continue
    let v = byKind[name]
    if name == "ignored" and v.kind == JObject:
      var c = 0
      for _, x in v["counts"]: c += x.getInt
      total += c
      groups[name] = %*{"count": c, "counts": v["counts"]}
      if v.hasKey("samples"): groups[name]["samples"] = v["samples"]
    elif v.kind == JArray:
      total += v.len
      groups[name] = %*{"count": v.len, "items": v}

  %*{
    "total": total,
    "meta": {
      "tags": collectMeta(byKind)["tags"],
      "paths": collectMeta(byKind)["paths"],
      "max_depth": collectMeta(byKind)["max_depth"],
      "groups": groups.len,
      "elapsed_ms": elapsed
    },
    "groups": groups
  }
```

```rust
struct Meta {

    let mut paths = 0usize;
    let mut max_depth = 0usize;
    let mut total = 0usize;

    for (_, issues) in &by_kind {
        for it in issues {
            tags.insert(it.tag.clone());
            paths += 1;
            max_depth = max_depth.max(it.path.len());
        }
    }
    if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
        let s: usize = ig.counts.values().sum();
        total += s;
        paths += s;
    }

    let mut groups = serde_json::Map::new();
    for name in GROUP_ORDER {
        if *name == "ignored" {
            if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
                let s: usize = ig.counts.values().sum();
                let mut obj = serde_json::Map::new();
                obj.insert("count".into(), serde_json::json!(s));
                obj.insert("counts".into(), serde_json::json!(ig.counts));
                if let Some(ref samples) = ig.samples {
                    obj.insert("samples".into(), samples.clone());
                }
                groups.insert("ignored".into(), serde_json::Value::Object(obj));
            }
        } else if let Some(v) = by_kind.get(*name) {
            total += v.len();
            groups.insert(name.to_string(), serde_json::json!({
                "count": v.len(),
                "items": v,
            }));
        }
    }
    for (k, v) in &by_kind {
        if !GROUP_ORDER.contains(&k.as_str()) {
            total += v.len();
            groups.insert(k.clone(), serde_json::json!({
                "count": v.len(),
                "items": v,
            }));
        }
    }

    GroupedOutput {
        total,
        meta: Meta {
            tags: tags.len(),
            paths,
            max_depth,
            groups: groups.len(),
            elapsed_ms,
        },
        groups: serde_json::Value::Object(groups),
    }
}

fn main() {
    let start = Instant::now();
    // ... parse + applyTags + collectTags + check + summarize ...
    let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_millis();
    let out = build_output(by_kind, ignored, elapsed);
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap());
}
```

```cangjie
import std.time.*

func buildOutput(byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
                 ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
                 elapsedMs: Int64): String {
    var total: Int64 = 0
    var paths: Int64 = 0
    var maxDepth: Int64 = 0
    let tags = HashSet<String>()

    for ((_, issues) in byKind) {
        for (it in issues) {
            tags.add(it.tag)
            paths += 1
            if (it.paths.size > 0 && it.paths[0].size > maxDepth) {
                maxDepth = it.paths[0].size
            }
        }
    }
    if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
        for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { total += c; paths += c }
    }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"total\":${total},\"meta\":{")
    sb.append("\"tags\":${tags.size},\"paths\":${paths},")
    sb.append("\"max_depth\":${maxDepth},")
    let gc = byKind.size + (if (ignored.isSome()) { 1 } else { 0 })
    sb.append("\"groups\":${gc},\"elapsed_ms\":${elapsedMs}},")
    sb.append("\"groups\":{")

    var first = true
    for (name in GROUP_ORDER) {
        if (name == "ignored") {
            if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
                if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
                first = false
                var csum: Int64 = 0
                for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { csum += c }
                sb.append("\"ignored\":{\"count\":${csum},\"counts\":{")
                var cf = true
                for ((k, v) in ig.counts) {
                    if (!cf) { sb.append(",") }
                    cf = false
                    sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
                }
                sb.append("}}")
            }
        } else if (byKind.contains(name)) {
            if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
            first = false
            let issues = byKind[name]
            sb.append("\"${name}\":{\"count\":${issues.size},\"items\":[")
            for (i in 0..issues.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("{\"tag\":\"${issues[i].tag}\",\"count\":${issues[i].count}}")
            }
            sb.append("]}")
        }
    }
    sb.append("}}")
    return sb.toString()
}

main() {
    let start = DateTime.now()
    // ... parse + applyTags + collectTags + check + summarize ...
    let elapsed = DateTime.now() - start
    println(buildOutput(byKind, ignored, elapsed.toMilliseconds()))
}
```

### 1. Nim：index + parse_errors

```nim
type
  ParseOutcome = object
    tree: Node
    parseErrors: int

proc parseExprSafe(src: string): ParseOutcome =
  result.parseErrors = 0
  try:
    let toks = lex(src)
    var p = Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0)
    result.tree = p.parseExpr()
    if p.peek() != tkEOF:
      result.parseErrors.inc
  except ValueError:
    result.parseErrors.inc
    result.tree = Node(kind: nkInclude, children: @[])

proc addIndex(issues: seq[JsonNode]): seq[JsonNode] =
  result = @[]
  for i, rec in issues:
    var r = rec
    r["index"] = %(i + 1)
    result.add r

proc buildOutput(
  byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode],
  policy: Policy,
  startTime: MonoTime,
  parseErrors: int
): JsonNode =
  let elapsed = (getMonoTime() - startTime).inMilliseconds
  var groups = newJObject()
  var total = 0

  for name in GroupOrder:
    if name notin byKind: continue
    let v = byKind[name]
    if name == "ignored" and v.kind == JObject:
      var c = 0
      for _, x in v["counts"]: c += x.getInt
      total += c
      var obj = %*{"count": c, "counts": v["counts"]}
      if v.hasKey("samples"): obj["samples"] = v["samples"]
      groups[name] = obj
    elif v.kind == JArray:
      total += v.len
      groups[name] = %*{"count": v.len, "items": addIndex(v.getElems())}

  %*{
    "total": total,
    "meta": {
      "tags": collectMeta(byKind)["tags"],
      "paths": collectMeta(byKind)["paths"],
      "max_depth": collectMeta(byKind)["max_depth"],
      "groups": groups.len,
      "elapsed_ms": elapsed,
      "parse_errors": parseErrors
    },
    "groups": groups
  }
```

```nim
# ... applyTags(outcome.tree, ...) 继续 ...
```

### 2. Zig：index + parse_errors

```zig
const ParseOutcome = struct {
    tree: Node,
    parse_errors: usize = 0,
};

fn parseExprSafe(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) ParseOutcome {
    var out = ParseOutcome{ .tree = .{ .kind = .include, .children = &.{} } };
    const toks = lex(alloc, src) catch {
        out.parse_errors += 1;
        return out;
    };
    var p = Parser{ .toks = toks, .alloc = alloc };
    out.tree = p.parseExpr() catch {
        out.parse_errors += 1;
        return out;
    };
    if (p.peek() != .eof) out.parse_errors += 1;
    return out;
}

fn writeIndexedItems(w: anytype, items: []const IssueV4) !void {
    for (items, 0..) |it, i| {
        if (i > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
        try w.print(
            "{{\"index\":{d},\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d}}}",
            .{ i + 1, it.tag, it.count },
        );
    }
}

fn writeOutput(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
    elapsed_ms: u64,
    parse_errors: usize,
) !void {
    const meta = collectMeta(by_kind, ignored);
    var total: usize = 0;
    var kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| total += entry.value_ptr.items.len;
    if (ignored) |ig| {
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        while (cit.next()) |c| total += c.value_ptr.*;
    }

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.print(
        "{{\"total\":{d},\"meta\":{{\"tags\":{d},\"paths\":{d},\"max_depth\":{d},\"groups\":{d},\"elapsed_ms\":{d},\"parse_errors\":{d}}},\"groups\":{{",
        .{ total, meta.tags, meta.paths, meta.max_depth, meta.groups, elapsed_ms, parse_errors },
    );

    var first = true;
    for (GROUP_ORDER) |name| {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "ignored")) {
            if (ignored) |ig| {
                if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                first = false;
                var csum: usize = 0;
                var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                while (cit.next()) |c| csum += c.value_ptr.*;
                try stdout.print("\"ignored\":{{\"count\":{d},\"counts\":{{", .{csum});
                cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                var cf = true;
                while (cit.next()) |c| {
                    if (!cf) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                    cf = false;
                    try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{d}", .{ c.key_ptr.*, c.value_ptr.* });
                }
                try stdout.writeAll("}}");
            }
        } else {
            const gop = by_kind.getPtr(name) orelse continue;
            if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            first = false;
            try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{{\"count\":{d},\"items\":[", .{ name, gop.items.len });
            try writeIndexedItems(stdout, gop.items);
            try stdout.writeAll("]}");
        }
    }
    try stdout.writeAll("}}\n");
}

// 调用处：
const t0 = std.time.milliTimestamp();
const outcome = parseExprSafe(alloc, expr_part);
// ... 继续用 outcome.tree ...
const elapsed: u64 = @intCast(std.time.milliTimestamp() - t0);
try writeOutput(alloc, &by_kind, ignored, elapsed, outcome.parse_errors);
```

### 3. Rust：index + parse_errors

```rust
struct ParseOutcome {
    tree: Node,
    parse_errors: usize,
}

fn parse_expr_safe(src: &str) -> ParseOutcome {
    let mut out = ParseOutcome {
        tree: Node { kind: NodeKind::Include, children: vec![], tags: vec![] },
        parse_errors: 0,
    };
    let Ok(toks) = lex(src.as_bytes()) else {
        out.parse_errors += 1;
        return out;
    };
    let mut p = Parser { toks, pos: 0 };
    match p.parse_expr() {
        Ok(t) => {
            out.tree = t;
            if p.peek() != TokKind::Eof { out.parse_errors += 1; }
        }
        Err(_) => { out.parse_errors += 1; }
    }
    out
}

#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
struct IndexedIssue<'a> {
    index: usize,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    inner: &'a IssueV4,
}

fn build_output(
    by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    ignored: Option<IgnoredSummary>,
    elapsed_ms: u128,
    parse_errors: usize,
) -> GroupedOutput {
    let mut tags: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut paths = 0usize;
    let mut max_depth = 0usize;
    let mut total = 0usize;

    for (_, issues) in &by_kind {
        for it in issues {
            tags.insert(it.tag.clone());
            paths += 1;
            max_depth = max_depth.max(it.path.len());
        }
    }
    if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
        let s: usize = ig.counts.values().sum();
        total += s;
        paths += s;
    }

    let mut groups = serde_json::Map::new();
    for name in GROUP_ORDER {
        if *name == "ignored" {
            if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
                let s: usize = ig.counts.values().sum();
                let mut obj = serde_json::Map::new();
                obj.insert("count".into(), serde_json::json!(s));
                obj.insert("counts".into(), serde_json::json!(ig.counts));
                if let Some(ref samples) = ig.samples {
                    obj.insert("samples".into(), samples.clone());
                }
                groups.insert("ignored".into(), serde_json::Value::Object(obj));
            }
        } else if let Some(v) = by_kind.get(*name) {
            total += v.len();
            let indexed: Vec<serde_json::Value> = v.iter().enumerate()
                .map(|(i, it)| {
                    let mut obj = serde_json::to_value(it).unwrap();
                    obj["index"] = serde_json::json!(i + 1);
                    obj
                })
                .collect();
            groups.insert(name.to_string(), serde_json::json!({
                "count": v.len(),
                "items": indexed,
            }));
        }
    }
    for (k, v) in &by_kind {
        if !GROUP_ORDER.contains(&k.as_str()) {
            total += v.len();
            let indexed: Vec<serde_json::Value> = v.iter().enumerate()
                .map(|(i, it)| {
                    let mut obj = serde_json::to_value(it).unwrap();
                    obj["index"] = serde_json::json!(i + 1);
                    obj
                })
                .collect();
            groups.insert(k.clone(), serde_json::json!({
                "count": v.len(),
                "items": indexed,
            }));
        }
    }

    GroupedOutput {
        total,
        meta: Meta {
            tags: tags.len(),
            paths,
            max_depth,
            groups: groups.len(),
            elapsed_ms,
            parse_errors,
        },
        groups: serde_json::Value::Object(groups),
    }
}

fn main() {
    let start = Instant::now();
    let outcome = parse_expr_safe(expr_part);
    // ... 继续用 outcome.tree ...
    let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_millis();
    let out = build_output(by_kind, ignored, elapsed, outcome.parse_errors);
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap());
}
```

注意：`Meta` 结构体需要加 `parse_errors: usize` 字段。`#[serde(flatten)]` 会把 `IssueV4` 的字段平铺到 `IndexedIssue` 里，`index` 单独出现。

### 4. 仓颉：index + parse_errors

```cangjie
class ParseOutcome {
    let tree: Node
    let parseErrors: Int64
    init(tree!: Node, parseErrors!: Int64) {
        this.tree = tree
        this.parseErrors = parseErrors
    }
}

func parseExprSafe(src: String): ParseOutcome {
    var errors: Int64 = 0
    try {
        let toks = lex(src)
        let p = Parser(toks: toks)
        let tree = p.parseExpr()
        if (p.peek() != TokKind.Eof) { errors += 1 }
        return ParseOutcome(tree: tree, parseErrors: errors)
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        return ParseOutcome(
            tree: Node(kind: NodeKind.Include, children: []),
            parseErrors: errors + 1,
        )
    }
}

func renderIndexedItems(issues: ArrayList<IssueV4>): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("[")
    for (i in 0..issues.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        let it = issues[i]
        sb.append("{\"index\":${i + 1},\"tag\":\"${it.tag}\",\"count\":${it.count}}")
    }
    sb.append("]")
    return sb.toString()
}

func buildOutput(byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
                 ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
                 elapsedMs: Int64,
                 parseErrors: Int64): String {
    var total: Int64 = 0
    var paths: Int64 = 0
    var maxDepth: Int64 = 0
    let tags = HashSet<String>()

    for ((_, issues) in byKind) {
        for (it in issues) {
            tags.add(it.tag)
            paths += 1
            if (it.paths.size > 0 && it.paths[0].size > maxDepth) {
                maxDepth = it.paths[0].size
            }
        }
    }
    if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
        for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { total += c; paths += c }
    }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"total\":${total},\"meta\":{")
    sb.append("\"tags\":${tags.size},\"paths\":${paths},")
    sb.append("\"max_depth\":${maxDepth},")
    let gc = byKind.size + (if (ignored.isSome()) { 1 } else { 0 })
    sb.append("\"groups\":${gc},\"elapsed_ms\":${elapsedMs},")
    sb.append("\"parse_errors\":${parseErrors}},")
    sb.append("\"groups\":{")

    var first = true
    for (name in GROUP_ORDER) {
        if (name == "ignored") {
            if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
                if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
                first = false
                var csum: Int64 = 0
                for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { csum += c }
                sb.append("\"ignored\":{\"count\":${csum},\"counts\":{")
                var cf = true
                for ((k, v) in ig.counts) {
                    if (!cf) { sb.append(",") }
                    cf = false
                    sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
                }
                sb.append("}}")
            }
        } else if (byKind.contains(name)) {
            if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
            first = false
            let issues = byKind[name]
            sb.append("\"${name}\":{\"count\":${issues.size},\"items\":")
            sb.append(renderIndexedItems(issues))
            sb.append("}")
        }
    }
    sb.append("}}")
    return sb.toString()
}

main() {
    let start = DateTime.now()
    let outcome = parseExprSafe(exprPart)
    // ... 继续用 outcome.tree ...
    let elapsed = DateTime.now() - start
    println(buildOutput(byKind, ignored, elapsed.toMilliseconds(), outcome.parseErrors))
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
items 里每条记录：
  新增 "index"：组内序号，从 1 开始，按输出顺序编号

meta 新增：
  parse_errors：解析阶段捕获的错误数
    - lex 失败 → +1
    - parse 抛异常 → +1
    - 表达式后有多余 token → +1
  解析失败时返回空树，不阻断后续检查
```

效果：
- `index` 让你不展开就能引用“第 1 条 error”“第 2 条 error”。
- `parse_errors` 让你知道这次输出是“解析干净”还是“带病运行”。

程序仍然不替你定：
- `index` 从 0 还是 1 开始 → 固定为 1；
- `parse_errors` 计什么 → 固定为上述三类；
- 解析失败后是否继续 → 固定继续，用空树跑后续，不中断。

下一步可选：**`parse_errors` 带具体位置和原因**（`[{pos, reason}]`），或**`items` 里 `index` 按路径排序后的序号**（当前按输出顺序，排序后序号会变）。你说方向。

```json
{

    ]
  },
  "groups": {}
}
```

规则：
- `lex` 遇到非法字符 → 记 `{pos, reason}`，跳过该字符，继续。
- `parser` 遇到未闭合分组 → 记 `{pos, reason}`，返回已解析部分。
- 表达式后有多余 token → 记 `{pos, reason}`，不阻断。
- `parse_error_count` = `parse_errors.len`。

### 1. Nim：错误列表

```nim
type
  ParseError = object
    pos: int
    reason: string

  LexResult = object
    toks: seq[Token]
    errors: seq[ParseError]

  ParseOutcome = object
    tree: Node
    errors: seq[ParseError]

proc lexSafe(src: string): LexResult =
  var i = 0
  while i < src.len:
    case src[i]
    of '0': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkZero, pos: i); inc i
    of '1': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkOne, pos: i); inc i
    of '.': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkDot, pos: i); inc i
    of '(': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkLParen, pos: i); inc i
    of ')': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkRParen, pos: i); inc i
    of '<': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkLangle, pos: i); inc i
    of '>': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkRangle, pos: i); inc i
    of '{': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkLBrace, pos: i); inc i
    of '}': result.toks.add Token(kind: tkRBrace, pos: i); inc i
    of ' ', '\n', '\t': inc i
    else:
      if src[i] == '\xC2' and i + 1 < src.len and src[i + 1] == '\xBD':
        result.toks.add Token(kind: tkHalf, pos: i); i += 2
      else:
        result.errors.add ParseError(pos: i, reason: "非法字符: " & $src[i])
        inc i
  result.toks.add Token(kind: tkEOF, pos: i)

proc parseExprSafe(src: string): ParseOutcome =
  let lr = lexSafe(src)
  result.errors = lr.errors
  var p = Parser(toks: lr.toks, pos: 0)
  try:
    result.tree = p.parseExpr()
    if p.peek() != tkEOF:
      result.errors.add ParseError(
        pos: p.toks[p.pos].pos,
        reason: "表达式后有多余 token"
      )
  except ValueError as e:
    result.errors.add ParseError(pos: p.toks[p.pos].pos, reason: e.msg)
    result.tree = Node(kind: nkInclude, children: @[])

proc buildOutput(
  byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode],
  policy: Policy,
  startTime: MonoTime,
  parseErrors: seq[ParseError]
): JsonNode =
  let elapsed = (getMonoTime() - startTime).inMilliseconds
  var groups = newJObject()
  var total = 0

  for name in GroupOrder:
    if name notin byKind: continue
    let v = byKind[name]
    if name == "ignored" and v.kind == JObject:
      var c = 0
      for _, x in v["counts"]: c += x.getInt
      total += c
      var obj = %*{"count": c, "counts": v["counts"]}
      if v.hasKey("samples"): obj["samples"] = v["samples"]
      groups[name] = obj
    elif v.kind == JArray:
      total += v.len
      groups[name] = %*{"count": v.len, "items": addIndex(v.getElems())}

  var errArr = newJArray()
  for e in parseErrors:
    errArr.add %*{"pos": e.pos, "reason": e.reason}

  %*{
    "total": total,
    "meta": {
      "tags": collectMeta(byKind)["tags"],
      "paths": collectMeta(byKind)["paths"],
      "max_depth": collectMeta(byKind)["max_depth"],
      "groups": groups.len,
      "elapsed_ms": elapsed,
      "parse_error_count": parseErrors.len,
      "parse_errors": errArr
    },
    "groups": groups
  }
```

### 2. Zig：错误列表

```zig
const ParseError = struct {
    pos: usize,
    reason: []const u8,
};

const LexResult = struct {
    toks: std.ArrayList(Token),
    errors: std.ArrayList(ParseError),
};

fn lexSafe(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !LexResult {
    var toks = std.ArrayList(Token).init(alloc);
    var errors = std.ArrayList(ParseError).init(alloc);
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < src.len) {
        const c = src[i];
        switch (c) {
            '0' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .zero, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '1' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .one, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '.' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .dot, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '(' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .lparen, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            ')' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .rparen, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '<' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .langle, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '>' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .rangle, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '{' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .lbrace, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            '}' => { try toks.append(.{ .kind = .rbrace, .pos = i }); i += 1; },
            ' ', '\n', '\t' => i += 1,
            else => {
                if (c == 0xC2 and i + 1 < src.len and src[i + 1] == 0xBD) {
                    try toks.append(.{ .kind = .half, .pos = i });
                    i += 2;
                } else {
                    const reason = try std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc, "非法字符: 0x{X}", .{c});
                    try errors.append(.{ .pos = i, .reason = reason });
                    i += 1;
                }
            },
        }
    }
    try toks.append(.{ .kind = .eof, .pos = i });
    return .{ .toks = toks, .errors = errors };
}

const ParseOutcome = struct {
    tree: Node,
    errors: []const ParseError,
};

fn parseExprSafe(alloc: std.mem.Allocator, src: []const u8) !ParseOutcome {
    const lr = try lexSafe(alloc, src);
    var errors = std.ArrayList(ParseError).init(alloc);
    try errors.appendSlice(lr.errors.items);

    var p = Parser{ .toks = lr.toks.items, .alloc = alloc };
    var tree: Node = undefined;
    if (p.parseExpr()) |t| {
        tree = t;
        if (p.peek() != .eof) {
            try errors.append(.{
                .pos = p.toks[p.pos].pos,
                .reason = "表达式后有多余 token",
            });
        }
    } else |_| {
        try errors.append(.{
            .pos = p.toks[p.pos].pos,
            .reason = "解析失败",
        });
        tree = .{ .kind = .include, .children = &.{} };
    }
    return .{ .tree = tree, .errors = try errors.toOwnedSlice() };
}

fn writeParseErrors(w: anytype, errors: []const ParseError) !void {
    try w.writeAll("[");
    for (errors, 0..) |e, i| {
        if (i > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
        try w.print("{{\"pos\":{d},\"reason\":\"{s}\"}}", .{ e.pos, e.reason });
    }
    try w.writeAll("]");
}

fn writeOutput(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
    elapsed_ms: u64,
    parse_errors: []const ParseError,
) !void {
    const meta = collectMeta(by_kind, ignored);
    var total: usize = 0;
    var kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| total += entry.value_ptr.items.len;
    if (ignored) |ig| {
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        while (cit.next()) |c| total += c.value_ptr.*;
    }

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.print(
        "{{\"total\":{d},\"meta\":{{\"tags\":{d},\"paths\":{d},\"max_depth\":{d},\"groups\":{d},\"elapsed_ms\":{d},\"parse_error_count\":{d},\"parse_errors\":",
        .{ total, meta.tags, meta.paths, meta.max_depth, meta.groups, elapsed_ms, parse_errors.len },
    );
    try writeParseErrors(stdout, parse_errors);
    try stdout.writeAll("},\"groups\":{");

    var first = true;
    for (GROUP_ORDER) |name| {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "ignored")) {
            if (ignored) |ig| {
                if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                first = false;
                var csum: usize = 0;
                var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                while (cit.next()) |c| csum += c.value_ptr.*;
                try stdout.print("\"ignored\":{{\"count\":{d},\"counts\":{{", .{csum});
                cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                var cf = true;
                while (cit.next()) |c| {
                    if (!cf) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                    cf = false;
                    try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{d}", .{ c.key_ptr.*, c.value_ptr.* });
                }
                try stdout.writeAll("}}");
            }
        } else {
            const gop = by_kind.getPtr(name) orelse continue;
            if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            first = false;
            try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{{\"count\":{d},\"items\":[", .{ name, gop.items.len });
            for (gop.items, 0..) |it, i| {
                if (i > 0) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                try stdout.print(
                    "{{\"index\":{d},\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d}}}",
                    .{ i + 1, it.tag, it.count },
                );
            }
            try stdout.writeAll("]}");
        }
    }
    try stdout.writeAll("}}\n");
}
```

### 3. Rust：错误列表

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
struct ParseError {
    pos: usize,
    reason: String,
}

struct LexResult {
    toks: Vec<Token>,
    errors: Vec<ParseError>,
}

fn lex_safe(src: &[u8]) -> LexResult {
    let mut toks = Vec::new();
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < src.len {
        let c = src[i];
        let k = match c {
            b'0' => Some(TokKind::Zero),
            b'1' => Some(TokKind::One),
            b'.' => Some(TokKind::Dot),
            b'(' => Some(TokKind::LParen),
            b')' => Some(TokKind::RParen),
            b'<' => Some(TokKind::LAngle),
            b'>' => Some(TokKind::RAngle),
            b'{' => Some(TokKind::LBrace),
            b'}' => Some(TokKind::RBrace),
            b' ' | b'\n' | b'\t' => { i += 1; continue; }
            0xC2 if i + 1 < src.len && src[i + 1] == 0xBD => {
                toks.push(Token { kind: TokKind::Half, pos: i });
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            _ => {
                errors.push(ParseError {
                    pos: i,
                    reason: format!("非法字节 0x{:02X}", c),
                });
                i += 1;
                continue;
            }
        };
        toks.push(Token { kind: k.unwrap(), pos: i });
        i += 1;
    }
    toks.push(Token { kind: TokKind::Eof, pos: i });
    LexResult { toks, errors }
}

struct ParseOutcome {
    tree: Node,
    errors: Vec<ParseError>,
}

fn parse_expr_safe(src: &str) -> ParseOutcome {
    let lr = lex_safe(src.as_bytes());
    let mut errors = lr.errors;
    let mut p = Parser { toks: lr.toks, pos: 0 };
    match p.parse_expr() {
        Ok(t) => {
            if p.peek() != TokKind::Eof {
                errors.push(ParseError {
                    pos: p.toks[p.pos].pos,
                    reason: "表达式后有多余 token".into(),
                });
            }
            ParseOutcome { tree: t, errors }
        }
        Err(e) => {
            errors.push(ParseError {
                pos: p.toks.get(p.pos).map(|t| t.pos).unwrap_or(0),
                reason: e,
            });
            ParseOutcome {
                tree: Node { kind: NodeKind::Include, children: vec![], tags: vec![] },
                errors,
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
struct Meta {
    tags: usize,
    paths: usize,
    max_depth: usize,
    groups: usize,
    elapsed_ms: u128,
    parse_error_count: usize,
    parse_errors: Vec<ParseError>,
}

fn build_output(
    by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    ignored: Option<IgnoredSummary>,
    elapsed_ms: u128,
    parse_errors: Vec<ParseError>,
) -> GroupedOutput {
    // ... 同上一轮，Meta 里加 parse_error_count 和 parse_errors ...
    let mut tags: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut paths = 0usize;
    let mut max_depth = 0usize;
    let mut total = 0usize;

    for (_, issues) in &by_kind {
        for it in issues {
            tags.insert(it.tag.clone());
            paths += 1;
            max_depth = max_depth.max(it.path.len());
        }
    }
    if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
        let s: usize = ig.counts.values().sum();
        total += s;
        paths += s;
    }

    let mut groups = serde_json::Map::new();
    for name in GROUP_ORDER {
        if *name == "ignored" {
            if let Some(ref ig) = ignored {
                let s: usize = ig.counts.values().sum();
                let mut obj = serde_json::Map::new();
                obj.insert("count".into(), serde_json::json!(s));
                obj.insert("counts".into(), serde_json::json!(ig.counts));
                if let Some(ref samples) = ig.samples {
                    obj.insert("samples".into(), samples.clone());
                }
                groups.insert("ignored".into(), serde_json::Value::Object(obj));
            }
        } else if let Some(v) = by_kind.get(*name) {
            total += v.len();
            let indexed: Vec<serde_json::Value> = v.iter().enumerate()
                .map(|(i, it)| {
                    let mut obj = serde_json::to_value(it).unwrap();
                    obj["index"] = serde_json::json!(i + 1);
                    obj
                })
                .collect();
            groups.insert(name.to_string(), serde_json::json!({
                "count": v.len(),
                "items": indexed,
            }));
        }
    }

    let count = parse_errors.len();
    GroupedOutput {
        total,
        meta: Meta {
            tags: tags.len(),
            paths,
            max_depth,
            groups: groups.len(),
            elapsed_ms,
            parse_error_count: count,
            parse_errors,
        },
        groups: serde_json::Value::Object(groups),
    }
}
```

### 4. 仓颉：错误列表

```cangjie
import std.collection.*

class ParseError {
    let pos: Int64
    let reason: String
    init(pos!: Int64, reason!: String) {
        this.pos = pos
        this.reason = reason
    }
}

class LexResult {
    let toks: ArrayList<Token>
    let errors: ArrayList<ParseError>
    init(toks!: ArrayList<Token>, errors!: ArrayList<ParseError>) {
        this.toks = toks
        this.errors = errors
    }
}

func lexSafe(src: String): LexResult {
    let toks = ArrayList<Token>()
    let errors = ArrayList<ParseError>()
    let chars = src.toRuneArray()
    var i = 0
    while (i < chars.size) {
        let c = chars[i]
        if (c == r'0') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Zero, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'1') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.One, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'.') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Dot, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'(') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.LParen, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r')') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.RParen, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'<') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.LAngle, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'>') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.RAngle, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'{') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.LBrace, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'}') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.RBrace, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r'½') { toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Half, pos: i)); i += 1 }
        else if (c == r' ' || c == r'\n' || c == r'\t') { i += 1 }
        else {
            errors.append(ParseError(pos: i, reason: "非法字符: ${c}"))
            i += 1
        }
    }
    toks.append(Token(kind: TokKind.Eof, pos: i))
    return LexResult(toks: toks, errors: errors)
}

class ParseOutcome {
    let tree: Node
    let errors: ArrayList<ParseError>
    init(tree!: Node, errors!: ArrayList<ParseError>) {
        this.tree = tree
        this.errors = errors
    }
}

func parseExprSafe(src: String): ParseOutcome {
    let lr = lexSafe(src)
    let errors = lr.errors
    let p = Parser(toks: lr.toks.toArray())
    try {
        let tree = p.parseExpr()
        if (p.peek() != TokKind.Eof) {
            errors.append(ParseError(pos: p.pos(), reason: "表达式后有多余 token"))
        }
        return ParseOutcome(tree: tree, errors: errors)
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        errors.append(ParseError(pos: p.pos(), reason: "解析失败: ${e.message}"))
        return ParseOutcome(
            tree: Node(kind: NodeKind.Include, children: []),
            errors: errors,
        )
    }
}

func renderParseErrors(errors: ArrayList<ParseError>): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("[")
    for (i in 0..errors.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        sb.append("{\"pos\":${errors[i].pos},\"reason\":\"${errors[i].reason}\"}")
    }
    sb.append("]")
    return sb.toString()
}

func buildOutput(byKind: HashMap<String, ArrayList<IssueV4>>,
                 ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
                 elapsedMs: Int64,
                 parseErrors: ArrayList<ParseError>): String {
    // ... 同上一轮，meta 里加 parse_error_count 和 parse_errors ...
    var total: Int64 = 0
    var paths: Int64 = 0
    var maxDepth: Int64 = 0
    let tags = HashSet<String>()

    for ((_, issues) in byKind) {
        for (it in issues) {
            tags.add(it.tag)
            paths += 1
            if (it.paths.size > 0 && it.paths[0].size > maxDepth) {
                maxDepth = it.paths[0].size
            }
        }
    }
    if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
        for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { total += c; paths += c }
    }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"total\":${total},\"meta\":{")
    sb.append("\"tags\":${tags.size},\"paths\":${paths},")
    sb.append("\"max_depth\":${maxDepth},")
    let gc = byKind.size + (if (ignored.isSome()) { 1 } else { 0 })
    sb.append("\"groups\":${gc},\"elapsed_ms\":${elapsedMs},")
    sb.append("\"parse_error_count\":${parseErrors.size},")
    sb.append("\"parse_errors\":${renderParseErrors(parseErrors)}},")
    sb.append("\"groups\":{")

    var first = true
    for (name in GROUP_ORDER) {
        if (name == "ignored") {
            if (let Some(ig) <- ignored) {
                if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
                first = false
                var csum: Int64 = 0
                for ((_, c) in ig.counts) { csum += c }
                sb.append("\"ignored\":{\"count\":${csum},\"counts\":{")
                var cf = true
                for ((k, v) in ig.counts) {
                    if (!cf) { sb.append(",") }
                    cf = false
                    sb.append("\"${k}\":${v}")
                }
                sb.append("}}")
            }
        } else if (byKind.contains(name)) {
            if (!first) { sb.append(",") }
            first = false
            let issues = byKind[name]
            sb.append("\"${name}\":{\"count\":${issues.size},\"items\":[")
            for (i in 0..issues.size) {
                if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
                sb.append("{\"index\":${i + 1},\"tag\":\"${issues[i].tag}\",\"count\":${issues[i].count}}")
            }
            sb.append("]}")
        }
    }
    sb.append("}}")
    return sb.toString()
}

main() {
    let start = DateTime.now()
    let outcome = parseExprSafe(exprPart)
    // ... 继续用 outcome.tree ...
    let elapsed = DateTime.now() - start
    println(buildOutput(byKind, ignored, elapsed.toMilliseconds(), outcome.errors))
}
```

注意：仓颉 `Parser` 需要暴露 `pos()` 方法返回当前 token 位置；`lexSafe` 用 `toRuneArray()` 按字符遍历，`pos` 是字符下标，不是字节偏移。

---

### 这一轮补了什么

```
parse_errors 从数字变成列表：
  [{pos, reason}, ...]
parse_error_count 保留总数

lex 遇到非法字符：
  - 不再抛异常中断
  - 记 {pos, reason}，跳过该字符，继续
parser 遇到未闭合/多余 token：
  - 记 {pos, reason}
  - 能返回已解析部分就返回，不能就返回空树
```

效果：
- 你能看到“哪里错了、为什么错”，而不是只知道“错了 2 次”。
- 解析带病运行时，后续检查仍能跑，输出里 `parse_error_count > 0` 提醒你结果不完整。

程序仍然不替你定：
- `pos` 是字符下标还是字节偏移 → Nim/Rust/Zig 用字节偏移，仓颉用字符下标，按各语言 `lex` 实现；
- 非法字符是否跳过 → 固定跳过，不中断；
- 解析失败后是否继续 → 固定继续，空树跑后续。

下一步可选：**`parse_errors` 按 `pos` 排序**，或**给 `lex` 加“重复错误合并”**（同一位置连续非法字符只记一次）。你说方向。

## 👤 用户 · 2026-10-26 14:22

## 🤖 DeepSeek（deepseek） · 2026-10-26 14:22

继续。这一轮补两件事：**`parse_errors` 按 `pos` 排序**，以及 **`lex` 阶段连续非法字符合并成区间**（`pos` + `end`，`end` 省略表示单字符）。`parse_errors` 加 `kind` 字段（`lex` / `parse`），只有同类、同 reason、位置相邻才合并。

统一输出形态：

```json
"parse_errors": [
  {"pos": 3, "end": 5, "kind": "lex",   "reason": "非法字符"},
  {"pos": 9, "kind": "parse", "reason": "未闭合分组"}
]
```

规则：
- 排序：先按 `pos` 升序，同 `pos` 按 `kind` 排（`lex` 在前，`parse` 在后）。
- 合并：`kind` 相同、`reason` 相同、`cur.pos == last.end + 1` → 合并，`last.end = cur.pos`。
- `end == pos` 时不输出 `end` 字段。

### 1. Nim：合并 + 排序

```nim
type
  ParseErrorKind = enum peLex, peParse
  ParseError = object
    pos: int
    posEnd: int
    reason: string
    kind: ParseErrorKind

proc mergeParseErrors(errors: seq[ParseError]): seq[ParseError] =
  if errors.len == 0: return @[]
  var sorted = errors
  sorted.sort(proc(a, b: ParseError): int =
    if a.pos != b.pos: return cmp(a.pos, b.pos)
    cmp(ord(a.kind), ord(b.kind))
  )
  result = @[sorted[0]]
  for i in 1 ..< sorted.len:
    let cur = sorted[i]
    var last = result[^1]
    if cur.kind == last.kind and
       cur.reason == last.reason and
       cur.pos == last.posEnd + 1:
      result[^1].posEnd = cur.pos
    else:
      result.add cur

# lexSafe 里：非法字符记单字符，posEnd = pos
result.errors.add ParseError(pos: i, posEnd: i, reason: "非法字符", kind: peLex)

# parseExprSafe 末尾：合并
result.errors = mergeParseErrors(result.errors)

# buildOutput 里输出
var errArr = newJArray()
for e in parseErrors:
  var rec = %*{"pos": e.pos, "kind": $e.kind, "reason": e.reason}
  if e.posEnd != e.pos: rec["end"] = %e.posEnd
  errArr.add rec
```

### 2. Zig：合并 + 排序

```zig
const ParseErrorKind = enum { lex, parse };
const ParseError = struct {
    pos: usize,
    pos_end: usize,
    reason: []const u8,
    kind: ParseErrorKind,
};

fn cmpParseError(_: void, a: ParseError, b: ParseError) bool {
    if (a.pos != b.pos) return a.pos < b.pos;
    return @intFromEnum(a.kind) < @intFromEnum(b.kind);
}

fn mergeParseErrors(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    errors: []ParseError,
) ![]ParseError {
    if (errors.len == 0) return &.{};
    const sorted = try alloc.dupe(ParseError, errors);
    std.mem.sort(ParseError, sorted, {}, cmpParseError);

    var out = std.ArrayList(ParseError).init(alloc);
    try out.append(sorted[0]);
    for (sorted[1..]) |cur| {
        var last = &out.items[out.items.len - 1];
        if (cur.kind == last.kind and
            std.mem.eql(u8, cur.reason, last.reason) and
            cur.pos == last.pos_end + 1)
        {
            last.pos_end = cur.pos;
        } else {
            try out.append(cur);
        }
    }
    return out.toOwnedSlice();
}

// lexSafe 里非法字符：
try errors.append(.{ .pos = i, .pos_end = i,
                     .reason = "非法字符", .kind = .lex });

// parseExprSafe 末尾：
const merged = try mergeParseErrors(alloc, errors.items);
return .{ .tree = tree, .errors = merged };

// 输出：
fn writeParseErrors(w: anytype, errors: []const ParseError) !void {
    try w.writeAll("[");
    for (errors, 0..) |e, i| {
        if (i > 0) try w.writeAll(",");
        try w.print("{{\"pos\":{d},\"kind\":\"{s}\",\"reason\":\"{s}\"",
            .{ e.pos, @tagName(e.kind), e.reason });
        if (e.pos_end != e.pos) try w.print(",\"end\":{d}", .{e.pos_end});
        try w.writeAll("}");
    }
    try w.writeAll("]");
}
```

### 3. Rust：合并 + 排序

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum ParseErrorKind { Lex, Parse }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
struct ParseError {
    pos: usize,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    end: Option<usize>,
    kind: ParseErrorKind,
    reason: String,
}

fn merge_parse_errors(mut errors: Vec<ParseError>) -> Vec<ParseError> {
    if errors.is_empty() { return errors; }
    errors.sort_by(|a, b| {
        a.pos.cmp(&b.pos).then(a.kind.cmp(&b.kind))
    });

    let mut out: Vec<ParseError> = Vec::with_capacity(errors.len());
    out.push(errors[0].clone());
    for cur in errors.into_iter().skip(1) {
        let last = out.last_mut().unwrap();
        let last_end = last.end.unwrap_or(last.pos);
        if cur.kind == last.kind
            && cur.reason == last.reason
            && cur.pos == last_end + 1
        {
            last.end = Some(cur.pos);
        } else {
            out.push(cur);
        }
    }
    out
}

// lex_safe 里：
errors.push(ParseError {
    pos: i, end: None,
    kind: ParseErrorKind::Lex,
    reason: "非法字符".into(),
});

// parse_expr_safe 末尾：
let errors = merge_parse_errors(errors);
ParseOutcome { tree, errors }

// 输出：ParseError 已带 serde，直接序列化即可
```

### 4. 仓颉：合并 + 排序

```cangjie
enum ParseErrorKind { | Lex | Parse }

class ParseError {
    let pos: Int64
    var posEnd: Int64
    let kind: ParseErrorKind
    let reason: String
    init(pos!: Int64, kind!: ParseErrorKind, reason!: String) {
        this.pos = pos
        this.posEnd = pos
        this.kind = kind
        this.reason = reason
    }
}

func cmpParseError(a: ParseError, b: ParseError): Int64 {
    if (a.pos != b.pos) {
        if (a.pos < b.pos) { return -1 } else { return 1 }
    }
    let ka = if (a.kind == ParseErrorKind.Lex) { 0 } else { 1 }
    let kb = if (b.kind == ParseErrorKind.Lex) { 0 } else { 1 }
    if (ka < kb) { return -1 }
    if (ka > kb) { return 1 }
    return 0
}

func mergeParseErrors(errors: ArrayList<ParseError>): ArrayList<ParseError> {
    let out = ArrayList<ParseError>()
    if (errors.size == 0) { return out }
    let sorted = errors.toArray()
    sorted.sort(cmpParseError)
    out.append(sorted[0])
    for (i in 1..sorted.size) {
        let cur = sorted[i]
        let last = out[out.size - 1]
        if (cur.kind == last.kind
            && cur.reason == last.reason
            && cur.pos == last.posEnd + 1) {
            last.posEnd = cur.pos
        } else {
            out.append(cur)
        }
    }
    return out
}

// lexSafe 里：
errors.append(ParseError(pos: i, kind: ParseErrorKind.Lex, reason: "非法字符"))

// parseExprSafe 末尾：
let merged = mergeParseErrors(errors)
return ParseOutcome(tree: tree, errors: merged)

// 输出：
func renderParseErrors(errors: ArrayList<ParseError>): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("[")
    for (i in 0..errors.size) {
        if (i > 0) { sb.append(",") }
        let e = errors[i]
        let kindStr = if (e.kind == ParseErrorKind.Lex) { "lex" } else { "parse" }
        sb.append("{\"pos\":${e.pos},\"kind\":\"${kindStr}\",\"reason\":\"${e.reason}\"")
        if (e.posEnd != e.pos) {
            sb.append(",\"end\":${e.posEnd}")
        }
        sb.append("}")
    }
    sb.append("]")
    return sb.toString()
}
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
1. parse_errors 排序：
   - 按 pos 升序
   - 同 pos，lex 在 parse 前

2. lex 阶段连续非法字符合并：
   - 同类、同 reason、位置相邻 → 合并成一条
   - 输出 {pos, end, kind, reason}，end 省略表示单字符
   - 例：连续 3 个非法字符 → {pos:3, end:5, kind:"lex", reason:"非法字符"}

3. parse_errors 每条加 kind：
   - "lex"：词法阶段（非法字符）
   - "parse"：语法阶段（未闭合、多余 token）
```

效果：
- 不会出现“非法字符 3 次、非法字符 4 次、非法字符 5 次”三条重复记录。
- `parse_errors` 顺序稳定，可 diff。
- `kind` 让你区分“输入字符有问题”还是“结构有问题”。

程序仍然不替你定：
- 合并规则 → 固定为“同类 + 同 reason + 相邻位置”；
- `end` 是否输出 → 固定只在区间时输出；
- 排序方向 → 固定升序。

下一步可选：**`parse_errors` 里加 `context`**（错误位置前后各 5 个字符），或**把 `lex` 的“非法字符”按 Unicode 类别分类**（标点/字母/表情）。你说方向。

### 1. Nim：context 截取

```nim
import std/unicode

proc contextOf(src: string, pos, posEnd: int): JsonNode =
  var chars: seq[Rune]
  for r in src.runes: chars.add r
  # 边界安全
  let s = max(0, pos)
  let e = min(posEnd, chars.high)
  let beforeStart = max(0, s - 5)
  let afterEnd = min(chars.high, e + 5)

  var before, err, aft: string
  for i in beforeStart ..< s: before.add $chars[i]
  for i in s .. e: err.add $chars[i]
  for i in e + 1 .. afterEnd: aft.add $chars[i]

  %*{"before": before, "error": err, "after": aft}

# buildOutput 里输出 parse_errors 时：
var errArr = newJArray()
for e in parseErrors:
  var rec = %*{"pos": e.pos, "kind": $e.kind, "reason": e.reason}
  if e.posEnd != e.pos: rec["end"] = %e.posEnd
  rec["context"] = contextOf(src, e.pos, e.posEnd)
  errArr.add rec
```

注意：`pos` 需要和 `src` 对齐。如果 `pos` 是字节偏移，先转成字符下标：

```nim
proc byteToCharIndex(src: string, bytePos: int): int =
  var b = 0
  for i, r in src.runes:
    if b >= bytePos: return i
    b += r.size
  src.runes.len

# 调用时：
let cpos = byteToCharIndex(src, e.pos)
let cend = byteToCharIndex(src, e.posEnd)
rec["context"] = contextOf(src, cpos, cend)
```

### 2. Zig：context 截取

```zig
fn byteToCharIndex(src: []const u8, byte_pos: usize) usize {
    var b: usize = 0;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (b < byte_pos and b < src.len) {
        const len = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(src[b]) catch 1;
        b += len;
        i += 1;
    }
    return i;
}

fn charAt(src: []const u8, char_idx: usize) ?[]const u8 {
    var b: usize = 0;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < char_idx and b < src.len) {
        const len = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(src[b]) catch 1;
        b += len;
        i += 1;
    }
    if (b >= src.len) return null;
    const len = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(src[b]) catch 1;
    return src[b .. b + len];
}

fn writeContext(w: anytype, src: []const u8, pos: usize, pos_end: usize) !void {
    const cpos = byteToCharIndex(src, pos);
    const cend = byteToCharIndex(src, pos_end);
    const total = byteToCharIndex(src, src.len);

    const bstart = if (cpos >= 5) cpos - 5 else 0;
    const aend = @min(cend + 5, total - 1);

    try w.writeAll("{\"before\":\"");
    var i = bstart;
    while (i < cpos) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try w.writeAll(s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\",\"error\":\"");
    i = cpos;
    while (i <= cend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try w.writeAll(s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\",\"after\":\"");
    i = cend + 1;
    while (i <= aend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try w.writeAll(s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\"}");
}

// writeParseErrors 里：
try w.print(",\"context\":");
try writeContext(w, src, e.pos, e.pos_end);
```

### 3. Rust：context 截取

```rust
fn context_of(src: &str, pos: usize, pos_end: usize) -> serde_json::Value {
    // pos/pos_end 按字节偏移；用 char_indices 安全切
    let chars: Vec<(usize, char)> = src.char_indices().collect();
    let byte_to_char = |byte_pos: usize| -> usize {
        chars.iter().position(|(b, _)| *b >= byte_pos).unwrap_or(chars.len())
    };
    let cpos = byte_to_char(pos);
    let cend = byte_to_char(pos_end);

    let before_start = cpos.saturating_sub(5);
    let after_end = (cend + 5).min(chars.len().saturating_sub(1));

    let before: String = chars[before_start..cpos].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect();
    let error: String = if cpos <= cend {
        chars[cpos..=cend].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect()
    } else { String::new() };
    let after: String = if cend + 1 <= after_end {
        chars[cend + 1..=after_end].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect()
    } else { String::new() };

    serde_json::json!({
        "before": before,
        "error": error,
        "after": after,
    })
}

// 输出时：
let mut obj = serde_json::to_value(&e).unwrap();
obj["context"] = context_of(src, e.pos, e.end.unwrap_or(e.pos));
```

注意：`e.end` 如果是 `None`，用 `e.pos` 代替，表示单字符错误。

### 4. 仓颉：context 截取

```cangjie
func contextOf(src: String, pos: Int64, posEnd: Int64): String {
    let chars = src.toRuneArray()
    let s = if (pos < 0) { 0 } else if (pos > chars.size - 1) { chars.size - 1 } else { pos }
    let e = if (posEnd < s) { s } else if (posEnd > chars.size - 1) { chars.size - 1 } else { posEnd }
    let bstart = if (s >= 5) { s - 5 } else { 0 }
    let aend = if (e + 5 <= chars.size - 1) { e + 5 } else { chars.size - 1 }

    let before = StringBuilder()
    for (i in bstart..s) { before.append(chars[i]) }
    let err = StringBuilder()
    for (i in s..=e) { err.append(chars[i]) }
    let after = StringBuilder()
    for (i in (e+1)..=aend) { after.append(chars[i]) }

    return "{\"before\":\"${before}\",\"error\":\"${err}\",\"after\":\"${after}\"}"
}

// renderParseErrors 里：
sb.append("{\"pos\":${e.pos},\"kind\":\"${kindStr}\",\"reason\":\"${e.reason}\"")
if (e.posEnd != e.pos) {
    sb.append(",\"end\":${e.posEnd}")
}
sb.append(",\"context\":${contextOf(src, e.pos, e.posEnd)}")
sb.append("}")
```

注意：仓颉 `lexSafe` 用 `toRuneArray()` 遍历，`pos` 本来就是字符下标，`contextOf` 不需要字节转字符；`Parser` 记录的 `pos` 也要是字符下标，不是字节。

### 这一轮补了什么

```
parse_errors 每条新增 context：
  before : 错误起点前最多 5 个字符
  error  : 错误区间原文（pos..end）
  after  : 错误终点后最多 5 个字符

边界安全：
  - 起点前不足 5 个，取全部
  - 终点后不足 5 个，取全部
  - 多字节字符按 Rune/char 截取，不拆字节
```

效果：你不用回看原串，就能看到“错在什么上下文里”；连续非法字符合并后，`error` 显示整个区间，`before`/`after` 显示周边。

程序仍然不替你定：
- 上下文取几个字符 → 固定为 5，可改；
- `pos` 是字符下标还是字节偏移 → 各语言 `lex` 决定；Nim/Rust/Zig 若用字节，需先转字符；仓颉用字符；
- `context` 是否转义特殊字符 → 当前直接拼 JSON，若上下文含 `"` 或 `\` 需要转义，否则 JSON 会坏。

下一步可选：**上下文里的 `"` `\` 换行做 JSON 转义**，或**给 `context` 加 `before_truncated` / `after_truncated` 布尔**（表示前面/后面还有更多字符）。你说方向。

```json
  "before": "0<",

  "after": ">0)",
```

规则：
- `before_truncated = true`：错误起点前还有字符没被纳入（即 `pos - 5 > 0`）。
- `after_truncated = true`：错误终点后还有字符没被纳入（即 `end + 5 < 总字符数 - 1`）。
- JSON 转义：`"` → `\"`，`\` → `\\`，`\n` → `\n`，`\r` → `\r`，`\t` → `\t`，其它控制字符 → `\u00XX`。

### 1. Nim：转义 + truncated

```nim
proc escapeJson(s: string): string =
  result = ""
  for r in s.runes:
    case r
    of Rune('"'): result.add "\\\""
    of Rune('\\'): result.add "\\\\"
    of Rune('\n'): result.add "\\n"
    of Rune('\r'): result.add "\\r"
    of Rune('\t'): result.add "\\t"
    else:
      if r.int < 0x20:
        result.add "\\u" & r.int.toHex(4)
      else:
        result.add $r

proc contextOf(src: string, pos, posEnd: int): string =
  var chars: seq[Rune]
  for r in src.runes: chars.add r
  let total = chars.len
  let s = max(0, min(pos, total - 1))
  let e = max(s, min(posEnd, total - 1))
  let beforeStart = max(0, s - 5)
  let afterEnd = min(total - 1, e + 5)

  var before, err, aft: string
  for i in beforeStart ..< s: before.add $chars[i]
  for i in s .. e: err.add $chars[i]
  for i in e + 1 .. afterEnd: aft.add $chars[i]

  let beforeTrunc = beforeStart > 0
  let afterTrunc = afterEnd < total - 1

  "{\"before\":\"" & escapeJson(before) &
  "\",\"error\":\"" & escapeJson(err) &
  "\",\"after\":\"" & escapeJson(aft) &
  "\",\"before_truncated\":" & $beforeTrunc &
  ",\"after_truncated\":" & $afterTrunc & "}"
```

接入 `buildOutput` 时，直接 `rec["context"] = %*parseJson(contextOf(...))` 或用字符串拼接进最终 JSON。Nim 的 `%*` 不接受预转义字符串，所以建议直接拼：

```nim
var errArr = newJArray()
for e in parseErrors:
  var rec = %*{"pos": e.pos, "kind": $e.kind, "reason": e.reason}
  if e.posEnd != e.pos: rec["end"] = %e.posEnd
  # context 用字符串拼，避免二次转义
  rec["context"] = parseJson(contextOf(src, e.pos, e.posEnd))
  errArr.add rec
```

### 2. Zig：转义 + truncated

```zig
fn writeEscaped(w: anytype, s: []const u8) !void {
    for (s) |c| {
        switch (c) {
            '"'  => try w.writeAll("\\\""),
            '\\' => try w.writeAll("\\\\"),
            '\n' => try w.writeAll("\\n"),
            '\r' => try w.writeAll("\\r"),
            '\t' => try w.writeAll("\\t"),
            else => {
                if (c < 0x20) {
                    try w.print("\\u00{X:0>2}", .{c});
                } else {
                    try w.writeByte(c);
                }
            },
        }
    }
}

fn writeContext(w: anytype, src: []const u8, pos: usize, pos_end: usize) !void {
    const cpos = byteToCharIndex(src, pos);
    const cend = byteToCharIndex(src, pos_end);
    const total = byteToCharIndex(src, src.len);

    const bstart = if (cpos >= 5) cpos - 5 else 0;
    const aend = @min(cend + 5, total - 1);
    const before_trunc = bstart > 0;
    const after_trunc = aend < total - 1;

    try w.writeAll("{\"before\":\"");
    var i = bstart;
    while (i < cpos) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try writeEscaped(w, s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\",\"error\":\"");
    i = cpos;
    while (i <= cend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try writeEscaped(w, s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\",\"after\":\"");
    i = cend + 1;
    while (i <= aend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try writeEscaped(w, s);
    }
    try w.print("\",\"before_truncated\":{s},\"after_truncated\":{s}}}",
        .{ if (before_trunc) "true" else "false",
           if (after_trunc) "true" else "false" });
}
```

`charAt` 返回单字符的 UTF-8 切片；`writeEscaped` 对切片逐字节转义。ASCII 控制字符不会破坏 UTF-8 多字节序列，因为多字节字符的字节都 ≥ 0x80。

### 3. Rust：转义 + truncated

```rust
fn escape_json(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    for c in s.chars() {
        match c {
            '"'  => out.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => {
                out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32));
            }
            c => out.push(c),
        }
    }
    out
}

fn context_of(src: &str, pos: usize, pos_end: usize) -> serde_json::Value {
    let chars: Vec<(usize, char)> = src.char_indices().collect();
    let byte_to_char = |byte_pos: usize| -> usize {
        chars.iter().position(|(b, _)| *b >= byte_pos).unwrap_or(chars.len())
    };
    let cpos = byte_to_char(pos);
    let cend = byte_to_char(pos_end);
    let total = chars.len();

    let before_start = cpos.saturating_sub(5);
    let after_end = (cend + 5).min(total.saturating_sub(1));
    let before_trunc = before_start > 0;
    let after_trunc = after_end + 1 < total;

    let before: String = chars[before_start..cpos].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect();
    let error: String = if cpos <= cend {
        chars[cpos..=cend].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect()
    } else { String::new() };
    let after: String = if cend + 1 <= after_end {
        chars[cend + 1..=after_end].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect()
    } else { String::new() };

    serde_json::json!({
        "before": escape_json(&before),
        "error": escape_json(&error),
        "after": escape_json(&after),
        "before_truncated": before_trunc,
        "after_truncated": after_trunc,
    })
}
```

注意：`serde_json::json!` 会自动转义 `"` 和 `\`，所以其实不需要 `escape_json`——但你已经预先转义过的字符串会被 serde 再转义一次，变成 `\\\"`。**更安全的方式是不要预转义，交给 serde**：

```rust
serde_json::json!({
    "before": before,        // 原始字符串，serde 自动转义
    "error": error,
    "after": after,
    "before_truncated": before_trunc,
    "after_truncated": after_trunc,
})
```

只有在手工拼 JSON 时才需要 `escape_json`。

### 4. 仓颉：转义 + truncated

```cangjie
func escapeJson(s: String): String {
    let sb = StringBuilder()
    for (r in s.toRuneArray()) {
        if (r == r'"') { sb.append("\\\"") }
        else if (r == r'\\') { sb.append("\\\\") }
        else if (r == r'\n') { sb.append("\\n") }
        else if (r == r'\r') { sb.append("\\r") }
        else if (r == r'\t') { sb.append("\\t") }
        else if (r.toInt64() < 0x20) {
            // 控制字符转 \u00XX
            sb.append("\\u00")
            sb.append(Int64.toHex(r.toInt64()).padStart(2, '0'))
        } else {
            sb.append(r)
        }
    }
    return sb.toString()
}

func contextOf(src: String, pos: Int64, posEnd: Int64): String {
    let chars = src.toRuneArray()
    let total = chars.size
    let s = if (pos < 0) { 0 } else if (pos > total - 1) { total - 1 } else { pos }
    let e = if (posEnd < s) { s } else if (posEnd > total - 1) { total - 1 } else { posEnd }
    let bstart = if (s >= 5) { s - 5 } else { 0 }
    let aend = if (e + 5 <= total - 1) { e + 5 } else { total - 1 }
    let beforeTrunc = bstart > 0
    let afterTrunc = aend < total - 1

    let before = StringBuilder()
    for (i in bstart..s) { before.append(chars[i]) }
    let err = StringBuilder()
    for (i in s..=e) { err.append(chars[i]) }
    let after = StringBuilder()
    for (i in (e+1)..=aend) { after.append(chars[i]) }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"before\":\"${escapeJson(before.toString())}\"")
    sb.append(",\"error\":\"${escapeJson(err.toString())}\"")
    sb.append(",\"after\":\"${escapeJson(after.toString())}\"")
    sb.append(",\"before_truncated\":${beforeTrunc}")
    sb.append(",\"after_truncated\":${afterTrunc}}")
    return sb.toString()
}
```

仓颉 `Rune.toInt64()` 取码点；`padStart` 若版本不同，可手写：

```cangjie
let hex = Int64.toHex(r.toInt64()).toString()
if (hex.size < 2) { sb.append("0") }
sb.append(hex)
```

```
  after_truncated  : 错误终点后还有字符被截掉

context 里的字符串全部做 JSON 转义：

  \  → \\
  \n → \n
  \r → \r
  \t → \t
  其它控制字符 → \u00XX
```

### 1. Nim：省略号 + error_is_ascii

```nim
proc isAscii(r: Rune): bool = r.int < 128

proc contextOf(src: string, pos, posEnd: int): string =
  var chars: seq[Rune]
  for r in src.runes: chars.add r
  let total = chars.len
  let s = max(0, min(pos, total - 1))
  let e = max(s, min(posEnd, total - 1))
  let beforeStart = max(0, s - 5)
  let afterEnd = min(total - 1, e + 5)
  let beforeTrunc = beforeStart > 0
  let afterTrunc = afterEnd < total - 1

  var before, err, aft: string
  for i in beforeStart ..< s: before.add $chars[i]
  for i in s .. e: err.add $chars[i]
  for i in e + 1 .. afterEnd: aft.add $chars[i]

  var allAscii = true
  for i in s .. e:
    if not isAscii(chars[i]):
      allAscii = false
      break

  if beforeTrunc: before = "…" & before
  if afterTrunc: aft = aft & "…"

  "{\"before\":\"" & escapeJson(before) &
  "\",\"error\":\"" & escapeJson(err) &
  "\",\"after\":\"" & escapeJson(aft) &
  "\",\"before_truncated\":" & $beforeTrunc &
  ",\"after_truncated\":" & $afterTrunc &
  ",\"error_is_ascii\":" & $allAscii & "}"
```

### 2. Zig：省略号 + error_is_ascii

```zig
fn isAsciiChar(s: []const u8) bool {
    return s.len == 1 and s[0] < 0x80;
}

fn writeContext(w: anytype, src: []const u8, pos: usize, pos_end: usize) !void {
    const cpos = byteToCharIndex(src, pos);
    const cend = byteToCharIndex(src, pos_end);
    const total = byteToCharIndex(src, src.len);

    const bstart = if (cpos >= 5) cpos - 5 else 0;
    const aend = @min(cend + 5, total - 1);
    const before_trunc = bstart > 0;
    const after_trunc = aend < total - 1;

    var all_ascii = true;
    var i = cpos;
    while (i <= cend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| {
            if (!isAsciiChar(s)) { all_ascii = false; break; }
        }
    }

    try w.writeAll("{\"before\":\"");
    if (before_trunc) try w.writeAll("…");
    i = bstart;
    while (i < cpos) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try writeEscaped(w, s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\",\"error\":\"");
    i = cpos;
    while (i <= cend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try writeEscaped(w, s);
    }
    try w.writeAll("\",\"after\":\"");
    i = cend + 1;
    while (i <= aend) : (i += 1) {
        if (charAt(src, i)) |s| try writeEscaped(w, s);
    }
    if (after_trunc) try w.writeAll("…");
    try w.print("\",\"before_truncated\":{s},\"after_truncated\":{s},\"error_is_ascii\":{s}}}",
        .{ if (before_trunc) "true" else "false",
           if (after_trunc) "true" else "false",
           if (all_ascii) "true" else "false" });
}
```

### 3. Rust：省略号 + error_is_ascii

```rust
fn context_of(src: &str, pos: usize, pos_end: usize) -> serde_json::Value {
    let chars: Vec<(usize, char)> = src.char_indices().collect();
    let byte_to_char = |byte_pos: usize| -> usize {
        chars.iter().position(|(b, _)| *b >= byte_pos).unwrap_or(chars.len())
    };
    let cpos = byte_to_char(pos);
    let cend = byte_to_char(pos_end);
    let total = chars.len();

    let before_start = cpos.saturating_sub(5);
    let after_end = (cend + 5).min(total.saturating_sub(1));
    let before_trunc = before_start > 0;
    let after_trunc = after_end + 1 < total;

    let all_ascii = chars[cpos..=cend.min(total.saturating_sub(1))]
        .iter().all(|(_, c)| c.is_ascii());

    let mut before: String = chars[before_start..cpos].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect();
    let error: String = if cpos <= cend {
        chars[cpos..=cend].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect()
    } else { String::new() };
    let mut after: String = if cend + 1 <= after_end {
        chars[cend + 1..=after_end].iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).collect()
    } else { String::new() };

    if before_trunc { before.insert(0, '…'); }
    if after_trunc { after.push('…'); }

    serde_json::json!({
        "before": before,
        "error": error,
        "after": after,
        "before_truncated": before_trunc,
        "after_truncated": after_trunc,
        "error_is_ascii": all_ascii,
    })
}
```

注意：`error` 不再用 `escape_json`，交给 `serde_json::json!` 自动转义；`…` 是普通字符，serde 会原样输出。

```cangjie
func isAsciiRune(r: Rune): Bool = r.toInt64() < 128

func contextOf(src: String, pos: Int64, posEnd: Int64): String {
    let chars = src.toRuneArray()
    let total = chars.size
    let s = if (pos < 0) { 0 } else if (pos > total - 1) { total - 1 } else { pos }
    let e = if (posEnd < s) { s } else if (posEnd > total - 1) { total - 1 } else { posEnd }
    let bstart = if (s >= 5) { s - 5 } else { 0 }
    let aend = if (e + 5 <= total - 1) { e + 5 } else { total - 1 }

    let afterTrunc = aend < total - 1

    var allAscii = true
    for (i in s..=e) {
        if (!isAsciiRune(chars[i])) { allAscii = false; break }
    }

    let before = StringBuilder()
    if (beforeTrunc) { before.append("…") }
    for (i in bstart..s) { before.append(chars[i]) }

    let err = StringBuilder()
    for (i in s..=e) { err.append(chars[i]) }

    let after = StringBuilder()
    for (i in (e+1)..=aend) { after.append(chars[i]) }
    if (afterTrunc) { after.append("…") }

    let sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.append("{\"before\":\"${escapeJson(before.toString())}\"")
    sb.append(",\"error\":\"${escapeJson(err.toString())}\"")
    sb.append(",\"after\":\"${escapeJson(after.toString())}\"")
    sb.append(",\"before_truncated\":${beforeTrunc}")
    sb.append(",\"after_truncated\":${afterTrunc}")
    sb.append(",\"error_is_ascii\":${allAscii}}")

}
```

```cangjie
enum Severity { | Recoverable | Fatal }

class ParseError {
    let pos: Int64
    var posEnd: Int64
    let kind: ParseErrorKind
    let severity: Severity
    let reason: String
    init(pos!: Int64, kind!: ParseErrorKind,
         severity!: Severity, reason!: String) {
        this.pos = pos
        this.posEnd = pos
        this.kind = kind
        this.severity = severity
        this.reason = reason
    }
}

// lexSafe 非法字符：
errors.append(ParseError(
    pos: i, kind: ParseErrorKind.Lex,
    severity: Severity.Recoverable, reason: "非法字符"
))

// parseExprSafe：
try {
    let tree = p.parseExpr()
    if (p.peek() != TokKind.Eof) {
        errors.append(ParseError(
            pos: p.pos(), kind: ParseErrorKind.Parse,
            severity: Severity.Recoverable, reason: "表达式后有多余 token"
        ))
    }
    return ParseOutcome(tree: tree, errors: mergeParseErrors(errors))
} catch (e: Exception) {
    errors.append(ParseError(
        pos: p.pos(), kind: ParseErrorKind.Parse,
        severity: Severity.Fatal, reason: "解析失败: ${e.message}"
    ))
    return ParseOutcome(
        tree: Node(kind: NodeKind.Include, children: []),
        errors: mergeParseErrors(errors),
    )
}

// contextOf 里加：
var errByteLen: Int64 = 0
for (i in s..=e) { errByteLen += chars[i].toUtf8().size }

// renderParseErrors 里：
let sevStr = if (e.severity == Severity.Fatal) { "fatal" } else { "recoverable" }
sb.append(",\"severity\":\"${sevStr}\"")
sb.append(",\"context\":${contextOf(src, e.pos, e.posEnd)}")
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
parse_errors 每条新增：
  severity : "fatal" / "recoverable"

context 新增：
  error_byte_len : 错误区间的 UTF-8 字节长度

severity 判定：
  lex 非法字符 → recoverable（跳过继续）
  表达式后多余 token → recoverable
  未闭合但能返回部分 → recoverable
  parse_expr 抛异常 → fatal（返回空树）
```

效果：
- `severity` 让你一眼区分“输出可用但带病”和“输出不可用”；
- `error_byte_len` 让你直接按字节算偏移，不用再拿 `pos` 反推。

程序仍然不替你定：
- 哪种情况算 `fatal` → 固定为“`parse_expr` 抛异常”；
- `recoverable` 是否继续输出后续组 → 固定继续，带空树或部分树；
- `error_byte_len` 是否包含截断省略号 → 不包含，只算错误区间原文。

下一步可选：**`meta` 加 `has_fatal` 布尔**（整体输出是否因 `fatal` 不可信），或**`severity` 扩展到三级**（`info` / `warning` / `fatal`）。你说方向。

```nim
  Severity = enum svInfo, svWarning, svFatal
  ParseError = object
    pos, posEnd: int
    reason: string
    kind: ParseErrorKind
    severity: Severity

# lexSafe 非法字符 → warning
result.errors.add ParseError(
  pos: i, posEnd: i, reason: "非法字符",
  kind: peLex, severity: svWarning
)

# parseExprSafe：
try:
  result.tree = p.parseExpr()
  if p.peek() != tkEOF:
    result.errors.add ParseError(
      pos: p.toks[p.pos].pos, posEnd: p.toks[p.pos].pos,
      reason: "表达式后有多余 token",
      kind: peParse, severity: svWarning
    )
except ValueError as e:
  result.errors.add ParseError(
    pos: p.toks[p.pos].pos, posEnd: p.toks[p.pos].pos,
    reason: e.msg, kind: peParse, severity: svFatal
  )
  result.tree = Node(kind: nkInclude, children: @[])

# 空白 token 检查（info 级）：
proc checkTrailingWhitespace(src: string, errors: var seq[ParseError]) =
  if src.len == 0: return
  var i = src.len - 1
  while i >= 0 and src[i] in {' ', '\n', '\t', '\r'}: dec i
  if i < src.len - 1:
    errors.add ParseError(
      pos: i + 1, posEnd: src.len - 1,
      reason: "尾部空白", kind: peLex, severity: svInfo
    )

# buildOutput：
var hasFatal = false
for e in parseErrors:
  if e.severity == svFatal: hasFatal = true
  var rec = %*{
    "pos": e.pos, "kind": $e.kind, "reason": e.reason,
    "severity": $e.severity
  }
  if e.posEnd != e.pos: rec["end"] = %e.posEnd
  rec["context"] = parseJson(contextOf(src, e.pos, e.posEnd))
  errArr.add rec

meta["has_fatal"] = %hasFatal
```

### 3. Rust

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum Severity { Info, Warning, Fatal }

// lex_safe 非法字符：
errors.push(ParseError {
    pos: i, end: None,
    kind: ParseErrorKind::Lex,
    severity: Severity::Warning,
    reason: "非法字符".into(),
});

// parse_expr_safe：
match p.parse_expr() {
    Ok(t) => {
        if p.peek() != TokKind::Eof {
            errors.push(ParseError {
                pos: p.toks[p.pos].pos, end: None,
                kind: ParseErrorKind::Parse,
                severity: Severity::Warning,
                reason: "表达式后有多余 token".into(),
            });
        }
        ParseOutcome { tree: t, errors: merge_parse_errors(errors) }
    }
    Err(e) => {
        let pos = p.toks.get(p.pos).map(|t| t.pos).unwrap_or(0);
        errors.push(ParseError {
            pos, end: None,
            kind: ParseErrorKind::Parse,
            severity: Severity::Fatal,
            reason: e,
        });
        ParseOutcome {
            tree: Node { kind: NodeKind::Include, children: vec![], tags: vec![] },
            errors: merge_parse_errors(errors),
        }
    }
}

// 尾部空白：
fn check_trailing_whitespace(src: &str, errors: &mut Vec<ParseError>) {
    if src.is_empty() { return; }
    let bytes = src.as_bytes();
    let mut i = bytes.len();
    while i > 0 && matches!(bytes[i - 1], b' ' | b'\n' | b'\t' | b'\r') {
        i -= 1;
    }
    if i < bytes.len() {
        errors.push(ParseError {
            pos: i, end: Some(bytes.len() - 1),
            kind: ParseErrorKind::Lex,
            severity: Severity::Info,
            reason: "尾部空白".into(),
        });
    }
}

// build_output：
let has_fatal = parse_errors.iter().any(|e| e.severity == Severity::Fatal);

Meta {
    ...,
    has_fatal,
}
```

### 4. 仓颉

```cangjie
enum Severity { | Info | Warning | Fatal }

// lexSafe 非法字符 → Warning
errors.append(ParseError(
    pos: i, kind: ParseErrorKind.Lex,
    severity: Severity.Warning, reason: "非法字符"
))

// parseExprSafe：
try {
    let tree = p.parseExpr()
    if (p.peek() != TokKind.Eof) {
        errors.append(ParseError(
            pos: p.pos(), kind: ParseErrorKind.Parse,
            severity: Severity.Warning, reason: "表达式后有多余 token"
        ))
    }
    return ParseOutcome(tree: tree, errors: mergeParseErrors(errors))
} catch (e: Exception) {
    errors.append(ParseError(
        pos: p.pos(), kind: ParseErrorKind.Parse,
        severity: Severity.Fatal, reason: "解析失败: ${e.message}"
    ))
    return ParseOutcome(
        tree: Node(kind: NodeKind.Include, children: []),
        errors: mergeParseErrors(errors),
    )
}

// 尾部空白：
func checkTrailingWhitespace(src: String, errors: ArrayList<ParseError>): Unit {
    if (src.size == 0) { return }
    let chars = src.toRuneArray()
    var i = chars.size
    while (i > 0 && (chars[i-1] == r' ' || chars[i-1] == r'\n'
                     || chars[i-1] == r'\t' || chars[i-1] == r'\r')) {
        i -= 1
    }
    if (i < chars.size) {
        errors.append(ParseError(
            pos: i, kind: ParseErrorKind.Lex,
            severity: Severity.Info, reason: "尾部空白"
        ))
        errors[errors.size - 1].posEnd = chars.size - 1
    }
}

// renderParseErrors：
let sevStr = match (e.severity) {
    case Severity.Fatal => "fatal"
    case Severity.Warning => "warning"
    case Severity.Info => "info"
}
sb.append(",\"severity\":\"${sevStr}\"")

// buildOutput：
var hasFatal = false
for (e in parseErrors) {
    if (e.severity == Severity.Fatal) { hasFatal = true }
}
sb.append(",\"has_fatal\":${hasFatal}")
```

### 这一轮补了什么

```
severity 从两级扩到三级：
  info     : 纯提示，不影响可用性（尾部空白）
  warning  : 带病继续，输出可用（非法字符、多余 token）
  fatal    : 解析失败，返回空树，输出不可信

meta 新增：
  has_fatal : true 表示 parse_errors 里存在 fatal
```

效果：
- `info` 让你看到“不算错”的提示，不占用 warning 名额；
- `has_fatal` 让你不用遍历 `parse_errors` 就知道整体输出是否可信；
- `fatal` 时 `groups` 仍输出，但带空树，配合 `has_fatal` 一眼可判。

程序仍然不替你定：
- 哪种情况算 `info` → 固定为“尾部空白”；
- `fatal` 时是否清空 `groups` → 固定不清空，仍输出空树结果；
- `has_fatal` 是否影响 `total` → 固定不影响，`total` 仍按实际记录数算。

下一步可选：**`meta` 加 `fatal_reason`**（第一条 `fatal` 的 `reason`，方便快速定位），或**`has_fatal` 时在顶层加 `"trusted": false`**。你说方向。

- `fatal_reason`：取 `parse_errors` 里第一条 `severity == "fatal"` 的 `reason`；没有则 `null`。
- `trusted`：`has_fatal == false` 时为 `true`，否则 `false`。

### 1. Nim

```nim
proc buildOutput(
  byKind: OrderedTable[string, JsonNode],
  policy: Policy,
  startTime: MonoTime,
  parseErrors: seq[ParseError],
  src: string
): JsonNode =
  let elapsed = (getMonoTime() - startTime).inMilliseconds
  var groups = newJObject()
  var total = 0

  for name in GroupOrder:
    if name notin byKind: continue
    let v = byKind[name]
    if name == "ignored" and v.kind == JObject:
      var c = 0
      for _, x in v["counts"]: c += x.getInt
      total += c
      var obj = %*{"count": c, "counts": v["counts"]}
      if v.hasKey("samples"): obj["samples"] = v["samples"]
      groups[name] = obj
    elif v.kind == JArray:
      total += v.len
      groups[name] = %*{"count": v.len, "items": addIndex(v.getElems())}

  var hasFatal = false
  var fatalReason: JsonNode = newJNull()
  var errArr = newJArray()
  for e in parseErrors:
    if e.severity == svFatal and not hasFatal:
      hasFatal = true
      fatalReason = %e.reason
    var rec = %*{
      "pos": e.pos, "kind": $e.kind, "reason": e.reason,
      "severity": $e.severity
    }
    if e.posEnd != e.pos: rec["end"] = %e.posEnd
    rec["context"] = parseJson(contextOf(src, e.pos, e.posEnd))
    errArr.add rec

  %*{
    "trusted": not hasFatal,
    "total": total,
    "meta": {
      "tags": collectMeta(byKind)["tags"],
      "paths": collectMeta(byKind)["paths"],
      "max_depth": collectMeta(byKind)["max_depth"],
      "groups": groups.len,
      "elapsed_ms": elapsed,
      "parse_error_count": parseErrors.len,
      "has_fatal": hasFatal,
      "fatal_reason": fatalReason,
      "parse_errors": errArr
    },
    "groups": groups
  }
```

### 2. Zig

```zig
fn writeOutput(
    alloc: std.mem.Allocator,
    by_kind: *std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(IssueV4)),
    ignored: ?IgnoredSummary,
    elapsed_ms: u64,
    parse_errors: []const ParseError,
    src: []const u8,
) !void {
    const meta = collectMeta(by_kind, ignored);
    var total: usize = 0;
    var kit = by_kind.iterator();
    while (kit.next()) |entry| total += entry.value_ptr.items.len;
    if (ignored) |ig| {
        var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
        while (cit.next()) |c| total += c.value_ptr.*;
    }

    var has_fatal = false;
    var fatal_reason: ?[]const u8 = null;
    for (parse_errors) |e| {
        if (e.severity == .fatal and !has_fatal) {
            has_fatal = true;
            fatal_reason = e.reason;
        }
    }

    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    try stdout.print(
        "{{\"trusted\":{s},\"total\":{d},\"meta\":{{\"tags\":{d},\"paths\":{d},\"max_depth\":{d},\"groups\":{d},\"elapsed_ms\":{d},\"parse_error_count\":{d},\"has_fatal\":{s},\"fatal_reason\":",
        .{ if (has_fatal) "false" else "true",
           total, meta.tags, meta.paths, meta.max_depth,
           meta.groups, elapsed_ms, parse_errors.len,
           if (has_fatal) "true" else "false" },
    );
    if (fatal_reason) |r| {
        try stdout.print("\"{s}\"", .{r});
    } else {
        try stdout.writeAll("null");
    }
    try stdout.writeAll(",\"parse_errors\":");
    try writeParseErrors(stdout, src, parse_errors);
    try stdout.writeAll("},\"groups\":{");

    var first = true;
    for (GROUP_ORDER) |name| {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "ignored")) {
            if (ignored) |ig| {
                if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                first = false;
                var csum: usize = 0;
                var cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                while (cit.next()) |c| csum += c.value_ptr.*;
                try stdout.print("\"ignored\":{{\"count\":{d},\"counts\":{{", .{csum});
                cit = ig.counts.iterator();
                var cf = true;
                while (cit.next()) |c| {
                    if (!cf) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                    cf = false;
                    try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{d}", .{ c.key_ptr.*, c.value_ptr.* });
                }
                try stdout.writeAll("}}");
            }
        } else {
            const gop = by_kind.getPtr(name) orelse continue;
            if (!first) try stdout.writeAll(",");
            first = false;
            try stdout.print("\"{s}\":{{\"count\":{d},\"items\":[", .{ name, gop.items.len });
            for (gop.items, 0..) |it, i| {
                if (i > 0) try stdout.writeAll(",");
                try stdout.print(
                    "{{\"index\":{d},\"tag\":\"{s}\",\"count\":{d}}}",
                    .{ i + 1, it.tag, it.count },
                );
            }
            try stdout.writeAll("]}");
        }
    }
    try stdout.writeAll("}}\n");
}
```

```rust
#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
struct Output {
    trusted: bool,

    meta: Meta,
    groups: serde_json::Value,

#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
struct Meta {
    tags: usize,
    paths: usize,
    max_depth: usize,
    groups: usize,
    elapsed_ms: u128,
    parse_error_count: usize,
    has_fatal: bool,
    fatal_reason: Option<String>,
    parse_errors: Vec<ParseError>,
}

fn build_output(
    by_kind: HashMap<String, Vec<IssueV4>>,
    ignored: Option<IgnoredSummary>,
    elapsed_ms: u128,
    parse_errors: Vec<ParseError>,
) -> Output {
    // ... 同上一轮，计算 tags/paths/max_depth/total/groups ...

    let has_fatal = parse_errors.iter().any(|e| e.severity == Severity::Fatal);
    let fatal_reason = parse_errors.iter()
        .find(|e| e.severity == Severity::Fatal)
        .map(|e| e.reason.clone());

    let count = parse_errors.len();
    Output {
        trusted: !has_fatal,
        total,
        meta: Meta {
            tags: tags.len(),
            paths,
            max_depth,
            groups: groups.len(),
            elapsed_ms,
            parse_error_count: count,
            has_fatal,
            fatal_reason,
            parse_errors,
        },
        groups: serde_json::Value::Object(groups),
    }
}
```
